Investment Trust & Banks:
• Investment Securities - Held for Trading [SSHT]
• Investment Securities Available for Sale & Held to Maturity [SAFS]

Insurance:
• Investment Securities - Held for Trading [SSHT]
• Investment Securities Available for Sale & Held to Maturity [SAFS]
• Investment Securities - Designated at Fair Value - Other [SOFV]
• Investment Securities - Fixed Income [SFIR]
• Investment Securities - Equity [SEQS]
• Investment Securities - Other [SSCO]

Property:
• Affiliated Companies - Non-Controlled [SEQA]
• Non-Affiliated Companies - Non-Controlled [SEQN]

Other Financial:
• Investment Securities - Held for Trading [SSHT]
• Investment Securities Available for Sale & Held to Maturity [SAFS]
• Investment Securities - Designated at Fair Value - Other [SOFV]

Industrial company:
• Investment Securities - Total [XTIS]

provider_title: Investment Securities Available for Sale & Held to Maturity [SAFS]
provider_description:
Investment Securities Available for Sale & Held to Maturity [SAFS] represents securities held to maturity (its final payment date). It includes debt securities, usually valued at amortized cost, purchased with the intent of selling before it reaches maturity, securities backed by a mortgage or a collection of mortgages and investments in debt securities issued by the state treasury. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Investment Securities Available for Sale & Held to Maturity [SAFS] includes:
Insurance:
• Investment Securities - Held to Maturity/at Amortized Cost [ASHM]
• Investment Securities Available for Sale [ASFS]
• Investment Securities - Designated/Measured at Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income (FVOCI) [ACFV]

Banks:
• Investment Securities - Held to Maturity/at Amortized Cost [ASHM]
• Investment Securities Available for Sale [ASFS]
• Investment Securities - Designated/Measured at Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income (FVOCI) [ACFV]
• Mortgage Backed Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SMBH]
• Government Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SGOH]

Investment Trust
• Investment Securities - Held to Maturity/at Amortized Cost [ASHM]
• Mortgage Backed Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [AMBH]
• Islamic Investments & Deposits - Long-Term [ISIDL]
• Derivative Assets - Speculative/Trading - Long-Term [ALDS]
• Investment Securities - Total [XTIS]
• Investment Securities - Available for Sale - Total [SSFS]
• Government Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SGOH]

Other Financial
• Investment Securities - Held to Maturity/at Amortized Cost [ASHM]
• Mortgage Backed Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [AMBH]
• Islamic Investments & Deposits - Long-Term [ISIDL]
• Derivative Assets - Speculative/Trading - Long-Term [ALDS]
• Investment Securities - Total [XTIS]
• Local Government Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [ALGS]
• Government Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [AGVS]
• Investments - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Long-Term [ALTI]
• Investment Securities Available for Sale [ASFS]
• Investment Securities - Designated/Measured at Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income (FVOCI) [ACFV]

provider_title: Investment Securities - Available for Sale - Total [SSFS]
provider_description:
Investment Securities - Available for Sale - Total [SSFS] represents a debt or equity security that is purchased with the intent of selling before it reaches maturity, or selling prior to a lengthy time period in the event the security does not have a maturity. An Available for Sale Security is a debt, equity or other security that is not classified as held for trading or held to maturity. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Investment Securities - Available for Sale - Total [SSFS] includes:
• Investment Securities Available for Sale [ASFS]
• Investment Securities - Designated/Measured at Fair Value through Other Comprehensive Income (FVOCI) [ACFV]

Banks additionally includes:
• Local Government Securities - Available for Sale [ASLG]
• Government Securities - Available for Sale [ASGV]
• Federal Agency Securities - Available for Sale [ASFA]
• Mortgage Backed Securities - Available for Sale [ASMB]
• Investment Securities - Other - Available for Sale [ASOS]

Deferred Charges [STDF] represents the value of all deferred costs reported by the company in the balance sheet. This item is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries.
Deferred Charges [STDF] includes:
Industrial
• Other Deferred Charges/Prepayments [AODC]
• Deferred Costs - Net [ADFN]
• Deferred Costs - Gross [ADFG]
• Deferred Costs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ADFA] (deducted)
• Deferred Fuel Costs - Long-Term [ALDF]
• Deferred Fuel Costs - Short-Term [ACDF]
• Deferred Costs - Short-Term [ADFC]

Insurance and Bank
• Other Deferred Charges/Prepayments [AODC]

Property
• Other Deferred Charges/Prepayments [AODC]
• Deferred Costs - Net [ADFN]
• Deferred Costs - Gross [ADFG]
• Deferred Costs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ADFA] (deducted)
• Deferred Costs - Short-Term [ADFC]

Investment
• Other Deferred Charges/Prepayments [AODC]
• Deferred Costs - Net [ADFN]

Financial
• Other Deferred Charges/Prepayments [AODC]
• Deferred Costs - Net [ADFN]
• Deferred Costs - Gross [ADFG]
• Deferred Costs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ADFA] (deducted)

Other Assets [SOAO] represents any other assets which cannot be specifically collected under the granular FCC’s. This is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Assets [SOAO] includes:
• Interim Dividend [AIDT]
• Long-lived Assets [XLLA]
• Other Non-Current Assets [AOLA]
• Other Non-Current Assets - Total [XOLT]
• Own Equity Shares - Long-Term [AOET]
• Retained Losses [ARLT]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Customer Acceptances [ACAC]
• Deposits [AODP]
• Employee Stock Option Trust/Plan (ESOT/ESOP) in Own Equity Shares [AEST]
• Other Current Assets [ACAO]
• Other Current Assets - Total [XOCA]
• Own Equity Shares - Short-Term [AIES]
• Segregated - Cash & Investments [ACIS]
• Segregated - Cash Deposits [ACCD]
• Segregated - Deposits - Other [ACOS]
• Total Current Assets [XTCA]

Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Customer Acceptances [ACAC]
• Employee Stock Option Trust/Plan (ESOT/ESOP) in Own Equity Shares [AEST]

Property companies additionally includes:
• ESOT/ESOP in Own Equity Shares [AEST]
• Other Current Assets [ACAO]
• Other Current Assets - Total [XOCA]
• Own Equity Shares - Short-Term [AIES]

Banks additionally includes:
• Central Bank Assets - Settlements With Other Central Banks [ACBS]
• Central Bank Assets - Gold [ACBG]

Intangible Assets - excluding Goodwill - Gross [STIG] represents the total gross value of intangibles excluding the gross value of goodwill. Applicable to all Industries.
Intangible Assets - excluding Goodwill - Gross [STIG] includes:
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Gross [SRIC]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [SCSG]
• Research & Development Costs - Gross [SRDG]
• Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [SBNG]
• Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [SLFG]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG]

Banks additionally includes:
• Core Deposit - Gross [SCDG]
• Mortgage Servicing Rights - Gross [SMRG]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Gross [STAG]
• Above Market Rent/Leases - Gross [SAMG]
• Leasing Rights - Gross [SLGG]
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [SCSG]
• Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [SBNG]
• Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [SLFG]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG]

Investment companies additionally includes:
• Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG]

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [SCSG]
• Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [SBNG]
• Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [SLFG]
• Asset Management Contracts - Gross [SAMC]
• Customer Base/Relations - Gross [SCUG]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG]

provider_title: Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [SBNG]
provider_description:
Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [SBNG] represents the gross value of brand names, patents, trademarks, marketing related intangibles, artistic intangibles. Applicable to Industries, Bank, Property and Other Financial companies.
Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [SBNG] includes:
• Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Gross [ABNG]

Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG] represents the gross value of other intangibles such as technology based, club membership intangibles, customer related intangibles. Applicable to all Industries.
Intangible Assets - Other - Gross - Total [SOIG] includes:
• Intangible Assets - Other - Gross [AOIG]
• Deferred Costs - Gross [ADFG]

Industrial and Banks additionally includes:
• Intangible Assets - Contra Item - Gross [SCIG] (deducted)

provider_title: Intangible Assets - excluding Goodwill - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment - Total [STIA]
provider_description:
Intangible Assets - excluding Goodwill - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment - Total [STIA] represents the total value of  accumulated amortization of intangibles excluding the value of accumulated amortization of goodwill. Applicable to all Industries.
Intangible Assets - excluding Goodwill - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment - Total [STIA] includes:
Industrial
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCSS]
• Research & Development Costs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SRDA]
• Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SBNA]
• Licenses, Franchises, Copy/Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SLFA]
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization [SARI]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA]

Insurance:
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization [SARI]

Bank:
• Core Deposits - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCDA]
• Mortgage Servicing Rights - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SMRA]
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCSS]
• Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SBNA]
• Licenses, Franchises, Copy/Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SLFA]
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization [SARI]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA]

Property:
• Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [STAA]
• Above Market Rent/Leases - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SMAA]
• Leasing Rights - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SLGA]
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization [SARI]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA]

Investment Trust:
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization [SARI]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA]

Other Financial:
• Right of Use Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization [SARI]
• Asset Management Contracts - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SACA]
• Customer Base/Relations - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCUA]
• Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes Intangible Assets - excluding Goodwill - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment - Total [XTIA].

provider_title: Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA]
provider_description:
Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA] represents total accumulated amortization of other intangibles, customer related intangibles, technology based, club membership etc. Applicable to Industrial, Banks, Property and Other Financial companies.
Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SOIA] includes:
• Intangible Assets - Other - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [AOIA]

Industrial and Banks additionally includes:
• Intangible Assets - Contra Item - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ACIA] (deducted)

Deposits - Total [STDP] represents the sum of Customer and Banks/Financial institution Deposits. Applicable to Banks, Financial and Investment companies. 
Deposits - Total [STDP] includes:
Bank
• Deposits - Non-Interest Bearing [SIBD]
• Deposits - Interest Bearing Deposits [SNID]
• Deposits - Customers - Total [SDBC]
• Deposits - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions [SDDB]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes Deposits - Total [XTDP].

Investment and Financial
• Deposits - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions - Long-Term & Short-Term [LDBB]
• Deposits - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions - Short-Term [LSBD]
• Deposits - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions - Long-Term [LLBD]
• Deposits - Customers - Total [LDBC]
• Deposits - Total [XTDP]

Deposits - Customers - Total [SDBC] represents the total of all deposits received from customers. Applicable to Banks.
Deposits - Customers - Total [SDBC] includes:
• Deposits - Demand -Customer [SCDD]
• Deposits - Savings - Customer [SSTC]
• Deposits - Other - Customer [SDPO]

Deposits - Demand -Customer [SCDD] represents all includes deposits made by customers. Those deposits are repayable on demand and could be withdrawn without prior notice. Applicable to Banks.
Deposits - Demand -Customer [SCDD] includes: 
• Deposits - Demand & Interest Bearing - Customers [LIDC]
• Deposits - Demand & Non-Interest Bearing - Customers [LNDC]

Deposits - Savings - Customer [SSTC] represent deposits/due to banks and financial institutions which may not be callable immediately.
Includes moneys owned by customers other than banks and other financial institutions, such as:
• Time deposits, term deposits, certificates of deposit
• Savings accounts (not payable on demand)
Applicable to Banks.
Deposits - Savings - Customer [SSTC] includes:
• Deposits - Savings - Customer [LCSD]

provider_title: Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [SSOD] refers to short term debt, notes payable, bills of exchange and other interest-bearing debt obligations due within a year. Applicable to all industries.
provider_description:
Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [SSOD] refers to short term debt, notes payable, bills of exchange and other interest-bearing debt obligations due within a year. Applicable to all industries.
Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [SSOD] includes:
Industrial and Property:
•  Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [LSOD]
•  Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable - Financial Sector [LSODF]
•  Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable - Negative [LNSD]
•  Bills of Exchange & Notes [LBLS]
•  Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt [XSTD]
•  Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt - Negative [XNSD]
•  Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt - Financial Sector [XSTDF]
•  Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there are no other debt items)

Bank, Insurance, Investment and Financial companies additionally includes:
•  Short-Term Banking Borrowings excluding Collateralized Financing [SDXF]
•  Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities [SAFL]

provider_title: Short-Term Banking Borrowings excluding Collateralized Financing [SDXF]
provider_description:
Short-Term Banking Borrowings excluding Collateralized Financing [SDXF] represents the sum of Commercial Papers with an original maturity of less than one year, short-term borrowings and interest-bearing liabilities reported by a bank. Applicable to Insurance, Banks, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Short-Term Banking Borrowings excluding Collateralized Financing [SDXF]  includes:
• Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable [LSOD]
• Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable - Financial Sector [LSODF]
• Short-Term Debt & Notes Payable - Negative [LNSD]
• Bills of Exchange & Notes [LBLS]
• Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt [XSTD]
• Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt - Negative [XNSD]
• Short-Term Debt & Current Portion of Long-Term Debt - Financial Sector [XSTDF]
• Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there are no other debt items) additionally, Banks include
• Other Short-Term Banking Borrowings [LSTB]

provider_title: Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities [SAFL]
provider_description:
Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities [SAFL] represents a combination of central bank/federal funds purchased, securities sold under repurchase agreements (REPO liabilities), securities loaned and/or a collateral for refinancing transactions repayable. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities [SAFL] includes:
Insurance
• Federal Funds Purchased & Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LFSR]
• Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LSRP]
• Federal Funds Purchased [LFFP]
• Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities - Total [LCOF]
Bank
• Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities - Total [LCOF]
• Securities - Loaned [SSCL]
• Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements & Federal Funds Purchased [SSFF]
Investment
• Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements & Federal Funds Purchased [SSFF]
Financial
• Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities - Total [LCOF]
• Securities - Loaned [SSCL]
• Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements & Federal Funds Purchased [SSFF]
• Securities Received as Collateral - Obligation to Return [SRCO]

provider_title: Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements & Federal Funds Purchased [SSFF]
provider_description:
Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements & Federal Funds Purchased [SSFF] represents funds bought by the bank from the excess reserve funds of other banks that are maintained in the central bank/Federal Reserve it includes funds acquired from a financial institution for a limited period of time to cover reserve requirements. Applicable to Banks, Investment and Financial companies.  
Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements & Federal Funds Purchased [SSFF] includes:
Banks and Investment 
• Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [SSRA]  
• Federal Funds Purchased [SFFP]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes Federal Funds Purchased & Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LFSR].

Financial
• Federal Funds Purchased & Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LFSR]  
• Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LSRP]  
• Federal Funds Purchased [LFFP]

Federal Funds Purchased [SFFP] represents funds bought by the bank from the excess reserve funds of other banks that are maintained in the central bank/Federal Reserve Bank. These funds are purchased by the bank when their reserves temporarily go below their reserve requirements. Applicable to Bank and Investment Trust companies.
Federal Funds Purchased [SFFP] includes:
• Federal Funds Purchased [LFFP]

In the absence of above and presence of Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LSRP], it includes:
• Collateralized Financing Agreements, REPO Financing Loans - Liabilities - Total [LCOF] 
• Federal Funds Purchased & Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements [LFSR].

Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term [SLCL] represents the sum of obligations outstanding under finance lease and hire purchase agreement. This item is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries. 
Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term [SLCL] includes:
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term & Short-Term [LCLT]
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term & Short-Term - Financial Sector [LCLTF]
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term [LCLO]
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term - Negative [LNLL]
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LCLOF]

Banks and Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Ijara Lease Payables - Long-Term [IIJDL]
• Ijara Lease Payables - Long-Term & Short-Term [IIJD]

Other Payables - Total [SPAO] represents any payables other than income tax payable and dividend payable. It includes the creditors arising from investment market and dealing activities. In banks it includes amounts payable/owed to creditors or suppliers for materials and merchandise acquired or for services provided within the normal operations of the business. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Other Payables - Total [SPAO] includes:
• Other Payables [LOPB]
• Payables - Total [XPAT]

Banks additionally includes:
• Payables - Investment Dealing Activities [LPMC]
• Accounts Payable [LAPB]

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Payables - Investment Dealing Activities [LPMC]
• Payables - Customers, Brokers, Dealers, & Clearing Organizations [SDBP]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Interest Payable - Short-Term Debt [LSIP]

Common Equity - Contributed [SCOM] represents the sum of all capital surpluses on common stock as well as all share option reserves reported by the company and the par or stated value of the issued common shares of the company. Applicable to all industries.
Common Equity - Contributed [SCOM] includes:
• Common Stock - Issued & Paid [SCMS]
• Common Stock - Additional Paid in Capital including Option Reserve [SPIC]
• Common Share Capital including Additional Paid in Capital - Total [SCPT]

Common Stock - Issued & Paid [SCMS] represents the par or stated value of the issued common shares of the company. It includes the capital provided by limited partners.  It includes the value of all multiple shares. Applicable to all industries.  
Common Stock - Issued & Paid [SCMS] includes:
• Common Stock - Issued & Paid [QCMS]
• Share Capital - Common & Preferred - Total [XSHC]
• Limited Partner [SLPD]
• Common Share Capital including Additional Paid in Capital - Total [QCAT] (if there is no clear breakout is presented)

provider_title: Common Stock - Additional Paid in Capital including Option Reserve [SPIC]
provider_description:
Common Stock - Additional Paid in Capital including Option Reserve [SPIC] represents all capital surpluses on common stock as well as all share option reserves reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.  
Common Stock - Additional Paid in Capital including Option Reserve [SPIC] includes:  
• Share Option Reserve [QSOR]  
• Common Stock - Additional Paid in Capital [QPIC]

Comprehensive Income - Accumulated - Total [SACI] represents the sum total of all accumulated comprehensive income, net of tax and a combination of group amounts. Generally US only. Applicable to all Industries.
Comprehensive Income - Accumulated - Total [SACI] includes:
• Investments - Unrealized Gain/Loss [SUGC]
• Hedging Reserves [SHRC]
• Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment - Accumulated [SCTC]
• Comprehensive Income - Pension Liabilities [SPLC]
• Comprehensive Income - Unearned Compensation [SUCC]
• Revaluation Reserves [SVLR]
• Comprehensive Income - Other - Total [SOTC]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Comprehensive Income - Accumulated - Total [XCOM].

provider_title: Finance and Operating Lease Liabilities - Total - Supplemental [STFL]
provider_description:
Finance and Operating Lease Liabilities - Total - Supplemental [STFL] represents the sum of operating lease liabilities and capital leases arising on adoption of IFRS 16. Applicable to all Industries.
Finance and Operating Lease Liabilities - Total - Supplemental [STFL] includes: 
• Total Operating Lease Liabilities - Supplemental [STLT]
• Capitalized Leases - Current Portion [SCFL]
• Capitalized Lease Obligations - Long-Term [SLCL]

Cash & Securities [SCSEK] represents the total value of cash on hand and short term deposits due from other banks.  Applicable to Banks.
Cash & Securities [SCSEK] includes:
• Cash & Short-Term Deposits Due from Banks - Total [SCDK]
• Collateralized Agreements, Reverse REPOs & Securities Borrowed - Assets [SASB]
• Investments - Total [STIV]

Demand Deposits - Total [SDEMD]represents all includes deposits made by customers. Those deposits are repayable on demand and could be withdrawn without prior notice.  Applicable to Banks.
Demand Deposits - Total [SDEMD] includes:
• Deposits - Demand -Customer [SCDD]
• Deposits - Demand Deposits - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions [SBDD]

Earning Assets [SAIRN] represents all includes deposits made by customer and banking related loans. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment & other financial.
Earning Assets [SAIRN] Includes:
•Cash & Short-Term Deposits Due from Banks - Total[SCDK]
•Lending & Long-Term Deposits Due from Banks[SDBN]
•Collateralized Agreements, Reverse REPOs & Securities Borrowed - Assets[SASB]
•Banking Related Loans - Net[SNBL]
•Invested Assets - Total[SINVT]

Invested Assets - Total [SINVT] represents the sum of total investments, cash and cash equivalents, accrued investment income and receivables for securities sold.  Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Property, Investment Trust & Other Financial companies.
Invested Assets - Total [SINVT] includes:
• Investments - Total [STIV]

Insurance:
• Investments including Loans - Total [STIL]

Investment Securities [SINVS] represents all type investment made by the customer. Applicable to all industries.
Investment Securities [SINVS] Includes:
• Investment Securities - Available for Sale, Held to Maturity & Held for Trading - Total[STIS]
• FHLB Stock - Asset[SFHA] (applicable to Banks)

Savings Deposits - Total [SDEPS] represents total saving deposits from customer. Applicable to Banks.
Savings Deposits - Total [SDEPS] includes:
• Deposits - Savings - Customer [LCSD]
• Deposits - Savings - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions [LBSD]

Reserves for Loan Losses - Total [SRLLT] represents allowances accumulated for possible defaults on loans outstanding. It includes the loan loss provision for interbank lending. The default rates are established according to regulations in the country and the Bank’s experience with each group of customers. The default risks are typified by country risk, industry risk, and risks on individual customers. Applicable for Bank, investment Trust,  Financial companies.
Reserves for Loan Losses - Total [SRLLT] includes:
• Reserves for Loan Losses [SRLL]
• Loan Loss Allowance - Inter-Bank Loans [ALLB]

Total Available Funds [STAVF] represents the sum of total equity after minority interest and the total value of deposits. Applicable to Banks, Investment and Financial companies.
Total Available Funds [STAVF] includes.
• Total Long Term Capital [STLTC]
• Deposits - Total [STDP]

Loans - Gross – Total [SLTGT] represents the total value of loans to customers, before deduction of provisions. Loans to customers may be further delineated in various categories, such as by customers (consumer or industrial), by maturity (short-term or long-term), or by underlying securities (secured or not secured), either on the balance sheet face or in a footnote to the financial statement. Applicable to Banks, Insurance and Other Financial companies.
Loans - Gross - Total [SLTGT] includes:
• Loans - Gross [SLGT]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Banking Related Loans - Net [SNBL]. 

Additionally for Banks, it includes:
• Inter-Bank Loans - Gross [AGLB]
• Time Deposits [ABTD]

Deposits - Net [SNDEP] represents the total value of deposits (Deposits - Total [STDP]) less the value of all deposits which are repayable on demand and could be withdrawn without prior notice. Includes deposits made by other financial institutions only and excludes deposits made by customers (Deposits - Due to Banks & Financial Institutions [SDDB]). Applicable to Banks, Investment and Financial companies.

Loans - Net - Total [SLBNT] represents banking related loans and  lending & long term deposits due from banks. Applicable to Banks, Investment and Financial companies.
Loans - Net - Total [SLBNT] includes:
• Banking Related Loans - Net [SNBL]

Banks additionally includes:
• Lending & Long-Term Deposits Due from Banks [SDBN]

provider_title: Tangible Book Value & Reserves for Loan Losses - Total [STBRLL]
provider_description: Tangible Book Value & Reserves for Loan Losses - Total [STBRLL] represents the sum of  Tangible Book [SQTAN] and Reserves for Loan Losses [SRLLT]. Applicable to all Industries. (Used for analytics)

Short-Term Investments - Total [SSTI] represents investments in debt and equity securities & derivaties with maturity of one year or less. Applicable to Industrial & Property.
Short-Term Investments - Total [SSTI] includes:
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Speculative/Trading - Short-Term [ATDV]
• Short-Term Investments [ASTI]
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Speculative/Trading in Receivables - Short-Term [ATDR]
• Islamic Investments & Deposits [ISID]
• Islamic Investments & Deposits - Short-Term [ISIDS]
• Financial Assets - Short-Term [SFAC]

Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [SRCA] represents cash on hand and other assets that bear some kind of restriction and may not be available for operational use by the company. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [SRCA] Includes:
• Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [ARCA]
• Restricted Investment - Short-Term [ARSI]

Other Current Assets [SCAO] represents current assets other than those classified as current deferred income tax, current deferred costs, current restricted cash and short-term investments, cash, short-term investments, inventories, derivatives or receivables. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Other Current Assets [SCAO] includes:
• Other Current Assets [ACAO]
• Own Equity Shares - Short-Term [AIES]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Segregated - Cash Deposits [ACCD]
• Segregated - Cash & Investments [ACIS]
• Segregated - Deposits - Other [ACOS]

provider_title: Investments in Associates, Joint Ventures and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries [SEQT] - Investment in associated, affiliated and other companies accounted for by the equity method.
provider_description:
Investments in Associates, Joint Ventures and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries [SEQT] - Investment in associated, affiliated and other companies accounted for by the equity method.
Associated companies are usually defined as those where the shareholding company may have a significant influence on decision making in the affiliated company. It usually requires approximately 20% of shareholding to have a significant influence, although the percentage figure is not an absolute criterion. Applicable to all Industries.
Investments in Associates, Joint Ventures and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries [SEQT] includes:
• Investments in Associates, Joint Ventures and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries [AEQI]

Receivables & Loans - Long-Term [SLLR] represents the total value of any net and gross receivables other than those generated by sales of products, goods and services, loans and notes receivable, or other receivables represented by specific codes, after the provision for doubtful other receivables.  This item is applicable for differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries.
Receivables & Loans - Long-Term [SLLR] includes:
• Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Net - Long-Term [SLAN]
• Loans - Long-Term [SLNG]
• Finance Lease Receivables - Long-Term [SFLT]
• Receivables - Other - Net - Long-Term [SLRO]
• Provision - Doubtful Accounts - Long-Term [SLPT] (deducted)

Loans - Long-Term [SLNG] represents Long-term loans, notes receivable and other interest-earning non-current receivables, after the provision for doubtful loans/note receivables. This refers to loan receivables and interest-earning receivables from the sales of goods, products and services, after the provisions for doubtful loans and notes. Notes receivable are frequently used to settle overdue trade receivable balances. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Loans - Long-Term [SLNG] includes:
• Loans/Notes Receivables - Gross - Long-Term [ALNG]
• Loans/Notes Receivables - Net - Long-Term [ALNN]

Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [SOPC] represents the gross value of tangible assets other than Plant/Machinery/Equipment, Land/Buildings, Property Plant & Equipment under Capitalized Leases or Construction in Progress. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [SOPC] includes:
•  Natural Resources/Biological Assets - Gross [SBAC]
•  Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Gross [SMXC]
•  Utility Plant - Gross [SUTP]
•  Property, Plant & Equipment - Contra Item - Gross [SCCP] (deducted)
•  Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Gross [AOPC]

Natural Resources/Biological Assets - Gross [SBAC] represents the gross book value (before depreciation and impairment) of biological assets and renewable natural resources. These are defined under IFRS as living animals or plants, such as sheep, trees and vines. This field is used when the item is reported within PPE. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Natural Resources/Biological Assets - Gross [SBAC] includes:
• Biological Assets - Gross [ABAC]

provider_title: Assets Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [SDOA]
provider_description:
Assets Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [SDOA] represents the assets of discontinued operations to be disposed of through sale and other non current assets classified as held for sale, when other non current assets are not reported separately.  When a company does not delineate between current and non-current assets (non differentiated B/S), all assets under discontinued operations are classified as Discontinued Operations – LT Asset. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Assets Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [SDOA] includes:
• Assets Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [ADOA]

provider_title: Restricted Accounts - Long-Term [SRCL] refers to cash, investments and other assets whose use is limited by law or other regulations, and permitted in more than one year or long-term in nature. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Restricted Accounts - Long-Term [SRCL] refers to cash, investments and other assets whose use is limited by law or other regulations, and permitted in more than one year or long-term in nature. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Restricted Accounts - Long-Term [SRCL] includes:
• Restricted Cash - Long-Term [ARCL]

provider_title: Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Short-Term [SDCL]
provider_description:
Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Short-Term [SDCL] represents liability arising from sale of business or group assets or discontinued operations or any assets held by business for sale. When the company does not delineated between the current and the non-current portion, it is updated to Non-current Liability Held for Sale/Disc Operations [LDOL]. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Short-Term [SDCL] includes:
• Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Short-Term [LDCL]

provider_title: Dividends/Distributions Payable [SDPB] refers to dividend that has been declared by directors but not paid to stockholders (common or preferred). Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Dividends/Distributions Payable [SDPB] refers to dividend that has been declared by directors but not paid to stockholders (common or preferred). Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Dividends/Distributions Payable [SDPB] includes:
• Dividends/Distributions Payable [LDPB]

Security Deposits [SSED] represents security deposits received for the purpose of offsetting potential losses due to damage of either a physical or intellectual nature or for rights of usage. It also includes amounts received as a proof of intent. Applicable to Industrial, Insurance, Property, Investment and Fnancial companies.
Security Deposits [SSED] includes:
• Security Deposits [LSED]

provider_title: Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [SDOL]
provider_description:
Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [SDOL] Represents the liabilities which are classified as held for sale from discontinued operations and other non current liabilities classified as held for sale. This field is long-term. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [SDOL] includes:
• Liabilities Held for Sale/Discontinued Operations - Long-Term [LDOL]

Preferred Shareholders Equity [SPSE] represents the total preferred shareholders. It includes preferred stock owned by the issuing company or its consolidated subsidiaries and other preferred stock. Applicable to all industries.
Preferred Shareholders Equity [SPSE] includes: 
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Total [SRPS]
• Preferred Stock - Non-Redeemable [SNRP]
• Preferred Equity - Contributed [SCPF]
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Temporary Equity [STPR]
• ESOP Guarantees - Preferred & Deferred Compensation [SEDP]
• Preferred Stock - Treasury/Repurchased [STSP] (deducted)
• Preferred Shareholders Equity - Total [QPSU]

Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Total [SRPS] represents all redeemable preferred stock both convertible and non-convertible, and redeemable on the maturity date. Applicable to all Industries. 
Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Total [SRPS] includes:
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Convertible [SPRC]
• Preferred Stock - Redeemable [ZPSK]

provider_title: Preferred Stock - Redeemable - Convertible [SPRC] refers to preferred stock that is convertible and redeemable at maturity. • Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 3 [VCL3]

provider_title: Capital Lease Maturities - Due in 4-5 Years [SCL45]
provider_description:
Capital Lease Maturities - Due in 4-5 Years [SCL45] represents the amount of capital lease payments due in year 4 and 5 following the balance sheet period end date. Applicable to all Industries.
Capital Lease Maturities - Due in 4-5 Years [SCL45] includes:
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 4 [VCL4]
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 5 [VCL5]

Marketable Securities - Long-Term [SMSL] represents long-term investments in very liquid instruments easily convertible into cash. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. 
Marketable Securities - Long-Term [SMSL] includes:
• Marketable Securities - Long-Term [AMSL]

Research & Development Costs - Gross [SRDG] represents the gross value of capitalized expenditure relating to research & development, including the development of new products. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Costs - Gross [SRDG] includes:
• Research & Development Costs - Gross [ARDG]

provider_title: Licenses, Franchises, Copy/Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SLFA]
provider_description:
Licenses, Franchises, Copy/Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SLFA] represents total accumulated amortisation of licences, franchises, copyrights, property rights, land use rights if reported within the intangible Asset break out. Applicable to Industrial, Bank, Property and Other Financial companies.
Licenses, Franchises, Copy/Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SLFA] includes:
• Licenses, Franchises, Copy/Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ALFA]

Convertible Debt - Long-Term [SCDL] represents the total amount of a company's debt which can be converted into common or preferred stock. Applicable to all Industries.
Convertible Debt - Long-Term [SCDL] Includes:
• Convertible Debt - Long-Term & Short-Term [LCDT]
• Convertible Debt - Long-Term & Short-Term - Financial Sector [LCDTF]
• Convertible Debt - Long-Term [LCDN]
• Convertible Debt - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LCDNF]

provider_title: Preferred Stock - Non-Redeemable [SNRP] includes security of a company which cannot be paid off before maturity even if the company can afford to do so and to non redeemable preferred stock that is convertible into common stock under certain conditions. When the company does not specifically reports the convertible preferred stock as redeemable or non redeemable, it is to be treated as non-redeemable. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Preferred Stock - Non-Redeemable [SNRP] includes security of a company which cannot be paid off before maturity even if the company can afford to do so and to non redeemable preferred stock that is convertible into common stock under certain conditions. When the company does not specifically reports the convertible preferred stock as redeemable or non redeemable, it is to be treated as non-redeemable. Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Stock - Non-Redeemable [SNRP] includes:
• Preferred Stock - Non-Redeemable, Non-Participating, Non-Cumulative, Share Capital & Premium [ZRPS]
• Preferred Stock - Convertible - Non-Redeemable [SPNC]

Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Total [STDH] represents the fair value of both short-term and long-term financial instruments or contracts whose value is derived from some other financial measure. Examples of derivatives include future or forward contracts, futures, call or put options. This item is used for derivatives whose purpose is to limit the risk related to the volatility of market prices of goods sold by the company, or to significant changes in foreign exchange rates. Applicable to all Industries with non-differentiated balance sheet.
Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Total [STDH] includes:  
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Long-Term [ANDH]

Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Short-Term [AOCD]
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging in Receivables - Short-Term [ARCD]

provider_title: Trade Accounts & Trade Notes Receivable - Total [SANT]
provider_description:
Trade Accounts & Trade Notes Receivable - Total [SANT] represents the total value of receivables from the sales of products, goods, trading assets (such as inventories) or from services provided, before provisions for doubtful receivables. It includes value of receivables from subsidiaries, affiliates, associates, joint ventures or other companies forming the same capital group, unbilled utility revenue. This item is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Financial companies.
Trade Accounts & Trade Notes Receivable - Total [SANT] includes:
• Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Gross - Total [AART]
• Provision - Doubtful Trade Accounts & Trade Notes Payable - Total [STAP] (deducted)

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Receivables from Customers, Brokers & Clearing Organizations [SRRO]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes:
• Unbilled Utility Revenue - Short-Term [AUUR]
• Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Net - Long-Term [ALRN]
• Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Net [AACR]
• Receivables from Customers, Brokers & Clearing Organizations [SRRO]

Deferred Tax - Asset - Long-Term & Short-Term [SDTT] represents deferred tax credits and debits liabilities reported in the asset section. This item includes both short term and long term deferred tax.  This item is applicable to all industries with non-differentiated balance sheet. 
Deferred Tax - Asset - Long-Term & Short-Term [SDTT] includes:  
• Deferred Tax - Asset - Long-Term [ADTA]
• Deferred Tax - Asset - Net [ADTN]
• Deferred Tax - Debit - Asset [ADTD]
• Deferred Tax - Credit - Asset [ADTS]
• Deferred Tax - Asset - Short-Term [ABDC]

Prepaid Expenses - Total [SPPT] represents the total value of goods or services that have already been purchased, but not fully consumed or used. It includes both current and non-current prepayments. This item is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries.
Prepaid Expenses - Total [SPPT] includes:
• LT & ST Prepayments in Long Term Assets [ATPY]
• Prepaid expenses and other current assets [APYO]
• Prepaid Expenses [APPY]
• LT & ST Pension Prepayments [APEP]
• Prepayments/Accrued Income [APAI]
• Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [ANPY] 
• Foreign Exchange Loss - LT Assets [AFXT]

Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [SCSG] represents gross value of computer software. This FCC is used when computer software is reported as part of intangibles. Applicable to Industrial, Bank, Property and Other Financial companies.
Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [SCSG] includes:
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [ACSG]

provider_title: Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [SLFG]
provider_description:
Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [SLFG] represents the gross value of licenses, franchises, copyrights, property rights, prototypes, contract-based intangibles, models, designs. Applicable to Industrial, Bank, Property and Other Financial companies.
Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [SLFG] includes:
• Licenses, Franchises, Copyrights, Property Rights, Prototypes, Contract Based, Models & Designs - Gross [ALFG]

Other Liabilities - Total [SLBO] represents the total other liabilities of the company. This is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Liabilities - Total [SLBO] includes:
• Other Liabilities [SOOL]
• Deferred Revenue/Income [SDRI]
• Provisions [SPRV]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Customer Advances - Total [SCAT]
• Billings in Excess of Costs - Total [SBXT]
• Regulatory Liabilities - Total [SRLT]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Customer Advances - Total [SCAT]
• Billings in Excess of Costs - Total [SBXT]

Provisions [SPRV] represents the total value of all current and non-current provisions including pension and post-retirement benefits. It includes provision for future restructuring and reorganization costs, non-current legal costs and litigation claims, environmental obligations and related to the closure of a mine, plantation or facilities negatively affecting the natural environment, and restoring it to its previous shape.  Applicable to all Industries.
Provisions [SPRV] includes:
• Provisions - Other than Pension & Post Retirement [SPOT] 
• Post Employment Benefits - Pension & Other [SPET]

provider_title: Post Employment Benefits - Pension & Other [SPET] refers to provisions for future pension liabilities. Includes retirement benefits, pension reserves, healthcare plans and post-employment obligations. Applicable to all industries.
provider_description:
Post Employment Benefits - Pension & Other [SPET] refers to provisions for future pension liabilities. Includes retirement benefits, pension reserves, healthcare plans and post-employment obligations. Applicable to all industries.
Post Employment Benefits - Pension & Other [SPET] includes:
• Post Employment Benefits - Pension & Other - Long-Term [LPEN]

Deferred Revenue/Income [SDRI] represents the sum of current and non-current deferred income. Deferred Income refers to income received in advance for the goods or services which have not been delivered. Applicable to all Industries. 
Deferred Revenue/Income [SDRI] includes:
• Deferred Income - Short-Term [LCAV]
• Deferred Income [LDIL]
• Contract Liabilities - Long-Term - Advance Consideration & Progress Billings in Excess of Unbilled Revenue [LCLL]
• Contract Liabilities - Short-Term - Advance Consideration & Progress Billings in Excess of Unbilled Revenue [LCLS]

Industrial, Property and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Customer Advances - Short-Term [LCAC] 
• Customer Advances - Long-Term [LCAL] 

Investment companies additionally includes:
• Customer Advances - Short-Term [LCAC]

Other Liabilities - [SOOL] represents any other liabilities which cannot be specifically collected under the granular FCC’s. This is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to all industries.
Other Liabilities [SOOL] includes:
• Deferred Tax - Liability - Short-Term [LDTC]
• Goodwill - Negative [LNGW]
• Other Non-Current Liabilities [LOLL]
• Other Non-Current Liabilities - Total [XLLT]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Acceptances Outstanding [LACC]
• Financial Liabilities - Long-Term [LFNC] (if there is debt item available)
• Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there is debt item available)
• Income Taxes - Payable - Short-Term [LTXP]
• Security Deposits [LSED]
• Total Non-Current Liabilities [XNCL]

Banks additionally includes:
• Acceptances Outstanding [LACC]
• Financial Liabilities - Long-Term [LFNC] (if there is debt item available)
• Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there is debt item available)
• Total Non-Current Liabilities [XNCL]
• Unrealized Foreign Exchange Gain - Long-Term [LFXT]
• Central Bank Liabilities - Money in Circulation [LCBM]
• Central Bank Liabilities - Settlements With Other Central Banks [LCBS]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Derivative Liabilities - Speculative/Trading - Long-Term [LDSN]
• Derivative Liabilities - Speculative/Trading - Short-Term [LSDC]
• Financial Liabilities - Long-Term [LFNC] (if there is debt item available)
• Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there is debt item available)
• Interest Payable - Short-Term Debt [LSIP]
• Other Current Liabilities [LOCL]
• Other Payables [LOPB]
• Security Deposits [LSED]

Investment companies additionally includes:
• Acceptances Outstanding [LACC]
• Derivative Liabilities - Speculative/Trading - Long-Term [LDSN]
• Derivative Liabilities - Speculative/Trading - Short-Term [LSDC]
• Financial Liabilities - Long-Term [LFNC] (if there is debt item available)
• Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there is debt item available)
• Other Current Liabilities [LOCL]
• Other Current Liabilities - Total [XOCL]
• Securities Sold [LSSO]
• Security Deposits [LSED]
• Total Current Liabilities [XTCL]
• Total Non-Current Liabilities [XNCL]

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Derivative Liabilities - Speculative/Trading - Long-Term [LDSN]
• Derivative Liabilities - Speculative/Trading - Short-Term [LSDC]
• Financial Liabilities - Long-Term [LFNC] (if there is debt item available)
• Financial Liabilities - Short-Term [LFCR] (if there is debt item available)
• Other Current Liabilities [LOCL]
• Security Deposits [LSED]
• Total Current Liabilities [XTCL]
• Total Non-Current Liabilities [XNCL]
• Unrealized Foreign Exchange Gain - Long-Term [LFXT]

provider_title: Securities Purchased under REPOs [SRPO] - Change in central bank funds sold, securities purchased under resale agreements (REPOs) and collateral for securities borrowed receivable. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
provider_description:
Securities Purchased under REPOs [SRPO] - Change in central bank funds sold, securities purchased under resale agreements (REPOs) and collateral for securities borrowed receivable. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Securities Purchased under REPOs [SRPO] includes:
• Securities Purchased under REPOs [ACSF]

provider_title: Investment Securities - Designated at Fair Value - Other [SOFV]
provider_description:
Investment Securities - Designated at Fair Value - Other [SOFV] represents securities classified as 'designated at Fair value through profit & loss (FVPL) but not further classified as available for sale (AFS), held to maturity (HTM) or for trading. This disclosure is fairly common under IFRS. These assets are carried in the consolidated balance sheet at fair value with gains or losses recognized in the consolidated statement of income under “Gains or Losses on Derivative Financial Instrument Transactions” for derivative instruments and “Other Income or Expense” for non-derivative financial assets. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Investment Securities - Designated at Fair Value - Other [SOFV] includes:
• Investment Securities - Designated at Fair Value through Profit & Loss/Unclassified [AOFV]

provider_title: Restricted Accounts - Cash [STRC] refers to cash and other assets held subject to limitations on how or when it may be used. For example, refundable customer deposits and cash in escrow accounts. It
provider_description:
Restricted Accounts - Cash [STRC] refers to cash and other assets held subject to limitations on how or when it may be used. For example, refundable customer deposits and cash in escrow accounts. It represents cash on hand and other assets that bears some kind of restriction and may not be available for operational use by the company. This item include both long term and current restricted cash. Applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet and to all industries.  
Restricted Accounts - Cash [STRC] includes: 
• Restricted Accounts - Short-Term [ARCA]
• Restricted Investment - Short-Term [ARSI]
• Restricted Cash - Long-Term [ARCL]

Preferred Shares - Issued - Issue Specific [STPII] represents the number of preferred shares issued (per specific share issue, company level - includes both shares outstanding and treasury shares). Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Shares - Issued - Issue Specific [STPII] includes:
• Preferred Shares - Issued - Issue Specific [XTPII]

Preferred Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific [STPOI] represents the number of preferred shares outstanding (per specific share issue, instrument level - excludes treasury shares). Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific [STPOI] includes:
• Preferred Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific [XTPOI]

Preferred Shares - Treasury - Issue Specific [STPTI] represents the number of preferred treasury shares (per specific share issue, instrument level). Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Shares - Treasury - Issue Specific [STPTI] includes:
• Preferred Shares - Treasury - Issue Specific [XTPTI]

Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Short-Term [SDFC] represents the fair value of short-term financial instruments or contracts whose value is derived from some other financial measure. Examples of derivatives include future or forward contracts, futures, call or put options. This item is used for derivatives whose purpose is to limit the risk related to the volatility of market prices of goods sold by the company, or to significant changes in foreign exchange rates. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Short-Term [SDFC] includes:
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging - Short-Term [AOCD]
• Derivative Financial Instruments - Hedging in Receivables - Short-Term [ARCD]

Transportation Equipment - Gross [STEC] represents the gross book value (before depreciation and impairment) of transport assets. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Transportation Equipment - Gross [STEC] includes:
• Transportation Equipment - Gross [ATPC]

Regulatory Assets - Long-Term [SRAN] represents probable future revenues associated with certain costs that are expected to be recovered from customers through the ratemaking process. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Regulatory Assets - Long-Term [SRAN] includes: 
• Regulatory Assets - Long-Term [AREG]

Hybrid Financial Instrument - Liability - Long-Term [SLHF] represents securities that combines two or more different financial instruments. Hybrid securities generally combine both debt and equity characteristics. Applicable to all industries.
Hybrid Financial Instrument - Liability - Long-Term [SLHF]  includes:  
• Hybrid Financial Instrument - Liability - Long-Term [LLHU]
• Hybrid Financial Instrument - Liability - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LLHUF]
• Hybrid Financial Instrument - Liability - Long-Term & Short-Term [LLHT]
• Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term [SMRS]
• Mandatorily Redeemable Trust Certificates - Long-Term [SPSD]
• Preferred Stock - Liability Portion - Long-Term [SLPS]

Preferred Stock - Liability Portion - Long-Term [SLPS] represents long term portion of Preferred stock reported under the Liability section. Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Stock - Liability Portion - Long-Term [SLPS] includes:
• Preferred Stock - Liability Portion - Long-Term [LLPS]
• Preferred Stock - Liability Portion - Long-Term & Short-Term [LLPT]
• Preferred Stock - Liability Portion - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LLPSF]

Comprehensive Income - Pension Liabilities [SPLC] represents accumulated pension liabilities disclosed as comprehensive income. Applicable to all industries.
Comprehensive Income - Pension Liabilities [SPLC] includes:
• Comprehensive Income - Pension Liabilities [QPLC]

Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Net [SNCS] represents the net book value of software after deducting the accumulated amortization of computer software from the gross value of computer software. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Bank, Financial companies.
Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Net [SNCS] includes:
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Net [ACSN]
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Gross [ACSG]
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ACSA] (Deducted)

Capital Lease Maturities - Remaining Maturities [SCLX] represents the amount of capital lease payments maturity greater than Year 10. Applicable to all Industries.
Capital Lease Maturities - Remaining Maturities [SCLX] includes:
• Capital Lease Maturities - Remaining Maturities [VCLR]

provider_title: Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 & Beyond [SCL6B]
provider_description:
Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 & Beyond [SCL6B] represents the sum of capital lease payments due after year 5 from the balance sheet period end date. These values are non-cumulative. Applicable to all Industries.
Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 & Beyond [SCL6B] includes:
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 [VCL6]
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 7 [VCL7]
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 8 [VCL8]
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 9 [VCL9]
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 10 [VCLA]
• Capital Lease Maturities - Remaining Maturities [VCLR]

Unbilled Utility Revenue - Short-Term [SUUR] represents unbilled utility revenue receivables generally representing electricity or gas consumed by customers but not yet billed to them by utility companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Unbilled Utility Revenue - Short-Term [SUUR] Includes:
• Unbilled Utility Revenue - Short-Term [AUUR]

Land & Buildings - Net [SLSN] represents the net book value (after depreciation) of land and buildings where nor shown separately, excluding investment and development properties. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Land & Buildings - Net [SLSN] includes:
• Land & Buildings - Net [ALSN]
• Land/Improvements - Net [SNLI]
• Buildings - Net [SBGN]
• Leasehold Improvements - Net [SLEN]

Land/Improvements - Net [SNLI] represents the net book value (after depreciation) of land and improvements in land and also land not classified as either freehold or leasehold land. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Land/Improvements - Net [SNLI] Includes:
• Leasehold Improvements - Net [ALEN]

Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Net [SMEN] represents gross Plant, Machinery & Equipment less accumulated depreciation. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Net [SMEN] includes:
• Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Net [AMEN]

In absence of the above it includes:
• Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Gross [SMEC]
• Less Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDME]

Construction in Progress - Net [SCPN] represents the net book value (i.e. after deduction of amounts written off) of prepayments and tangible fixed assets in the course of construction. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Construction in Progress - Net [SCPN] includes:
• Construction in Progress - Net [ACPN]

Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Net [SOPN] represents the net book value (after depreciation and amortization) of other tangible fixed assets. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Net [SOPN] includes:
• Natural Resources/Biological Assets - Net [SBAN]
• Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Net [SMXN]
• Utility Plant - Net [SUPN]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Net [AOPN]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Contra Item - Net [ACNP] (deducted)

Utility Plant - Net [SUPN] represents net book value (after depreciation) of Utility Plant. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Utility Plant - Net [SUPN] Includes:
• Utility Plant - Net [AUPN]

Utility Plant - Gross [SUTP] represents gross book value of fixed assets employed by utility companies in the production of the utility, such as electric plants, distribution facilities of electricity, gas or water, etc. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Utility Plant - Gross [SUTP] includes:
• Utility Plant - Gross [AUTP]

provider_title: Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDPZ] refers to accumulated depreciation and impairment of other tangible fixed assets. Applicable to Industrial companies.
provider_description:
Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDPZ] refers to accumulated depreciation and impairment of other tangible fixed assets. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDPZ] includes:
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Other - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ADOP]
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Contra Item - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ACPD] (deducted)
• Utility Plant - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SUPD]
• Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDMX]
• Natural Resources/Biological Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDBA]

Utility Plant - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SUPD] represents accumulated depreciation and impairment of utility plants. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Utility Plant - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SUPD] Includes:
• Utility Plant - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [AUPD]

Regulatory Liabilities - Long-Term [SRLN] represents long-term regulatory obligations reported by utility companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Regulatory Liabilities - Long-Term [SRLN] includes:
• Regulatory Liabilities - Long-Term [LREG]

provider_title: Property, Plant & Equipment excluding Utility Plant - Net [SPPEU]
provider_description:
Property, Plant & Equipment excluding Utility Plant - Net [SPPEU] represents the net book value of all property/plant and equipment, less the net book value (after depreciation) of Utility Plant. Applicable to all Industries.
Property, Plant & Equipment excluding Utility Plant - Net [SPPEU] Includes:
• Property, Plant & Equipment - Net - Total [SPPE]
• Utility Plant - Net [SUPN] (deducted)

Receivables - Other [SORT] represents other receivables or a combined value of debtors. Applicable to all industries.
Receivables - Other [SORT] includes:
For Industries, Property & Investment:
• Loan/Notes Receivables - Gross [ALRF]
• Islamic Receivables - Short-Term [ISRC]
• Receivables - Other - Net [AORC]
• Receivables - Other - Gross [AONR]
• Accounts Receivable & Others - Net - Short-Term [XOLR]
• Loans/Notes Receivables - Gross - Long-Term [ALNG]
• Loans/Notes Receivables - Net - Long-Term [ALNN]
• Finance Lease Receivables - Net - Long-Term [ALFL]
• Islamic Receivables - Long-Term [ISRL]
• Receivables - Other - Gross - Long-Term [ALOG]
• Receivables - Other - Net - Long-Term [ALON]
• Accrued Income - Short-Term [AAIC]
• Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Net - Long-Term [ALRN]
• Loans/Notes Receivables - Net [ACLR]
• Contract Assets - Long-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [ACAL]
• Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [ACAS]

Bank companies additionally includes:
• Receivables - Other - Net [AORC]
• Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [ACAS]
• Contract Assets - Long-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [ACAL]
• Receivables - Other - Net - Long-Term [ALON] 

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Receivables - Other - Net [AORC]
• Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [ACAS]
• Contract Assets - Long-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & •Progress Billings [ACAL]
• Receivables - Other - Net - Long-Term [ALON]
• Interest Receivables [AIRC]
• Murabaha Receivables [IMRL]
• Istisna Receivables [ISTL]
• Musharaka Financing - Receivables [IMSL]
• Mudaraba Financing - Receivables [IMDL]
• Ijara Financing [IIJL]
• Wakala Receivables [IWKL]
• Other Islamic Receivables [IOIL]
• Islamic Financing Assets - Total [ISFC]
• Provision for Islamic Financing Assets [IPIF]

Investments - Other - Total [STIO] represents investments other than equity in affiliates, investment securities and investment properties. Applicable to all Industries.
Investments - Other - Total [STIO] Includes:
• Investments - Other [AOIT]

Minority Interest - Non-Equity [SNMI] represents non-controlling interests reported within liabilities. Minority/non-controlling interest is an accumulated interest for minority shareholders in subsidiaries that are less than 100 percent owned by the reporting parent company. Applicable to all Industries.
Minority Interest - Non-Equity [SNMI] includes:   
• Minority Interest - Non-Equity [LNMI]

Limited Partner [SLPD] represents capital provided by limited partners. This is the equivalent of common stock in stockholding companies. Although a company with limited partners may have general partners as well, the economic interests of limited partners are identical to those of stockholders. Applicable to all Industries.
Limited Partner [SLPD] includes:
• Limited Partner [QLPD]

provider_title: Cash in Hand & with Banks - Total [SCSH]
provider_description:
Cash in Hand & with Banks - Total [SCSH] represents cash on hand, balances on demand deposits and near-term savings and time deposits. These should be readily available for use and must be free from any contractual restrictions that limit their use in satisfying debts and other operational cash needs. Applicable to all Industries. 
Cash in Hand & with Banks - Total [SCSH] includes:
• Cash in Hand & with Banks [ACSH]
• Cash - Negative [ANCH]

provider_title: Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCSS]
provider_description:
Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCSS] represents total accumulated impairment or amortization of software. It includes impairment of software costs reported under intangible assets. Applicable to Industrial and Banks.
Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCSS] includes:
• Computer Software - Intangible Assets - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ACSA]

provider_title: Contract Liabilities - Short-Term - Advance Consideration & Progress Billings in Excess of Unbilled Revenue [SCLS]
provider_description:
Contract Liabilities - Short-Term - Advance Consideration & Progress Billings in Excess of Unbilled Revenue [SCLS] represents advance consideration received or due before the company transfers goods or services to the customer. Applicable to all Industries.
Contract Liabilities - Short-Term - Advance Consideration & Progress Billings in Excess of Unbilled Revenue [SCLS] includes:
• Contract Liabilities - Short-Term - Advance Consideration & Progress Billings in Excess of Unbilled Revenue [LCLS].
