provider_title: Investment Securities - Other [SSCO] - Debt securities issued by companies and institutions other than central or local government organizations. Excludes trading investments, bills of exchange and federal agency securities, if shown separately. Applicable to Insurance and Banks.
provider_description:
Investment Securities - Other [SSCO] - Debt securities issued by companies and institutions other than central or local government organizations. Excludes trading investments, bills of exchange and federal agency securities, if shown separately. Applicable to Insurance and Banks.
Investment Securities - Other [SSCO] includes:  
• Investment Securities - Other [AODS]

Inventories - Long-Term [SNIN] represents tangible items or merchandise net of advances and obsolescence acquired for either resale directly or included in the production of finished goods manufactured for sale, in the normal course of operation. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Inventories - Long-Term [SNIN] includes:
• Inventories - Long-Term [ANIN]

Deferred Costs - Short-Term [SDCC] represents prepaid expenses other than for operations including costs of fuel reported by utility companies. Such expenses may be deferred and amortized in later years. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Deferred Costs - Short-Term [SDCC] includes:
• Deferred Costs - Short-Term [ADFC]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Deferred Fuel Costs - Short-Term [ACDF]

provider_title: Receivables from Customers, Brokers & Clearing Organizations [SRRO]
provider_description:
Receivables from Customers, Brokers & Clearing Organizations [SRRO] represents the total value of receivables from subsidiaries, affiliates, associates, joint ventures or other companies forming the same capital group, after provisions for doubtful accounts. Applicable to Other Financial companies.
Receivables from Customers, Brokers & Clearing Organizations [SRRO] includes:
• Receivables - Related Parties - Gross [ARGR]
• Provision - Receivables - Related Parties [APDE] (deducted)
• Receivables - Related Parties - Net [ACGR]

provider_title: Inventories - Cost in excess of Billings [SICD]
provider_description:
Inventories - Cost in excess of Billings [SICD] represents uncompleted contracts stated at cost. Includes contract work in progress, long-term contract work in progress and construction costs included as stocks in current assets. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. Inventories - Cost in Excess of Billings [SICD] includes: 
• Inventories - Cost in excess of Billings [AICD]

provider_title: Provision - Doubtful Accounts [SPDT] - A combination of provisions for doubtful receivables. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Provision - Doubtful Accounts [SPDT] - A combination of provisions for doubtful receivables. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Provision - Doubtful Accounts [SPDT] includes: 
• Provision - Doubtful Accounts [APDB]
• Provision - Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade [APDA]

Provision - Doubtful Accounts - Total [STPT] represents the total value of all provisions for doubtful receivables. Applicable to Investment, Financial, Property and Industrial companies.
Provision - Doubtful Accounts - Total [STPT] includes:
• Provision - Loan/Notes Receivables [APNR]
• Provision - Receivables - Other [APOR]
• Provision - Doubtful Accounts [APDB]
• Provision - Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade [APDA]

Industrial, Property and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Provision - Doubtful Accounts - Long-Term [ALPT]
• Provision - Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Long-Term [ATPD]

provider_title: Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDME]
provider_description:
Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDME] represents accumulated depreciation of plant and machinery, transportation equipment as well as computer equipment and software. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Plant, Machinery & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDME] includes:
• Transportation Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDTE]
• Computer Software & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDSE]

provider_title: Computer Software & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDSE] - Accumulated depreciation and impairment that relates to the reduction in the useful economic life of computer equipment and software. Applicable to Industrial companies.
provider_description:
Computer Software & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDSE] - Accumulated depreciation and impairment that relates to the reduction in the useful economic life of computer equipment and software. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Computer Software & Equipment - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDSE] Includes:
• Computer Software & Equipment - Tangible Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ADSE]

provider_title: Construction in Progress - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDCP]
provider_description:
Construction in Progress - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDCP] represents Accumulated write offs and depreciation of capital work in progress and other tangible fixed assets in course of construction. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Construction in Progress - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDCP] includes:
• Construction in Progress - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ADCP]

provider_title: Trade Accounts Payable - Long-Term [SLTL] - Non-current portion of amounts payable/owed to creditors or suppliers for materials and merchandise acquired or for services provided within the normal operations of the business. This applies to differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Trade Accounts Payable - Long-Term [SLTL] - Non-current portion of amounts payable/owed to creditors or suppliers for materials and merchandise acquired or for services provided within the normal operations of the business. This applies to differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Trade Accounts Payable - Long-Term [SLTL] includes:
• Trade Payables - Long-Term [LLTP]

provider_title: Common Share Capital including Additional Paid in Capital - Total [SCPT]
provider_description:
Common Share Capital including Additional Paid in Capital - Total [SCPT] represents the combined value of common stock and additional paid in capital. Applicable to all Industries.
Common Share Capital including Additional Paid in Capital - Total [SCPT] includes:
• Common Share Capital including Additional Paid in Capital - Total [QCAT]

Investments including Loans - Total [STIL] represents total of trading, term, property & other investments and Loans. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Investments including Loans - Total [STIL] includes:
• Investment Securities - Available for Sale, Held to Maturity & Held for Trading - Total[STIS]
• Investment Property[SVPT]
• Investments - Other - Total[STIO]
• Loans - Mortgage, Policy & Other[STLN]

provider_title: Separate & Variable Account - Assets [SSVA] - Assets of contra accounts for transactions on segregated funds. Segregated funds are established for an insurance company to manage certain investment assets on behalf of its clients. In managing such segregated funds, income from the funds is directly transferred to the clients and the insurance company earns commissions on managing such funds for customers. Applicable to Insurance.
provider_description:
Separate & Variable Account - Assets [SSVA] - Assets of contra accounts for transactions on segregated funds. Segregated funds are established for an insurance company to manage certain investment assets on behalf of its clients. In managing such segregated funds, income from the funds is directly transferred to the clients and the insurance company earns commissions on managing such funds for customers. Applicable to Insurance.
Separate & Variable Account - Assets [SSVA] includes:
• Separate & Variable Account/Linked Assets [ASAC]

Insurance Reserves - Total [SRVT] represents  Short-term and long-term insurance reserves , Reinsurance refunds,  Policyholder fund liabilities  and Other insurance reserves. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Insurance Reserves - Total [SRVT] Includes:
• Benefit & Loss Reserves - Gross [SBLR]
• Unearned Premiums - Gross [SUPR]
• Policy & Contract Claims - Gross [SPLR]
• Policyholders' Funds [SPHF]
• Insurance Reserves - Other - Gross - Total [SOIR]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes:
• Insurance Reserves - Total [XINR]
• Investment Contracts - Technical Liabilities [LINV]
• Insurance Contracts - Technical Liabilities [LINS]

Benefit & Loss Reserves - Gross [SBLR] represents all reserves for refunds and policy benefits on insurance policies related to general insurance including changes in long-term technical/underwriting provision for non-life insurance claims as well as provisions made by an insurer to cover liabilities in connection with long-term insurance contracts. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Benefit & Loss Reserves - Gross [SBLR] includes:  
• Benefit & Loss Reserves – Non-Life, Gross [SLBLL]  
• Benefit & Loss Reserves - Non-Life - Gross [SBLN]
• Benefit & Loss/Technical Risk Reserves [LBLR]

Policyholders' Funds [SPHF] represent liabilities/funds directly related to the writing of policies by insurance companies and includes funds due to policyholders, unpaid policy dividends, cumulative investment contract gains not yet distributed to policyholders, retrospective funds, or cumulative clients' deposits and accrued interest on them. This item can be reported both as a liability and as part of the equity. Only collect the portion reported as a liability. Applicable to Insurance.
Policyholders' Funds [SPHF] includes:
• Policyholders' Funds [LPHF]

Payable - Reinsurance & Brokers/Agents [SPRB] represents the balances owed to reinsurers, brokers and agents. Includes ceded premiums payable to reinsurers. Excludes premiums ceded as a deduction of insurance reserves. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Payable - Reinsurance & Brokers/Agents [SPRB] includes: 
• Payable - Insurance & Reinsurance [LPRB]

Non-Reserve Liabilities [SNRLB] represents sum of total liabilities and insurance reserves. Applicable to Insurance.
Non-Reserve Liabilities [SNRLB] includes:
• Total Liabilities [STLB]
• Insurance Reserves - Total [SRVT]

provider_title: Book Value excluding Accumulated Comprehensive Income [STCSEAC]
provider_description: Book Value excluding Accumulated Comprehensive Income [STCSEAC] represents the sum of Shareholders Equity - Common [STCSE] excluding all accumulated comprehensive income (Comprehensive Income - Accumulated - Total [SACI]). Applicable to Insurance companies. (Used for analytics)

Benefit & Claims Reserves - Gross [SBPLR] represents all reserves, provisions set apart for future claims as at the end of the period for refunds and policy benefits on insurance policies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Benefit & Claims Reserves - Gross [SBPLR] includes:
• Benefit & Loss Reserves - Gross [SBLR]
• Policy & Contract Claims - Gross [SPLR] (Used for analytics)

Reinsurance Liabilities [SRIL] represents payables by an insurance company to reinsurers. 
Reinsurance Liabilities [SRIL] includes:
• Reinsurance Deposits [LRID]
• Payable - Insurance & Reinsurance [LRPB]

Insurance Related Assets - Bank [SIAB] represents any assets related to the insurance activities of a company for which banking operations generate the majority of income. Applicable to Banks.
Insurance Related Assets - Bank [SIAB] includes: 
• Insurance Related Assets - Bank [AINR]

provider_title: Junior Subordinated Debentures & Notes Payable - Trust Account [SPTA] is an unsecured loan, which has no collateral securities. Applicable to Banks.
provider_description:
Junior Subordinated Debentures & Notes Payable - Trust Account [SPTA] is an unsecured loan, which has no collateral securities. Applicable to Banks.
Junior Subordinated Debentures & Notes Payable - Trust Account [SPTA] includes:
• Junior Subordinated Debentures & Notes Payable to Trust Preferred Subsidiaries [LNTP]
• Junior Subordinated Debentures & Notes Payable to Trust Preferred Subsidiaries - Long-Term & Short-Term [LNTT]

Comprehensive Income - Unearned Compensation [SUCC] represents accumulated unearned deferred compensation disclosed as comprehensive income. Applicable to all industries.
Comprehensive Income - Unearned Compensation [SUCC] includes:
• Comprehensive Income - Unearned Compensation [QUEC]

provider_title: Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 [SCL6]
provider_description:
Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 [SCL6] represents the amount of capital lease payments due in year 6 following the balance sheet period end date. These values are non-cumulative. If the company reports capital lease payments in ranges instead of individual years, then the value is updated to the highest year in the range. Applicable to all industries.
Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 [SCL6] includes:
• Capital Lease Maturities - Due in Year 6 [VCL6]

provider_title: Common Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific - Current [SLCOI]
provider_description:
Common Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific - Current [SLCOI] represents the number of common shares outstanding (per specific share issue, instrument level - excludes treasury shares). Applicable to all Industries.
Common Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific - Current [SLCOI] includes:
• Common Shares - Outstanding - Issue Specific - Current [XLCOI]

Regulatory Assets - Short-Term [SRAC] represents regulatory assets reported within current assets generally reported for Utility companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Regulatory Assets - Short-Term [SRAC] includes: 
• Regulatory Assets - Short-Term [ARAC]

provider_title: Provisions - Short-Term [SCPV] refers to all provisions reported under the current liability section except provision for income taxes, deferred taxes. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Provisions - Short-Term [SCPV] refers to all provisions reported under the current liability section except provision for income taxes, deferred taxes. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Provisions - Short-Term [SCPV] includes:
• Provisions - Short-Term [LCPV]

Regulatory Liability - Short-Term [SRLS] represents short-term regulatory obligations reported by utility companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Regulatory Liability - Short-Term [SRLS] includes:
• Regulatory Liability - Short-Term [LCRL]

provider_title: Finance Lease Receivables - Long-Term [SFLT] - Net long-term receivables from lease financing operations, after the provision for loan losses. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Finance Lease Receivables - Long-Term [SFLT] - Net long-term receivables from lease financing operations, after the provision for loan losses. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Finance Lease Receivables - Long-Term [SFLT] includes:
• Finance Lease Receivables - Net - Long-Term [ALFL]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Finance Lease Receivables - Long-Term - Gross [ALFR]
• Provision - Finance Lease Receivables - Long-Term [ALFP] (deducted)
• Unearned Income - Finance Lease - Long-Term [AUNI]

Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [SNPY] represents prepaid expenses disclosed outside current assets and due after one year. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [SNPY] includes:
• Prepaid Expenses - Long-Term [ANPY]

Preferred Shares - Authorized - Issue Specific [STPAI] represents the number of preferred shares authorized for issuance in addition to the current stock (per specific share issues - instrument level). Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Shares - Authorized - Issue Specific [STPAI] includes:
• Preferred Shares - Authorized - Issue Specific [XTPAI]

Unearned Income - Customers [SUIN] represents unearned interest or Islamic financing income, where the nominal value of a loan (or an Islamic financing contract) includes prepaid interest/Islamic income, and a portion of the prepaid income is not yet earned in the income statement at the end of a fiscal period. Applicable to Bank and Other Financial companies.
Unearned Income - Customers [SUIN] includes: 
• Unearned Income - Customers [AUIN]
• Unearned Income - Islamic Financing Assets [IUIN]

provider_title: Mortgage Backed Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SMBH]
provider_description:
Mortgage Backed Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SMBH] represents securities backed by a mortgage or a collection of mortgages, guaranteed as to interest and principal. The code is used for securities held to maturity, or for securities not specified as held for sale, maturity or trading. Applicable to Banks.
Mortgage Backed Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SMBH] Includes:
• Mortgage Backed Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [AMBH]
• Mortgage Backed Securities - Available for Sale [ASMB]

provider_title: Government Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SGOH]
provider_description:
Government Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SGOH] represents investments in debt securities issued by the state treasury (the central or federal government).   The code is used for securities held to maturity, securities held for sale, or for securities not specified as held for sale, maturity or trading. Applicable to Bank and Investment Trust companies.
Government Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [SGOH] includes:
• Local Government Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [ALGS]
• Government Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [AGVS]

Banks additionally includes:
• Federal Agency Securities - Held to Maturity/Undisclosed [AFED]
• Local Government Securities - Available for Sale [ASLG]
• Government Securities - Available for Sale [ASGV]
• Federal Agency Securities - Available for Sale [ASFA]

provider_title: Core Deposits - Net [SDCN] are deposits owned by a bank’s permanent client base, typically sourced from its branches, as opposed to funds received from deposit brokers. It
provider_description:
Core Deposits - Net [SDCN] are deposits owned by a bank’s permanent client base, typically sourced from its branches, as opposed to funds received from deposit brokers. It represents the premium that a bank paid for acquiring another institution’s core deposits. Applicable to Banks.
Core Deposits - Net [SDCN] Includes:
• Core Deposits - Net [ACDN]

provider_title: Core Deposit - Gross [SCDG] are deposits owned by a bank’s permanent client base, typically sourced from its branches, as opposed to funds received from deposit brokers. Applicable to Banks.
provider_description:
Core Deposit - Gross [SCDG] are deposits owned by a bank’s permanent client base, typically sourced from its branches, as opposed to funds received from deposit brokers. Applicable to Banks.
Core Deposit - Gross [SCDG] Includes:
• Core Deposit - Gross [ACDG]

provider_title: Core Deposits - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCDA] - Core deposits are deposits owned by a bank’s permanent client base, typically sourced from its branches, as opposed to funds received from deposit brokers. Applicable to Banks.
provider_description:
Core Deposits - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCDA] - Core deposits are deposits owned by a bank’s permanent client base, typically sourced from its branches, as opposed to funds received from deposit brokers. Applicable to Banks.
Core Deposits - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [SCDA] Includes:
• Core Deposits - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ACDA]

Preferred Stock - Issued for ESOP [QEDQ] represents the total number of preferred shares issued to the employee stock option plan. This field would include all the shares that are fully paid for as well as those covered by a pledge made by the company to insure a loan incurred by the employee stock option plan (ESOP) for the purchase of preferred shares for to the issuance of preferred stock under the employees stock option plan. Applicable to all Industries.
Preferred Stock - Issued for ESOP [QEDQ] includes:
• Preferred Stock - Issued for ESOP [QEDG]

Customer Advances - Total [SCAT] represents all advances received from customers, for goods or services expected to be delivered both current and non-current. This item is applicable to non-differentiated balance sheet. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Customer Advances - Total [SCAT] includes:
• Customer Advances - Short-Term [LCAC]
• Customer Advances - Long-Term [LCAL]

Investment Property - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SIPD] represents accumulated depreciation and impairment of investment property. Investment property is a property (land or a building, or part of a building or both) held to earn rentals or for capital appreciation purposes. Applicable to all Industries.
Property - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SIPD] includes:
• Investment Property - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ADID]

Investment Property - Gross [SDIC] represents gross Investment property. Applicable to all Industries.
Investment Property - Gross [SDIC] includes:
• Investment Property - Gross [ADIC]

In the presence of Investment Property - Gross [ADIC] or Investment Property - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ADID], it includes:
• Investment Property - Net [AVPN].

provider_title: Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Net [STAN]
provider_description:
Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Net [STAN] represents the tenant relationships and acquired in place leases, net value after deduction of accumulated amortization. Applicable to Property companies.
Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Net [STAN] Includes:
• Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Net [ATRN]
• Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Gross [ATRG]
• Tenant Relationships & Acquired in Place Leases - Accumulated Amortization & Impairment [ATRA] (Deducted).

provider_title: Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 7 [SLD7] reflects the amount of long-term debt maturing in year seven from the balance sheet period end date. These values are non-cumulative. If the company reports long term debt maturities in ranges instead of individual years, then the value is updated to the highest year in the range. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 7 [SLD7] reflects the amount of long-term debt maturing in year seven from the balance sheet period end date. These values are non-cumulative. If the company reports long term debt maturities in ranges instead of individual years, then the value is updated to the highest year in the range. Applicable to all Industries.
Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 7 [SLD7] includes:
• Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 7 [VLD7]

provider_title: Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 9 [SLD9] reflects the amount of long-term debt maturing in year nine from the balance sheet period end date. These values are non-cumulative. If the company reports long term debt maturities in ranges instead of individual years, then the value is updated to the highest year in the range. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 9 [SLD9] reflects the amount of long-term debt maturing in year nine from the balance sheet period end date. These values are non-cumulative. If the company reports long term debt maturities in ranges instead of individual years, then the value is updated to the highest year in the range. Applicable to all Industries.
Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 9 [SLD9] includes:
• Debt - Long-Term - Maturities - Year 9 [VLD9]

provider_title: Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term [SMRS]
provider_description:
Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term [SMRS] represents other mandatory redeemable equity securities. Applicable to all Industries
Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term [SMRS] Includes:
• Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term [LMRS]
• Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term & Short-Term [LMRT]
• Other Mandatorily Redeemable Equity Instruments - Long-Term - Financial Sector [LMRSF]

Inventories - Gas in Storage [SIGS] represents gas in storage held as inventory for gas utility companies. Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Inventories - Gas in Storage [SIGS] includes: 
• Inventories - Gas in Storage [AGIS]

provider_title: Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Net [SMXN] - Net book value (after depreciation and impairment) of non-renewable natural resources, mineral deposits and extraction or mining rights. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Net [SMXN] - Net book value (after depreciation and impairment) of non-renewable natural resources, mineral deposits and extraction or mining rights. Applicable to all Industries.
Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Net [SMXN] includes:
• Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Net [AMIN]

provider_title: Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDMX] - Accumulated depreciation and impairment of non-renewable natural resources, mineral deposits and extraction or mining rights. The item is reported by mining companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
provider_description:
Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDMX] - Accumulated depreciation and impairment of non-renewable natural resources, mineral deposits and extraction or mining rights. The item is reported by mining companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [SDMX] Includes:
• Mining/Exploration Specific Assets - Accumulated Depreciation & Impairment [ADMI]

provider_title: Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [SSCA]
provider_description:
Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [SSCA] represents the entity’s right to payment of goods and services which has been transferred to the customer and the payment of which is conditional on something other than the passage of time and hence unbilled. Applicable to all Industries.
Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [SSCA] includes:
• Contract Assets - Short-Term - Unbilled Revenue in Excess of Advance Consideration & Progress Billings [ACAS]

Provisions - Restructuring - Long-Term [SRSR] represents long term provision for future restructuring and reorganisation costs, including liabilities for the sale, closure and termination of businesses. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Provisions - Restructuring - Long-Term [SRSR] includes:
• Provisions - Restructuring - Long-Term [LRSR]

Receivables - Total [SRET] represent the Total of Receivable from Insurance Receivable, Premium Receivable, Income Tax Receivable, Interest Receivable, Reinsurance Receivable and any other Receivable. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Receivables - Total [SRET] Includes:
• Insurance Premium Receivables [SIPR]
• Income Tax - Receivables [SITX]
• Receivables - Other [SORT]

Insurance Premium Receivables [SIPR] represents receivables from policyholders, agencies, and other operating parties in insurance companies net of impairment. Applicable to Insurance.
Insurance Premium Receivables [SIPR] Includes:
• Insurance Receivables - Net [APRE]
• Insurance Receivables - Gross [AIRG]
• Provision - Insurance Receivables [APIR] (deducted)
• Premiums Receivables from Policyholders/agents - Net [APRR]
• Premiums Receivables from Policyholders/agents - Gross [APRG]
• Provision - Insurance Premium Receivables from Policyholders/agents [APPR] (deducted)
• Provision - Insurance Premium & Insurance Receivables - Total [APIT] (deducted)
• Reinsurance Receivables, Net [ARRN]
• Reinsurance Receivables, Gross [ARRG]
• Provision - Reinsurance Receivables [ARPR] (deducted)

provider_title: Investment Securities - Fixed Income [SFIR] refers to fixed income security assets held for investment, including treasury bills, bonds and notes. Applicable to Insurance and Investment Trust companies.
provider_description:
Investment Securities - Fixed Income [SFIR] refers to fixed income security assets held for investment, including treasury bills, bonds and notes. Applicable to Insurance and Investment Trust companies.
Investment Securities - Fixed Income [SFIR] includes:
• Investment Securities - Fixed Income [AIFS]

Investment Securities - Equity [SEQS] represents the sum of Short term & Long-term equity securities. Includes common and preferred shares. Includes common and preferred shares. Applicable to Insurance and Investment Trust companies.
Investment Securities - Equity [SEQS] includes:
• Investment Securities - Equity [AEQS]

Loans - Mortgage, Policy & Other [STLN] represents a sum of real estate mortgage loans and other insurance loans. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Loans - Mortgage, Policy & Other [STLN] includes:
• Loans - Mortgage/Real Estate [SREL]
• Policy Loans [SPOL]
• Loans - Other [SOLN]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes 
• Loans [ATLN]

Policy Loans [SPOL] represents loans made by an insurance company to its policyholders where the cash value of the underlying insurance policy is used as the collateral. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Policy Loans [SPOL] includes:
• Policy Loans [APOL]

Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [SDPC] represents varying costs related to the acquisition of insurance contracts that are deferred and amortized over the respective policy terms. Applicable to Insurance.
Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [SDPC] includes:
• Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [ADPA]

Accrued Investment Income [SAII] represents investment income accrued, but not yet expensed in the income statement. Applicable to Insurance and Investment Trust companies.
Accrued Investment Income [SAII] includes:
• Accrued Investment Income [AAII]

Pension Benefits - Overfunded - Total [SPBT] represents the total value of overfunded pension benefits. It include the assets in a pension plan that serves as an investment for participating employees. Applicable to all industries.
Pension Benefits - Overfunded - Total [SPBT] includes:
• Pension Benefits - Overfunded - Long-Term & Short-Term [APBT]  
• LT Pension Assets [APBO]

Separate & Variable Account - Liabilities [SSAC] represents the liabilities of contra accounts for transactions on segregated funds. Segregated funds are established for an insurance company to manage certain investment assets on behalf of its clients. Insurance companies earn fees by managing such segregated funds. Pension fund management or annuity-style savings accounts offered by life insurance companies are examples of services through which insurance companies earn these fees. Applicable to Insurance.
Separate & Variable Account - Liabilities [SSAC] includes:
• Separate & Variable Account/Linked Liabilities [LSAC]

Equity Securities & Real Estate [SESRE] represents the Overview of the publicly traded real estate securities, focusing on equity real estate investment trusts (REITs) and their valuation. Applicable to Insurance & Other Financials.
Equity Securities & Real Estate [SESRE] includes:
• Investment Property [SVPT]
• Investment Property - Net [SNVP]

provider_title: Investment in Equity, Real Estate & Mortgages [SEQPL]
provider_description:
Investment in Equity, Real Estate & Mortgages [SEQPL] represents the total value of all investments in equity, real estate and mortgages both short term and long term. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Investment in Equity, Real Estate & Mortgages [SEQPL]  includes:
• Investment Securities - Equity [SEQS]
• Investment Property [SVPT]
• Loans - Mortgage/Real Estate [SREL] (Used for analytics)

provider_title: Accounts & Notes Receivable - Trade - Net - Long-Term [SLAN]
provider_description:

provider_description:
Revolving Line of Credit - Outstanding [SRLRS] is an arrangement made between a company and a bank to borrow money on a short-term basis to meet temporary cash shortfalls. Line of credits are specifically designed to help businesses finance short-term working capital needs which they can use day-to-day according to their need for cash. A line of credit offers flexibility because interest is only paid on credit when its accessed. Revolving line of credit has certain per-approved limit as agreed under the Credit Agreement and can be borrowed any number of times up to the credit limits. Revolving line of credit- outstanding is the short-term loan amount outstanding as on the date of Balance sheet. It represents a portion of short-term debt. Applicable to all industries.
Revolving Line of Credit - Outstanding [SRLRS] includes:
• Revolving Line of Credit - Outstanding [VRLR]

provider_title: Revolving Line of Credit - Total Principal Amount [STLCS]
provider_description:
Revolving Line of Credit - Total Principal Amount [STLCS] represents the pre-approved credit limit set on the revolving line of credit loan. It is the maximum outstanding debt allowed on the credit account which the borrower can borrow within a certain timeframe. Total borrowing limitation amount is collected, if a company has multiple lines of credits, the sum of the Total credit limit is collected. Applicable to all industries.
Revolving Line of Credit - Total Principal Amount [STLCS] includes:
• Revolving Line of Credit - Total Principal Amount [VTLC]

provider_title: Revolving Line of Credit - Unutilized/Unused Amount [SRACS]
provider_description:
Revolving Line of Credit - Unutilized/Unused Amount [SRACS] represents the unutilized or unused amount of credit balance available. Unused credit lines are "off-balance sheet" items because they have not yet been converted into assets and liabilities. Unused credit lines are disclosed in the footnotes of the document and indicates the readiness of the company to meet any financial requirements. This information is collected as-reported by the company. If there are multiple lines of credit, sum of each type of unused credit is collected. Applicable to all industries.
Revolving Line of Credit - Unutilized/Unused Amount [SRACS] includes:
• Revolving Line of Credit - Unutilized/Unused Amount [VRAC]

provider_description: Total Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets - Net (excl Goodwill) [SVIDN] represents the intangible assets that have indefinite useful lives which is based on the forecasts of the expected future cash flows attributable to the respective asset. Intangible assets determined to have indefinite useful lives are not amortized but are tested for impairment. Assets that may have indefinite lives include certain trade names, trademarks, and perpetual franchises. It reflects net value of all indefinite-lived intangible asets excluding Goodwill.

• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development in Cost of Revenues [EARC]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Cost of Revenues [EAUC]
• Cost of Revenues - Other [EOCG]

*These items are only included if we have Cost of goods items available.

Cost of Revenues - Unclassified [SCOU] represents the total cost of goods and services sold.
This is only populated if other components of Cost of Revenues - Total [SCGS] are available.
Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Cost of Revenues - Unclassified [SCOU] includes:
• Cost of Revenues[ECOR]

Amortization in Cost of Revenues [SACS] represents amortization of intangible assets included in cost of revenues. It is the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets included in cost of revenues. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment companies. 
Amortization in Cost of Revenues [SACS] includes:
• Premiums Earned & Other Income from Insurance - Bank - Total [EAMC]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAMX]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges in Cost of Revenues [EADC]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs in Cost of Revenues [EALC]
• Amortization of Computer Software in Cost of Revenues[EASC]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles in Cost of Revenues [EABC]
• Amortization & Impairment of Intangibles including Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAIC]
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development in Cost of Revenues [EARC]
• Amortization of Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAGC]

If Cost of sales is available, then it also includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill [EAMI]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EALR]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EAMO]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges [EAMD]
• Amortization of Goodwill [EAMA]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs [EAML]
• Amortization of Computer Software [EASW]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles [EAMB]

Gross Profit - Industrials/Property - Total [SGRP] represents the company's residual profit after selling a product or service and deducting the cost associated with its production and sale. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Gross Profit - Industrials/Property - Total [SGRP] includes:
• Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR]
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR] (Deducted)
In the absence of above, it includes:
• As Reported Gross Profit [XGRP]. 
Applicable to Industrial, Property, Other Financial and Investment Trust companies.

Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA] represents all costs of operating a business other than the costs of readying a product for sale. Applicable to all Industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Unclassified [SSGU]
Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS]
• Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SDES]
• Amortization of Intangibles in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SAMS]
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Research & Development Expense [SRAD]
• Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP]
• Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE]

Investment Trust companies additionally includes:
• Investment Management Fees [SIMF]

Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Unclassified [SSGU] represents all costs of operating a business other than the costs of readying a product for sale. Applicable to all Industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Unclassified [SSGU] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ESGA]

provider_title: Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS]
provider_description:
Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS] represents expenses paid to employees of a company in the form of salaries, wages, fees, benefits or any other form of compensation reported within the selling, general and administrative expenses. It includes expenses paid to employees in the form of the company’s shares when reported within SGA. This code is also used when the company presents the I/s ‘By Nature’ for Service Organization and Utility Companies. This field should also be used when the company reports labor expenses outside cogs, SGA or with in any other expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SLAS] includes:
• Management Remuneration [EMEN]
• Workers' Profits Participation & Welfare Funds [EWPF]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ELAS]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ESCS]

Research & Development Expense [SRAD] represents expenses for research and development of new products and services by a company in order to obtain a competitive advantage.  It represents the portion expensed during the year, and excludes the portion capitalized to tangible or intangible assets. Capitalization of research and development expenditure is rare for US companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Expense [SRAD] includes:
• Research & Development Expense [ERAD]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized [ECRD] (deducted)
• Rental Expenses in Research & Development Expense [ERRD]
• Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total [ETRD]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]
• Engineering Expenses [EENX]
• Research & Development Expense in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ERDS]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Research & Development [ELRD]
• Research & Development in Cost of Revenue [ERDC]
• Research & Development Expense - Gross (before Government Grants)

provider_title: Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO]
provider_description:
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO] represents selling, general and administrative costs, not related to labor, research and development,  depreciation/amortization/impairment in SGA expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other - Total [SSGO] includes:
• Advertising Expense [SADE]
• Property & Other Taxes [SPTX]
• Rental Expense [SRXP]
• Occupancy Expense - Other [SOEO]
• Pre-Opening Expenses [SPOE] (applicable only Industrial)
• Provision for Doubtful Accounts & Write-off [SPDW]  (Applicable only Industrial)
• Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [SEOE]

In the absence of the breakdown above for Industrial companies, it includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other [ESGO].

In the absence of the breakdown above for Property, Bank ,Investment Trust, Other Financial companies, it includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other [ESGO] 
• Research & Development Expense [ERAD]
• Research & Development Expense in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ERDS]
• Rental Expenses in Research & Development Expense [ERRD]
• Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total [ETRD]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized [ECRD]
• Research & Development in Cost of Revenue [ERDC]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]
• Research & Development Expense - Gross (before Government Grants) [ERBG]
• Bad Debt Written-Off/Provision [EBDW]

Insurance:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Other [ESGO]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]
• Bad Debt Written-Off/Provision [EBDW]
• Provision for Loan Losses [ELOP]
• Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [EOEO]

Provision for Doubtful Accounts & Write-off [SPDW] represents the provision for possible uncollectable accounts receivable. This item may also be referred to as the allowance for doubtful accounts. It includes recovery of bad debt provisions/bad debt written off and the write-off of doubtful receivables. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Provision for Doubtful Accounts & Write-off [SPDW] includes:
• Bad Debt Written-Off/Provision [EBDW]

Other Operating Expense/(Income) - Net [SOIE] represents net operating expenses/income which are either not specified as being for plant hire, fixed asset rentals, depreciation/amortization, marketing, duties/taxes, exchange losses, research/development or exploration or which may represent a combination of some or all of these items. This item is adjusted by rounding adjustments. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Operating Income/Expense - Net [SOIE] includes:
• Other Operating Income - Total [SOOI] (deducted)
• Other Operating Expense [SOOE]
• Operating Provisions [SOPV]
• Non-Recurring Adjustments - Operating [SNRO] (deducted)
• Supplementary Adjustments - Operating [SSPO] (deducted)

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Provision for Decommissioning Fund & Environmental Obligations [SPDF]

Banks additionally includes:
• Contributions & Transfer to Bank Guarantee Fund [SBGF]

Supplementary Adjustments - Operating - Decrease/(Increase) [SSPO] represents targeted data items disclosed by companies in the notes to the accounts but cannot be assigned to any item presented within the Income Statement. These items are deemed to be part of operating income/expenses and adjusted in here to ensure the item can be shown in its respective position and the statement is still balancing. Applicable to all Industries.

Operating Expenses - Total [SOET] represents total operating expense as reported by the company. This item needs to be captured in a cost-by-nature or single-step income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Operating Expenses - Total [SOET] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA]
• Other Operating Expense/Income - Net [SOIE]

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total [STIC]
• Dividends to Policy Holders [SDPH]
• Fees & Commissions Expense [SCFE]
• Underwriting Expenses [SUWE]
• Expenses from Banking Operations - Insurance [SEBO]

Banks additionally includes:
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]

Investment additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]
• Operating Expenses - Revenue Account [SOER]
• Operating Expenses - Capital Account [SOEC]

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Operating Expenses - Total [XTOE]
• Total Expenses [XEXP]
• Bank Operating Expenses - Total [XBOE]

Operating Profit before Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) [SOPR] represents the as reported total operating income (revenues and operating income less operating costs) from a company’s primary/core operations, before non-recurring and non-operating items. Applicable to all industries.
Operating Profit before Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) [SOPR] includes:
• Revenue from Business Activities - Total[STLR]
• Less: Operating Expenses - Total[SOET]

In the absence of the above breakdown it includes:
• Operating Profit/Income from Operations[XEBT]

Financing Income/(Expense) - Net - Total [SFIE] represents the total value of income and expenses related to financial operations. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies. 
Financing Income/(Expense) - Net - Total [SFIE] includes:
• Non-Interest Financial Income/Expense - Total [SNIF]
• Interest Expense - Net of Interest Income [SNII] (deducted)

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET] (deducted)

If the above accounts are not available, it will be the sum of the following items:
• Net Financing Income/Expense [XNFI]
• Financial Expense - Total [XTFE] (deducted)
• Financial Income - Total [XTFI]

Interest Expense - Net of (Interest Income) [SNII] represents net interest income and expenses when not shown separately. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies.
Interest Expense - Net of (Interest Income) [SNII] includes:
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN]
• Interest Income - Non-Bank [SINI] (deducted)

Interest Income - Non-Bank [SINI] represents interest from investments together with any income received on short term lending. Interest received from advances, deposit accounts. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies.
Interest Income - Non-Bank [SINI] includes:
• Interest Income - Non-Bank [EIIN]
• Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities [EILL]
• Interest Expense/Income - Net [EINN] (if the value is positive)
• Financial Expense - Total [XTFE] ((in the absence of pure interest income and is an Income)
• Net Financing Income/Expense [XNFI] (in the absence of pure Interest expense and Financial Income and is an Income)
• Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Equity Portion (AFUDC) [EAFC] (additional for Industrial companies)

provider_title: Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [SFAS]
provider_description:
Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [SFAS] represents the Income or loss on sale of fixed assets (including investment properties). Applicable to all Industries.
Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [SFAS] includes:
• Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [EGFA]
• Sale of Investment Properties - Property - Gain/Loss [ESLP]
• Sale of Leased Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [SGLL]

Banks and Insurance additionally includes:
• Sale of Other Real Estate Owned - Gain/Loss [EORE]

Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense) - Total [SNEI] represents other net non-operating income or expenses. Applicable to all industries.
Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense) - Total [SNEI] includes:
• Non-Operating Rental Income [SRNI]
• Transfer to/from Untaxed Reserves [STRF]
• Trading Derivatives - Gain/Loss [SNDT]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/Loss [SNDE]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/Loss [SNDR]
• Non-Recurring Adjustments - Non-Operating [SNRN]
• Supplementary Adjustments - Non-Operating [SSPN]

In the absence of the above breakdown it includes:
• Other Non-Operating Income/Expense [EONO]

Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX] represents pre-tax profit without the effect of unusual and extraordinary income/expense. Applicable to all Industries.
Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX] includes:
• Operating Profit before Non-Recurring Income/Expense [SOPR]
• Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [SFAS]
• Equity Earnings - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA]
• Other Non-Operating Income/Expense - Total [SNEI]

Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Financing Income/Expense - Net - Total [SFIE]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [SIFX]
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN] (deducted)

Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN] represents the total value of non-recurring income or expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN] includes:
• Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Other - Total [SGLO]
• Sale of Assets - Non-recurring - Gain/Loss [SNRA]
• Costs Associated with IPOs & Mergers [SCAI] (Deducted)
• Debt Restructuring - Gain/Loss [SDRS]
• Compensation for Disaster - Pre-Tax [SDCX]
• Sale & Acquisition of Group Companies - Gain/Loss [SDSA]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Investment Property [SIPV]
• Other than Temporary Impairment Losses on Investments [SIMP] (Deducted)
• Impairment - Investment Property [SIIN] (Deducted)
• Impairment - Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets [SITI] (Deducted)
• Recognition of Negative Goodwill [SNGO]
• Early Extinguishment of Lease Related Debts - Gain/Loss [SERD]
• Restructuring Charges [SRST] (Deducted)
• Litigation Expenses/Settlements [SLIT] (Deducted)
• COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SCVT]
• Impairment - Financial Investments [SIVO] (Deducted)
• Impairment - Deferred Costs [SIDC] (Deducted)
• Fair Value Adjustments - Investment Property [SIPV]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Financial Investments [SFVI]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Other Assets [SFVO]

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [SDHN]
• Early Termination of Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [SDET]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/Loss [SDIE]
• Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [SDUA]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Research & Development - in Process [SRDW]
• Valuation of Inventory - Gain/(Loss) [SVAI]
• Fair Value Adjustments - Biological Assets [SFVB]
• Special Income - Total [XSPI]
• Special Expense - Total [XSPE]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Write-Off of Real Estate Held for Sale [SWRS] (Deducted)
• Property-Related Acquisition Expenses [SPAE] (Deducted)

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Exceptional Claims & Benefits Paid (Catastrophes) [SETR] (Deducted)

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Non-Recurring Income/Expense [ENRE].

provider_title: Sale & Acquisition of Group Companies - Gain/(Loss) [SDSA]
provider_description:
Sale & Acquisition of Group Companies - Gain/(Loss) [SDSA] represents gain/(Loss) on sale and acquisition of subsidiaries/associated companies but not forming part of discontinued operations. Applicable to all Industries.
Sale & Acquisition of Group Companies - Gain/(Loss) [SDSA] includes:
• Sale & Acquisition of Group Companies - Gain/Loss [SDSA]
• Acquisition Cost of Group Companies [EAQA] (deducted)

Income before Taxes [SIBT] represents as reported income/loss after all operating and non-operating income and expense before the deduction of income tax. Applicable to all industries.
Income before Taxes [SIBT] includes:
• Net Income before Tax [XIBT]
Include if the below items are reported after Pretax Income:
• Amortization of Goodwill [EAMA]
• Impairment - Goodwill [EIGO]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ELAS]
• Management Remuneration [EMEN]
• Workers' Profits Participation & Welfare Funds [EWPF]
• Property & Other Taxes [EPOT]

Exclude below items if reported as pretax items:
• Equity Earnings - Net of Tax [CEIA]
• Wealth Taxes [CTWT]
• Minority Interest - Continuing Operations [CMIN]
• Final Tax [FTAX]
• Research & Development Expense - Tax Credit [ERTC]

In the absence of Net Income before Tax [XIBT], it includes:
• Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX]
• Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SGLN]

Income Taxes [STAX] represents total income taxes for the period. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes [STAX] includes:
• Provision for Income Tax – Unclassified [SPAX]
• Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX]
• Income Taxes - Deferred [SDTR]
• Income Taxes - Other (by Type) [SOTX]
• Provision for Income Tax Expense- Unclassified [SPRX]

Investment companies additionally includes:
• Taxes on Capital Account [STCX]
• Taxes on Revenue Account [STRX]

In the absence of above, it includes:
Income Taxes - Total [XTAX]

provider_title: Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX] When a company reports its total current taxes without any delineation (no breakdown reported) between tax jurisdictions. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial Statements. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX] When a company reports its total current taxes without any delineation (no breakdown reported) between tax jurisdictions. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial Statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes for the Year - Current [SCTX] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID]
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF]
• Income Taxes - Other (KFAS/NLST) - Current [SCTO]

If the accounts above are not available, Income Taxes - Total - Current [VCTR] is taken.

provider_title: Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID] reflects the portion of a company’s current income tax provision attributable to its domestic and local tax jurisdiction. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID] reflects the portion of a company’s current income tax provision attributable to its domestic and local tax jurisdiction. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [SCID] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [VCTD]
• Income Taxes - Local - Current [VCTL]

provider_title: Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF] reflects the portion of a company’s current income tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF] reflects the portion of a company’s current income tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [SCIF] includes:
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [VCTF]

Income Taxes - Deferred [SDTR] represents a company's total deferred taxes reported without any delineation (no breakout) between tax jurisdictions, this amount is classified as Deferred Tax – Total (VDTR). This value is obtained from the notes of the financial Statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Deferred [SDTR] includes:   
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID]
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF]
• Income Taxes - Other - Deferred [SDTO]

If the accounts above are not available, Income Taxes - Total - Deferred [VDTR] is taken.

provider_title: Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID] reflects the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision attributable to its domestic and local tax jurisdiction. Applicable to all Industries. Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID] includes:
provider_description:
Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID] reflects the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision attributable to its domestic and local tax jurisdiction. Applicable to all Industries. Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [SDID] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [VDTD]
• Income Taxes - Local - Deferred [VDTL]

provider_title: Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF] reflects the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions. Deferred tax provisions are established to account for changes in deferred tax asset and liability accounts within a given period. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF] reflects the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions. Deferred tax provisions are established to account for changes in deferred tax asset and liability accounts within a given period. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [SDIF] includes:
• Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [VDTF]

Net Income after Tax [SIAT] represents the income/expense after all operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes, but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations and preferred dividends. Applicable to all Industries.
Net Income after Tax [SIAT] includes:
• Income before Taxes [SIBT]
• Income Taxes [STAX}

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Net Income after Tax [XIAT]

provider_title: Equity in Earnings/(Loss) of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA]
provider_description:
Equity in Earnings/(Loss) of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA] represents the share of earnings/losses that the company is entitled to from unconsolidated affiliated companies which has not been distributed as dividends. It includes the non-recurring part of profit/loss. Applicable to all Industries.
Equity in Earnings/(Loss) of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA] includes:
• Equity Earnings - Net of Tax [CEIA]
• Non-Recurring Portion of Equity Earnings [SNRE]

provider_title: Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO]
provider_description:
Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] represents a sum of the income/expense after all operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations and preferred dividends (Net Income after Tax [SIAT]), the share of earnings/losses that the company is entitled to from unconsolidated affiliated companies which has not been distributed as dividends (Equity in Earnings of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA]) and adjustments to net income reported after taxes but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, discontinued operations and preferred dividends (After-Tax Adjustments - Other - Total [SOAN]). Applicable to all Industries.
Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] is the sum of:
• Equity in Earnings of Affiliates (after Taxes) [SQEA]
• After-Tax Adjustments - Other - Total [SOAN]
• Net Income after Tax [SIAT]

Net Income before Minority Interest [SIBM] represents the sum of Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] and all after tax extraordinary items reported by the company (Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX]). If the statement is non-detailed Net Income before Minority Interest [SIBM] is equal to Net Income after Extraordinary Items [XNIX]. Applicable to all Industries.

Minority Interest [SMNI] represents the share of earnings/losses in subsidiaries that belongs to shareholders other than the parent company when the parent company owns less than 100%, but more than 50%, of a subsidiary. Since the subsidiary's financials are consolidated by the company, this value is a negative number to represent the amount the company does not own. Applicable to all Industries.
Minority Interest [SMNI] includes:
• Minority Interest - Continuing Operations [CMIN]

If the account above is not available, it includes Minority Interest - Total [XIMI].

Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC] represents total net income/loss reported by the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions. Applicable to all Industries.
Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC] includes:
• Net Income before Minority Interest [SIBM]
• Minority Interest [SMNI] (Deducted)

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Net Income - including Extraordinary Items [XNIC]

Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS] represents total net income/loss reported by  the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS] includes:
• Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC*]
• Interest Expense - Hybrid Debt Instruments - Equity [SIHD] (deducted)
• Distribution for General Partners [SDSP]  (deducted)
• Distribution for Preferred Shares [SDFS]  (deducted)
• Earnings Adjustments to Net Income - Other [SOAJ] (deducted)

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Policyholders Surplus [SPHS] (deducted)

In the absence of the item [*] above it uses Net Income - including Extraordinary Items applicable to Common [XNCX].

provider_title: DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Period End Date [SPPSGI]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Period End Date [SPPSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company reports its business activity at the end of a financial period. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Period End Date [SPPSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI]

provider_title: Net Income - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [BINCC]
provider_description: Net Income - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [BINCC] represents Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]. Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN]
provider_description:
Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN] represents income before extraordinary items and preferred and common dividends, but after operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes, minority interest and equity in earnings. Applicable to all Industries.
Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCN] is the difference between:
• Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]
• Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX]

provider_title: Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC]
provider_description:
Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC] represents the weighted average common shares outstanding used to calculate earnings and other per share items, at company level. Applicable to all Industries.
Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Total [SBASC] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Basic EPS [BWASC]

Alternatively if CPO is primary Instrument for the company, it is:

provider_title: EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific [SBESI]
provider_description: EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific [SBESI] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the number of basic weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on instrument level (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]). provider_title: EPS - Basic from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXB]

Dilution Adjustment [SCDAJ] includes:
• Dilution Adjustment [CDAJ]

provider_title: Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DINCC]
provider_description: Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DINCC] represents a sum of Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS] and the value of Diluted Adjustment [CDAJ]. Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND]
provider_description:
Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND] represents Diluted net income after dilution adjustments but before After-tax extraordinary items. Applicable to Industrial companies.

provider_title: Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC]
provider_description:
Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC] represents the diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share items, at company level. Applicable to all Industries:
Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC] includes:

Alternatively if CPO is primary Instrument for the company, it is:

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDAIC]
provider_description:

If calculation above is not available, it uses EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DEPSBC].

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDCOC]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDCOC] represents the diluted net income available to common shareholders excluding extraordinary items (Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND]) per share (Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC]), at company level. provider_title: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Total [SDESC]
provider_description: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Total [SDESC] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the number of diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on company level (Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Total [SDWSC]).  Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDAII]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDAII] represents as reported diluted bottom line net income available to common shareholders (Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINCCI]) per share (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]).
