It uses Net Income - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [DINCC] as numerator if the account above is not available.

If calculation above is not available, it uses EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DEPSBI].

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDCOI]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDCOI] represents as reported diluted net income including all after tax items but before extraordinary items (Diluted Income available to Common excluding Extraordinary Items [SNCND]) per share (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Reported per specific share issues. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [SDCOI] includes:
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DEPSCI] (if calculation above is not available)

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific [SDESI]
provider_description: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific [SDESI] represents the value of Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by the number of diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item on instrument level (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: EPS - Diluted from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXD]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXD] represents the diluted per share of the gain/loss resulting from nonrecurring or unusual events and discontinued operations. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted from Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SEPSXD] is difference between:
• EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDAIC]
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Total [SDCOC]

provider_title: DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSGI]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI]

provider_title: DPS - Common - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSNI]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSNI] represents dividends per common share after taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSNI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Net - Issue Specific [XDPSNI]

Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) [SEBIT] represents a difference between total revenues reported by the company (Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR]) and total operating expense as reported by the company (Operating Expenses - Total [SOET]).
In the absence of the above, it includes: 
• Income before Taxes [SIBT] 
• Financing Income/(Expense) - Net - Total [SFIE] (less)
• Sale of Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets - Gain/(Loss) [SFAS] (less) 
• Equity Earnings/(Loss) - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA]  (less)
• Other Non-Operating Income/(Expense) - Total [SNEI] (less)
• Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SGLN] (less)
Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) [SEBITDA]
provider_description: Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) [SEBITDA] represents a sum of Earnings before Interest and Taxes [SEBIT] and the total depreciation and amortization value for the period [STDAE]. Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) and Operating Lease Payments [SEBITDAL]
provider_description:
Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) and Operating Lease Payments [SEBITDAL] represents Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation & amortization and Operating leases. Applicable to all Industries.
Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) and Operating Lease Payments [SEBITDAL] includes:
• Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA)[SEBITDA]
• Rental/Operating Lease Expense [SROL]

Depreciation & Amortization - Supplemental [SDEA] represents the amount charged for the combined depreciation of tangible fixed assets and amortization of intangibles during the period. Applicable to all Industries.
Depreciation & Amortization - Supplemental [SDEA] includes:
• Depreciation & Amortization - Supplemental [VDAE]

If account above is not available, it includes:
• Depreciation Expense - Total - Supplemental [SDPR]
• Amortization - Total - Supplemental [SAMR]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Depreciation & Amortization [EDAE].

Depreciation Expense - Total - Supplemental [SDPR] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of tangible fixed assets to expenses over those periods expected to benefit from the use of the assets. Applicable to all Industries.
Depreciation Expense - Total [SDPR] includes:
• Depreciation - Supplemental [VDEP]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets - Supplemental [VDLR]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes:
• Depreciation in Cost of Revenues [EDEC]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Cost of Revenues [EDLC]
• Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EDES]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EDLS]
• Depreciation in Research & Development Expenses [EDRD]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Research & Development Expenses [EDRL]
• Depreciation [EDEP]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EDLR]

Amortization - Total - Supplemental [SAMR] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. This field represents total amortization value for the period, related to assets classified in the balance sheet as intangibles. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization - Total - Supplemental [SAMR] includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill - Supplemental [VAMI]

If account above is not available, it includes:
• Goodwill Amortization - Supplemental [SAMA]
• Intangible Amortization - Other - Supplemental [SAOI]
• Amortization of Deferred Costs - Supplemental [SADC]

Intangible Amortization - Other - Supplemental [SAOI] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. Applicable to all Industries.
Intangible Amortization - Other - Supplemental [SAOI] includes:
• Amortization of Other Intangibles excluding Goodwill - Supplemental [VAOI]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs - Supplemental [SAML]
• Amortization of Computer Software - Supplemental [SASW]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles - Supplemental [SAMB]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets - Supplemental [SALR]
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development Expenses - Supplemental [SARD]

Property companies additionally includes:
• Amortization of Below/Above Market Leases - Supplemental [SAAM]
• Amortization of Tenant Relationships & In Place Leases - Supplemental [SATR]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill [EAMI]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EAMO]
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAMC]
• Amortization & Impairment of Intangibles including Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAIC]
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAMS]

Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE] represents the maximum value of combined depreciation and amortization reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes. Applicable to all industries.
Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE] includes:
• Depreciation - Total[STDEP]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [STAMD]
• Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI]

In the absence of Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI], it includes:
• Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO]
• Amortization of Goodwill - Total [STAMA]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Depreciation & Amortization - Total [TDAE] 
• Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [TAMD].

Depreciation - Total [STDEP] represents the maximum value of depreciation reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes. Applicable to all industries.
Depreciation - Total [STDEP] includes:
•Depreciation - Total [TDEP]

provider_title: Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI] includes the highest of the following values reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI] includes the highest of the following values reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [STAMI] includes:
• Amortization of Intangible Assets including Goodwill - Total [TAMI]

provider_title: Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO]
provider_description:
Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO] represents the maximum value of amortization related to intangible assets other than goodwill reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes.
 will be used in the calculation of ratios and analytics such as Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA). Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [STAMO] includes:
• Amortization of Intangible Assets excluding Goodwill - Total [TAMO]

provider_title: Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [SXRD]
provider_description:
Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [SXRD] represents the total research and development expenditure, including the portion of R&D costs that was capitalized to intangible or tangible assets during the accounting period. This is collected when reported in notes and which cannot be directly or indirectly associated to the face item of Income Statement. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [SXRD] includes:
• Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total - Supplemental [VRDT]

If the account above is not available, it includes Research & Development Expense - Expensed & Capitalized - Total [ETRD].

• Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized - Supplemental [SRDC]

If the item above is still not available, it includes:
• Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE]
• Research & Development Expense - Capitalized - Supplemental [SRDC]

Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE] represents expenses for the research and development of new products and services, excluding the portion of R&D expenses that was capitalized to intangible or tangible assets during the accounting period. This is picked when the R&D expense is reported in notes and the company does not specify where it is included. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE] includes:
• Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [VRAD]
• Research & Development Expense - Gross (before Government Grants) - Supplemental [VRBG]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Research & Development Expense [SRAD].

Labor & Related Expenses - Total [SLAR] represents the total value of all labour related expenses. It includes tax benefits relating to Stock option compensation and provisions for Stock Option compensation. Labor & Related Expense consists of expenses paid to employees of a company in the form of salaries, wages, fees, benefits or any other form of compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
Labor & Related Expenses - Total [SLAR] includes:
• Labor & Related Expenses - Supplemental [VLAR]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Labor & Related Expenses in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ELAS]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Cost of Revenue [ELAC*]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Research & Development [ELRD]
• Management Remuneration [EMEN]
• Workers' Profits Participation & Welfare Funds [EWPF]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ESCS*]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Cost of Revenue [ESCC*]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR*]

If Stock-based compensation accounts above are not available, it includes:
• Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [VSCP]
• Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Net of Tax - Supplemental [VSCN] (second option)
• Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental (third option)

Stock option will only be included if we have Labor and related expenses available.

provider_title: Labor & Related Expenses - Supplemental [SVLAR] consists of expenses paid to employees of a company in the form of salaries, wages, fees, benefits or any other form of compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Labor & Related Expenses - Supplemental [SVLAR] consists of expenses paid to employees of a company in the form of salaries, wages, fees, benefits or any other form of compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
Labor & Related Expenses - Supplemental [SVLAR] includes:
• Labor & Related Expenses - Supplemental[VLAR]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Labor & Related Expenses in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [ELAS]
• Labor & Related Expenses in Cost of Revenue [ELAC]

provider_title: Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Net of Tax - Supplemental [SVSCN]
provider_description:
Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Net of Tax - Supplemental [SVSCN] represents the provisions for Stock Option compensation which is reported in the footnotes after the tax impact of stock-based compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Net of Tax - Supplemental [SVSCN] is the difference between: 
• Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [SVSCP]
• Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [SVSCT]

Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [SVSCP] represents the provisions for Stock Option compensation when reflected in the footnotes before the tax impact of stock-based compensation. This would apply to the nominal charge recognized by some companies or the fair value provision for companies who have adopted the accounting standard. Applicable to all Industries.
Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [SVSCP] includes:
• Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [VSCP]

Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [SVSCT] represents tax benefits relating to Stock option compensation. Applicable to all Industries.
Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [SVSCT] includes:
• Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [VSCT]

If the account above is not available, it is calculated by multiplying Stock-Based Compensation Expense - Pre-tax - Supplemental [VSCP] by Estimated Tax Value [SETAXV].

Auditor Fees [SAFT] represents total fees for auditor services. Includes audit fees, audit-related fees, tax fees and other payments. NB: This relates to external auditors fees and do not include internal auditors fees. Applicable to all Industries.
Auditor Fees [SAFT] includes:
• Auditor Fees - Total [XAFT]

If the account above is not available, the sum of the following will be collected:
• Audit-Related Fees [SARF]
• Tax Fees [SATF]
• Fees - Other [SAOF]

Audit-Related Fees [SARF] represents all fees for professional services necessary and reasonably related to the performance an audit or review of financial statements. It also includes fees for services that are normally incurred in connection with statutory and regulatory filings or engagements, such as comfort letters, statutory audits, attest services, consents, and review of documents filed with the SEC. Applicable to all industries.
Audit-Related Fees [SARF] includes:
• Auditor Fees [VTAU]
• Audit-Related Fees  [VTAR]

provider_title: Tax Fees [SATF] are fees for auditors' legal counseling services. Note: This relates to external auditors fees and does not include internal auditors fees. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Tax Fees [SATF] are fees for auditors' legal counseling services. Note: This relates to external auditors fees and does not include internal auditors fees. Applicable to all Industries.
Tax Fees [SATF] includes:
• Tax Fees [VTTF]

Fees - Other [SAOF] represents all fees paid towards other auditor services as well as other non-auditor fees. Note: This relates to external auditors fees and does not include internal auditor’s fees. Applicable to all Industries.
Fees - Other [SAOF] includes:
• Auditor Fees - Other [VTOF]
• Fees (Non-auditor) - Other [VOAF]

Normalized after Tax Profit [SNAT] represents the value of income/expense after all operating and non-operating income and expense, reserves, income taxes, but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations and preferred dividends (Net Income after Tax [SIAT]) deducted by the total value of non-recurring income or expenses (Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN]). Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Normalized Net Income from Continuing Operations [SNCO]
provider_description: Normalized Net Income from Continuing Operations [SNCO] represents the difference between Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items [SICO] and Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN]. Applicable to all Industries.

Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] represents total net income/loss reported by  the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions (Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]) adjusted by the total value of non-recurring income or expenses (Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Total [SGLN]) and total after tax extraordinary items (Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/Loss [STEX]). Applicable to all Industries.

Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) - Normalized [SNEBIT] represents pre-tax profit without the effect of unusual or extraordinary income/expense and interest expense. Applicable to all Industries.
Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) - Normalized [SNEBIT] includes: 
• Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX]
• Interest Expense - Net of Interest Income [SNII]

provider_title: Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) - Normalized [SNEBITDA]
provider_description:
Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) - Normalized [SNEBITDA] represents pre-tax profit without the effect of unusual/extraordinary income/expense, interest expense and depreciation & amortization. Applicable to all Industries.
Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation & Amortization (EBITDA) - Normalized [SNEBITDA] is Normalized Pre-tax Profit [SNPX] less Interest Expense - Net of Interest Income [SNII] less Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE].

provider_title: Income before Taxes & Provision for Loan Losses [SIBTLLP]
provider_description:
Income before Taxes & Provision for Loan Losses [SIBTLLP] represents the value of as reported income/loss after all operating and non-operating income and expense, before the deduction of income tax adjusted by the value of provisions established for possible defaults or renegotiations by customers on loans from a financial institution. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Income before Taxes & Provision for Loan Losses [SIBTLLP] includes:
• Income before Taxes [SIBT]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]

Rental/Operating Lease Expense [SROL] represents rental expenses paid for offices, factories, machinery and equipment. It includes rent for the operating leasing machinery/equipment. Applicable to all Industries.
Rental/Operating Lease Expense [SROL] includes:
• Rental Expense - Supplemental [VRXP]

If account above is not available, it will be the sum of the following items:
• Rental Expense [ERXP]
• Aircraft Operating Lease Costs [EAOL]
• Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [EREX]
• Rental Expenses in Research & Development Expense [ERRD]

Advertising Expenses - Supplemental [SADV] represents a company’s cost of advertising media and promotional expenses reported as a supplemental value. Applicable to all industries.
Advertising Expense - Supplemental [SADV] includes:
• Advertising Expenses - Supplemental [VADV] 

If the account above is not available, it includes Advertising Expense [EADV].

provider_title: Cost of Revenue including Operation & Maintenance (Utility) - Total [SCREV]
provider_description:
Cost of Revenue including Operation & Maintenance (Utility) - Total [SCREV] represents the total cost of manufacturing and distributing goods and facilities by utility companies. It is the sum of Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR] and Operating & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE]. Applicable for Industrial, Property, Other Financial & Investment Trust Companies.
Cost of Revenue including Operation & Maintenance (Utility) - Total [SCREV] includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE]

Cost of Revenues excluding Depreciation [SCOGXD] represents the total value of costs of goods and services diminished by the value of depreciation and amortization reported within costs of goods sold. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Cost of Revenues excluding Depreciation [SCOGXD] includes:
• Cost of Financing-Related Operations [SCFS]
• Cost of Revenues - Total [SCGS]
• Amortization in Cost of Revenues [SACS] (deducted)
• Depreciation in Cost of Revenues [SDCS] (deducted)

Operating Expenses [SOPEX] represents the total expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Operating Expenses [SOPEX] is the difference between:
• Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR]
• Earnings before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) [SEBIT]

provider_title: Selling, General & Administrative Expenses excluding Research & Development Expenses [SGAXRD]
provider_description:
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses excluding Research & Development Expenses [SGAXRD] represents Selling, General & Administrative expenses excluding R&D expenses. Applicable to all industries.
Selling, General & Administrative Expenses excluding Research & Development Expenses [SGAXRD] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA]
• Less Research & Development Expense - Supplemental [SRDE]

Banks and Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Stock-Based Compensation in Research & Development Expense [ESCR]

provider_title: DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Payable Date [SYPSGI]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Payable Date [SYPSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which any declared stock dividends are due to be paid out. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Payable Date [SYPSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI]

provider_title: DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Ex Date [SXPSGI]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Ex Date [SXPSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company sets as one business day before the period end date/record date. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - By Ex Date [SXPSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI]

Tax Adjusted Operating Income [SINVC] represents Income before Discontinued Operations & Extraordinary Items adjusted to the Interest Expense Net (adjusted to Tax Rate). Applicable to all industries (Input to analytics).
Tax Adjusted Operating Income [SINVC] includes:
• Net Income after Minority Interest [SNIC]
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN]

provider_title: Operating Expenses excluding Non-Cash Charges - Total [SOENCC]
provider_description:
Operating Expenses excluding Non-Cash Charges - Total [SOENCC] represents the total value of operating expense minus the maximum value of combined depreciation and amortization reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes. Applicable to all Industries.
Operating Expenses excluding Non-Cash Charges - Total [SOENCC] includes:
• Operating Expenses - Total [SOET]
• Depreciation & Amortization - Total [STDAE] (less)

provider_title: Income Available to Common Shares before Depreciation & Amortization [SNISDA]
provider_description:
Income Available to Common Shares before Depreciation & Amortization [SNISDA] represents total net income/loss reported by the company after provision for income taxes, equity in earnings, after-tax adjustments, discontinued operations, extraordinary items and minority interest, but before other adjustments to net income, preferred dividends and other distributions excluding the maximum value of combined depreciation and amortization. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Available to Common Shares before Depreciation & Amortization [SNISDA] includes:
• Income Available to Common Shares [SNIS]
• Depreciation, Depletion & Amortization - Total [STDAE]

Estimated Tax Rate [SETAXV] represents the estimated taxes in the country of domicile. Calculated when the value of tax benefits relating to Stock option compensation (Stock-Based Compensation - Tax Benefit - Supplemental [VSCT]) is not provided. Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Total Common & Spl DPS -Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [STDSGI]
provider_description: Total Common & Spl DPS -Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [STDSGI] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue. It includes special dividends per share before taxes, paid to common shareholders on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]
provider_description:
Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR] represents revenue other than from sale of goods and services but still forming part of the business activities of the company. Applicable to all industries.
Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR] includes:
Industrial:
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other [ROBR]
• Islamic Income [ISIN]
• Royalty Income - Business [SROI]

Insurance:
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other [ROBR]
• Revenue from Goods & Services [RNTU]
• Net Revenue/Expense - Banking Operations - Insurance [SOIB]
• Fees & Commissions Income [SCFI]

Bank:
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other [ROBR]
• Revenue from Goods & Services [RNTU]

Property:
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other [ROBR]
• Islamic Income [ISIN]

Investment Trust:
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other [ROBR]
• Islamic Income [ISIN]
• Revenue from Goods & Services [RNTU]
• Sales of Goods & Services - Net [RNTS]

Other Financial:
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other [ROBR]
• Islamic Income [ISIN]
• Revenue from Goods & Services [RNTU]

provider_title: Amortization of Intangibles in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SAMS]
provider_description:
Amortization of Intangibles in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SAMS] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of assets that lack physical existence over those periods expected to benefit from the use of these assets. These assets usually have a high degree of uncertainty concerning future benefits. EAMS represents the amortization of all intangible assets (including goodwill) reported within selling, general or administrative expenses. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Intangibles in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SAMS] includes:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAMS]
• Amortization of Goodwill in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAGS]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EADS]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAMY]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAUS]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EALS]
• Amortization of Computer Software in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EASS]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EABS]
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EARS]
• Amortization excluding Goodwill in Research & Development Expenses [EARD]

If Cost of sales is not available, then it also includes the items below:
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill [EAMI]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EALR]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EAMO]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges [EAMD]
• Amortization of Goodwill [EAMA]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs [EAML]
• Amortization of Computer Software [EASW]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles [EAMB]

Non-Interest Financial Income/(Expense) - Total [SNIF] represents the total value of non-interest expense. It includes realized and unrealized gains and losses recorded as a result of foreign exchange fluctuations, gains and losses on the sale of investments, dividend income and accretion of the costs that an extraction company will incur in the future, for the closure of a mine and restoring the natural environment to its previous shape. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies.
Non-Interest Financial Income/(Expense) - Total [SNIF] includes:
• Non-Interest Financial Income/Expense - Total [EINU]
• Dividend & Investment Income [SIDN]
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [SIFX]
• Amortization of Deferred Financing Charges [SADF] (deducted)
• Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/Loss [SGIT]
• Non-Interest Financial Income/Expense - Other - Net [SINO]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Accretion - Site Closure & Reclamation Expenses [SSCR] (deducted)

provider_title: Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/(Loss) [SGIT]
provider_description:
Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/(Loss) [SGIT] represents realized gains and losses on the sale of investments held for sale, maturity and trading. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment and Financial companies.
Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/(Loss) [SGIT] includes:
• Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/Loss [EGIT]

provider_title: Provision for Income Tax Expense- Unclassified [SPRX] includes all taxes based on profits which are unclassified as to by region - federal, State and/or foreign government and by type - current or deferred. It also includes income taxes incurred by affiliated, associated and joint venture companies.
provider_description:
Provision for Income Tax Expense- Unclassified [SPRX] includes all taxes based on profits which are unclassified as to by region - federal, State and/or foreign government and by type - current or deferred. It also includes income taxes incurred by affiliated, associated and joint venture companies.
Provision for Income Tax Expense- Unclassified [SPRX] includes:
• Provision for Income Tax [TTAX]
• Taxes - Associated Companies [VTAC]

Research & Development - in Process [SRDW] represents unusual write-off of the value of purchased research and development in process. In-process Research & Development.
These are a purchased company's research and development costs, reported by the overtaking company and expensed in its income statement after completing the acquisition. Also called in-process research & development costs. Under certain accounting standards, goodwill resulting from an acquisition of a company must be allocated to the overtaken company's assets. The in-process research & development is related to the portion of goodwill that is allocated to the purchased company's research & development costs. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Research & Development - in Process [SRDW] includes:
• Purchased Research & Development Written Off [ERDW]

Litigation Expenses/Settlements [SLIT] represents non-recurring litigation expenses and legal/litigation provisions . Litigation expenses may include fees for lawyers, or the settlement of charges. However, litigation does not include standard business-related lawyers' fees. Applicable to all Industries.
Litigation Expenses/Settlements [SLIT] includes:
• Legal Provisions & Litigation Expenses [ELIT]

Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Other - Total [SGLO] represents other non-recurring income or losses, not included in any specific non-recurring categories. It includes as well transfers to/from untaxed reserves. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Other - Total [SGLO] includes:
• Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Other [EGLO]

provider_title: Earnings Adjustments to Net Income - Other Expense/(Income) [SOAJ]
provider_description:
Earnings Adjustments to Net Income - Other Expense/(Income) [SOAJ] represents an adjustment applied to net earnings that is used to calculate a company’s earnings per share. When net income used for EPS computation is not clearly reported by a company, the difference between the net income reported and the net income required for EPS computation is calculated and classified as Other Adjustments to Net Income. Applicable to all Industries. 
Earnings Adjustments to Net Income - Other Expense/(Income) [SOAJ] includes:
• Adjustments to Net Income - Other [COAJ]

Banks additionally includes:
• Primary Capital Adjustment - Savings Banks [CPCA]

Net Premiums Earned [SPNE] represents insurance policy premiums written in the course of the accounting period, after the impact of provisions for unearned premiums and the portion of insurance premiums that was paid out or received from reinsurers.  Insurance policies may consist of life policies and non-life policies such as fire, automobile, professional liability, health insurance, etc. This item is used for any net premiums, regardless of being related to life or non-life policies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Net Premiums Earned [SPNE] Includes:  
• Premiums Written - Gross [SPRW]
• Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Reinsurance [SPCD]
• Unearned Premiums [SPUP]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes:
• Net Premiums Earned - Total [XNPE]
• Net Premiums Earned [RPRE]
• Premiums Written - Net of Reinsurance [RPRN]

Premiums Written - Gross [SPRW] represents insurance policy premiums written in the course of the accounting period, before the impact of provisions for unearned premiums and the portion of insurance premiums that was paid out or received from reinsurers.  Insurance policies may consist of life policies and non-life policies such as fire, automobile, professional liability, health insurance, etc. This item is used when a company does not specify whether premiums earned are related to life or non-life policies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Premiums Written - Gross [SPRW] includes:  
• Premiums Written - Gross - Life/Long-Term Insurance [SPWL]
• Interest & Fees on Loans [SPWN]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes Premiums Written - Gross [RPRW].

Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Reinsurance [SPCD] represents a combination of earned (written) and unearned insurance premiums that were ceded out to reinsurers, in exchange for the coverage of losses that the insurer might incur on policies sold to clients. This item is usually a contra account to gross premiums. Applicable to Insurance.
Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Reinsurance [SPCD] includes: 
• Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Written [SRIW]
• Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Unearned [SRIU]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Written & Unearned [RRIC].

provider_title: Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Written [SRIW]
provider_description:
Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Written [SRIW] represents the portion of gross premiums written that were ceded out to reinsurers, in exchange for the coverage of losses that the insurer might incur on the policies sold to clients. This item is as a contra account to gross premiums. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Written [SRIW] includes: 
• Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Written [RRIL]

Investment Income/(Expense) - Net - Insurance [SNRV] represents net result from an insurance company's investing activities. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Investment Income/(Expense) - Net - Insurance [SNRV] includes:
• Investment Income - Gross - Insurance - Total [SIIT]
• Investment Expense - Insurance - Total [SIIE]

In absence of the breakdown above, it includes:
• Investment Income - Net - Insurance [RNII].

Investment Income - Gross - Insurance - Total [SIIT] represents the total investment income of an insurance company. Applicable to Insurance.
Investment Income - Gross - Insurance - Total [SIIT] includes:
• Investment Income - Gross - Insurance [RIIT]
• Dividend Income - Investments [RNID]
• Interest Income - Investment [RNIT]
• Dividend & Investment Income [EIDT]
• Interest Income - Non-Bank [EIIN]
• Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [ENFE] (if an income)
• Interest Expense/Income - Net [EINN] (if an income)
• Financial Income - Total [XTFI] (if an income)
• Net Financing Income/Expense [XNFI] (if an income)

Investments & Loans - Business - Gain/(Loss) [SGIL] represents gain/loss of investment securities and derivatives. It includes realized and unrealized income or losses on trading account investment assets, gains or losses on the sale of investment securities available for sale or held to maturity and other net investment gains or losses on asset types. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Investments & Loans - Business - Gain/(Loss) [SGIL] includes: 
Insurance
• Investment Securities - Business - Gain/Loss[SGLS]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Gain/Loss[SGHD]
• Gain/Loss on Sale of Financial Instruments - Other[SGFI]
• Settlement of Loans - Gain/Loss[SGSL]

Bank
• Investment Securities - Business - Gain/Loss [SGLS]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Gain/Loss [SGHD]
• Gain/Loss on Sale of Financial Instruments - Other [SGFI]
• Settlement of Loans - Gain/Loss [SGSL]
• Net Investments & Loans Gain/Loss - Business Revenue [SSGL]

Investment
• Investment Securities - Business - Gain/Loss [SGLS]
• Settlement of Loans - Gain/Loss [SGSL]
• Net Investments & Loans Gain/Loss - Business Revenue [SSGL]
• Capital Gains/(Losses) - Unrealized - Total [SUNC]
• Realized Capital Gain/Loss - Total [SRCT]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Gain/Loss - Unclassified [SGHU]

Financial
• Investment Securities - Business - Gain/Loss [SGLS]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Gain/Loss [SGHD]
• Gain/Loss on Sale of Financial Instruments - Other [SGFI]
• Settlement of Loans - Gain/Loss [SGSL]
• Net Investments & Loans Gain/Loss - Business Revenue [SSGL]
• Capital Gains/(Losses) - Unrealized - Total [SUNC]

Investment Securities - Business - Gain/(Loss) [SGLS] represents gain/loss on investment securities. It includes realized and unrealized income or losses on trading account investment assets, gains or losses on the sale of investment securities available for sale or held to maturity and other net investment gains. Applicable to Insurance, Banks, Investment and Financial companies.
Investment Securities - Business - Gain/(Loss) [SGLS] includes:
Insurance
• Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/Loss [EGLI]
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/Loss – Total [EGTU]
• Investment Securities - Business Unclassified - Gain/Loss [EVIU]
• Investment Gain/Loss – Other [EGIO]

Bank
• Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/Loss [SGLI]
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/Loss [SGTI]

Investment
• Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/Loss [SGLI]
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/Loss [SGTI]
• Investment Gain/Loss – Other [SGIO]

Financial
• Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/Loss [SGLI]
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/Loss [SGTI]

Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Gain/(Loss) [SGHD] represents realized gains or losses on the sale of derivative assets held for hedging purposes as well as unrealized fair value changes of derivative assets held for hedging purposes.  Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Derivative - Hedging - Gain/(Loss) [SGHD] includes: 
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Realized Gain/Loss [SRGD]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Fair Value Adjustments [SDEO]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [EGLD].

provider_title: Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Fair Value Adjustments - Gain/(Loss) [SDEO]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Fair Value Adjustments - Gain/(Loss) [SDEO] represents the unrealized fair value changes of derivative assets held for hedging purposes. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.  
Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Fair Value Adjustments - Gain/(Loss) [SDEO] includes:  
• Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [EDEO]

Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total [STIC] represents net expenses for current insurance claims combined with net additions to insurance reserves. Applicable to Insurance companies.  
Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total [STIC] includes:
• Long-Term Insurance Reserves - Gross [SLBR]
• Loss Adjustment Expense [SLAA]
• Insurance Benefits Ceded [SIBP] (deducted)
• Insurance Benefits Paid - Current [SCBP]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes: 
• Insurance Claims/Reserves - Net of Reinsurance - Total [ETIC]  
• Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Paid - Net of Reinsurance [ECBN]
• Long-Term Insurance Reserves - Net of Reinsurance [ECLN]
• Net Claims/Losses Paid - Total [XNCM]

Loss Adjustment Expense [SLAA] represents an insurance company’s costs of carrying out loss adjustments under the insurance policy. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Loss Adjustment Expense [SLAA] includes: 
• Loss Adjustment Expense [ELAA]

Other Operating Expense [SOOE] represents any other operating expenses which are not specifically collected under the available granular FCC’s like Selling/General/Admin. Expense [ESGA], Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [EDOE], Other SGA [ESGO], Other Operating Income/Expenses [EOIE]. It is usually reported by the company as “Other”.  Applicable to all Industries.
• Other Operating Expense [EOOE]
• Depreciation [EDEP*]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EDLR*]
• Depreciation & Amortization [EDAE*]
• Amortization of Intangibles including Goodwill [EAMI*]
• Amortization of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EALR*]
• Amortization of Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EAMO*]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges [EAMD*]
• Amortization of Goodwill [EAMA*]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs [EAML*]
• Amortization of Computer Software [EASW*]
• Amortization of Brands, Patents, Trademarks, Marketing & Artistic Intangibles [EAMB*]
• Depreciation - Investment Property [EDEI*]
• Other Operating Income/Expense [EOIE] (if an expense)

*The accounts are included if there are no Cost of sales, Selling, general and administrative expenses available.

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Reimbursed Costs [EORC]

provider_title: Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN]
provider_description:
Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN] represents interest expense on debt, net of capitalized. Additionally this item should also be used when the company does not delineate separately gross interest costs and interest capitalized that is when the company just reports Interest expense on the face. Applicable to Industrial, Insurance, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN] includes:
• Interest Expense on Capital Financing - Gross [STIE]
• Dividends on Hybrid Financial Instruments - Liability Portion [SDHY]
• Interest Capitalized [SICA] (deducted)
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [EIEN]
• Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities [EILL]
• Interest/Dividends on Hybrid Financial Instruments - Liability Portion [EPRD]
• Interest Expense/Income - Net [EINN] (if this is an expense)
• Financial Expense - Total [XTFE] (in the absence of pure interest expense)
• Net Financing Income/Expense [XNFI] (in the absence of pure Interest expense and Financial Expense and is expense)

Industrial companies additionally includes: 
• Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Debt Portion (AFUDC) [SAFD]

provider_title: Early Extinguishment of Lease Related Debts - Gain/(Loss) [SERD]
provider_description:
Early Extinguishment of Lease Related Debts - Gain/(Loss) [SERD] represents gains/losses on early extinguishment and redemption of lease related debt . Long-term debt called back by a company before the maturity date. This may occur when the interest rate on the debt exceeds the current prevailing interest rate. The difference between the cash paid and the carrying value of the bond is treated as an ordinary loss or gain. Applicable to all industries.
Early Extinguishment of Lease Related Debts - Gain/(Loss) [SERD] includes:
• Early Extinguishment of Lease Related Debts - Gain/Loss [EERD]

Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/(Loss) [STEX] represents the all after tax extraordinary items reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Extraordinary Activities - after Tax - Gain/(Loss) [STEX] includes:
• Discontinued Operations - Net of Taxes - Total [SDON]
• Impacts from Changes in Accounting Standards [SGAP]
• Extraordinary Items [SXTR]
• Extraordinary Items - Tax Impact [SSIT]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Extraordinary Items (after Tax) [XTEX].

provider_title: Discontinued Operations - Net of Taxes - Total - Income/(Expense) [SDON]
provider_description:
Discontinued Operations - Net of Taxes - Total - Income/(Expense) [SDON] represent net result from current discontinued operations combined with the sale of discontinued operations, after taxes. Applicable to all Industries.
Discontinued Operations - Net of Taxes - Total - Income/(Expense) [SDON] includes:
• Discontinued Operations - Net - Income/Expense [SXCD]
• Sale of Discontinued Operations - Net - Gain/Loss [SXDD]
• Discontinued Operations before Tax [SDBT]
• Discontinued Operations - Tax Impacts [STID]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Discontinued Operations - Net of Taxes [XDOT].

Discontinued Operations - Net - Income/(Expense) [SXCD] represents current net income/loss generated by the operations of a business unit or subsidiary available for sale, net of tax . Applicable to all industries.
Discontinued Operations - Net - Income/(Expense) [SXCD] includes: 
• Discontinued Operations - Net - Income/Expense [ZCDN]
• Minority Interest - Discontinued Operations [CMID] (deducted)

Discontinued Operations - Tax Impacts [STID] represents tax on discontinued operations. Applicable to all Industries.
Discontinued Operations - Tax Impacts [STID] includes:
• Discontinued Operations - Tax Impacts - Current Income/Expense [ETDT]
• Discontinued Operations - Tax Impacts - Gain/Loss on Sale [ETDD]
• Discontinued Operations - Tax Impacts [ETID]

Interest Expense [SINTEX] represents Net interest expense. Applicable to all Industries
Interest Expense [SINTEX] includes:
•Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest[SIEN]
•Interest Expense - Finance - Total[SIET]

Investment Income - Insurance [SINVI] represents Investment income for an insurance company. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Investment Income - Insurance [SINVI] includes:
• Investment Income - Net - Insurance [SNRV]
• Investment Income - Gross - Investment [SGII]

Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SELBA] represents insurance claims made by policyholders in settlements of losses incurred. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SELBA] includes:
•Insurance Benefits Paid - Current[SCBP]
•Long-Term Insurance Reserves - Gross[ELBR]
•Loss Adjustment Expense[ELAA]
•Long-Term Insurance Reserves - Net of Reinsurance[ECLN]

Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Total [SRRII] represents change in premiums received but not yet earned. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Total [SRRII] includes:
•Unearned Premiums[SPUP]
•Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Reinsurance[SPCD]

Total Claim & Loss Expense [STCLE] represents the total insurance claims & reserves. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Total Claim & Loss Expense [STCLE] includes:
•Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total [STIC]
•Long-Term Insurance Reserves - Gross [SLBR]

Underwriting Expenses - Insurance [SUWEX] represents total operating expense less Underwriting & claims reserves (used for Analytics). Applicable to Insurance companies.
Underwriting Expenses - Insurance [SUWEX] includes:
•Operating Expenses - Total[SOET]
•Underwriting & Commissions[SUNDC]
•Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total[STIC]

provider_title: Underwriting Expenses minus Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SUWELB]
provider_description:
Underwriting Expenses minus Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SUWELB] represents the difference between insurance costs and policholders claims/losses. Applicable to Insurance.
Underwriting Expenses minus Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SUWELB] is the difference between:
• Underwriting Expenses - Insurance [SUWEX] 
• Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SELBA]

Premiums Earned - Total [SPTE] represents the sum of insurance policy premiums written in the course of the accounting period, after the impact of provisions for unearned premiums and the portion of insurance premiums that was paid out or received from reinsurers. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Premiums Earned - Total [SPTE] includes:
• Net Premiums Earned [SPNE]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]

Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Total [SLBA] represents the sum of:
• Losses, Benefits & Adjustments - Insurance [SELBA]
• Insurance Benefits Ceded [SIBP]
• Underwriting & Commissions [SUNDC]
Applicable to Insurance companies.

Net Premiums Written [SNPW] represents insurance policy premiums written in the course of the accounting period with included impact of provisions for unearned premiums and the portion of insurance premiums that was paid out or received from reinsurers. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Net Premiums Written [SNPW] is difference between: 
• Premiums Written - Gross [SPRW]
• Premiums Ceded Out & Unearned - Reinsurance [SPCD]

Fixed Charges [SFXC] represents the sum of Interest Expense Net & Preferred Dividends adjusted to the Tax rate. Applicable to all industries.
Fixed Charges [SFXC] includes:
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN]
• Preferred Dividends and Similar [XPFS].

Depreciation in Cost of Revenues [SDCS] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of tangible fixed assets to expenses over those periods expected to benefit from the use of the assets. It’s the sum of depreciation reported outside of cost of sales, outside of selling, general and administrative expenses as well as outside research and development expenses. It the value of pure depreciation is not available then it’s the sum of combined values depreciation with amortization. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment Trust companies.
Depreciation in Cost of Revenues [SDCS] includes:
• Depreciation in Cost of Revenues [EDEC]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Cost of Revenues [EDLC]
• Depreciation & Amortization in Cost of Revenues [EDAC]

If any items in Cost of goods sold are reported, it will include the following items:
• Depreciation & Amortization [EDAE]
• Depreciation [EDEP]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EDLR]

provider_title: Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Cost of Revenues [SLAC]
provider_description:
Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Cost of Revenues [SLAC] represents labour costs reported within the cost of goods sold. This would also be populated when company uses 'by nature' presentation of the income statement (reporting material expenses, change in inventories, depreciation/amortization, labor and related expenses) and labour cost is deemed to be part of cost of revenue for manufacturing and mining companies. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment Trust companies.
Labor & Related Expenses including Stock-Based Compensation in Cost of Revenues [SLAC] includes:
• Labor & Related Expenses in Cost of Revenue [ELAC]
• Stock-Based Compensation in Cost of Revenue [ESCC]

provider_title: Interest Expense on Capital Financing - Gross [STIE]
provider_description:
Interest Expense on Capital Financing - Gross [STIE] represents interest expense on debt before interest capitalized. When not reported, it is  calculated using the gross value from the reported net and capitalized values. Applicable to Industrial, Insurance, Property, Investment and Other Financial companies.
Interest Expense on Capital Financing - Gross [STIE]  includes:
• Interest Expense on Capital Financing - Gross [ETIE]

Non-Interest Financial Income/(Expense) - Other - Net [SINO] represents other net financing income or expenses. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Non-Interest Financial Non-Interest Financial Income/(Expense) - Other - Net [SINO] includes:  
• Net Financial Income/Expense - Other [EINO]

Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies additionally includes:
• Dividend & Investment Income [EIDT] (if negative)

Impairment - Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets [SITI] represents the total value of impairment of all assets.  It includes a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of long-lived assets or assets held for use, company acquisition costs (goodwill), other intangible assets and oil and natural gas assets. Applicable to all Industries.
Impairment - Tangible & Intangible Fixed Assets [SITI] includes:
• Impairment - Fixed Assets [SIFO]
• Impairment - Goodwill [SIGO]
• Impairment - Intangibles excluding Goodwill [SIIO]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• Impairment - Oil & Gas Assets [SIOG]

Impairment - Fixed Assets [SIFO] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of long-lived assets or assets held for use. These assets are retained by the reporting company. This item is applicable to all industries and may also be reported as part of the business and geographic segment information.
Impairment - Fixed Assets [SIFO] includes:
• Impairment - Fixed Assets [EIFO]

Income Taxes - Other (KFAS/NLST) - Current [SCTO] represents the portion of a company’s current income tax provision not classified as Income Taxes - Domestic - Current [VCTD], Income Taxes - Foreign - Current [VCTF] or Income Taxes - Local - Current [VCTL]. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all industries.
Income Taxes - Other (KFAS/NLST) - Current [SCTO] includes:
• Income Taxes - Other (KFAS/NLST) - Current [VCTO]
• Final Tax [FTAX]

Income Taxes - Other - Deferred [SDTO] represents the portion of a company’s deferred income tax provision not classified as Income Taxes - Domestic - Deferred [VDTD], Income Taxes - Foreign - Deferred [VDTF] or Income Taxes - Local - Deferred [VDTL]. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all industries.
Income Taxes - Other - Deferred [SDTO] includes:
• Income Taxes - Other - Deferred [VDTO]

provider_title: Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB] - Other revenues related to financing operations. Applicable to all industries.
provider_description:
Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB] - Other revenues related to financing operations. Applicable to all industries.
Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB] includes:
• Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [ROFB]

Insurance companies additionally includes:
• Non-Insurance/Non-Technical Income - Total [XNSI]

Insurance Benefits Paid - Current [SCBP] represents insurance claims made by policyholders in settlements of losses incurred. Policy claims related to life, accidents, health, property and casualty policies. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Insurance Benefits Paid - Current [SCBP] includes:
• Life Insurance Benefits Paid[SLBP]
• Non-Life Insurance Benefits Paid[SGBP]
In the absence of the above breakdown it includes Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Paid - Gross[ECBP].

Underwriting Expenses [SUWE] represents all expenses, inclusive of net commissions, salaries, and advertising costs, that are applicable to the authoring of net premiums written. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Underwriting Expenses [SUWE] includes: 
• Policy Acquisition Costs - Total [SPAQ]
• Unclassified Underwriting Expense - Other [SODE]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes Underwriting Expenses - Total [EUWU].

Policy Acquisition Costs - Total [SPAQ] represents acquisition costs relating to the life/general insurance business, which are capitalized and shown in the Balance sheet as an asset, these expenses are gradually amortized over the lifetime of the insurance policy. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Policy Acquisition Costs - Total [SPAQ] includes:
• Policy Acquisition Costs - Unclassified [SAQU]
• Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [SPAD]
• Policy Acquisition Costs - Other [SOPA]
• Underwriting Commissions to Agents [SPAU]
• Fee & Commission Expense - Insurance [SPFC]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Policy Acquisition Costs [EPAQ]

provider_title: Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [SPAD]
provider_description:
Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [SPAD] represents policy acquisition costs relating to the life/general insurance business, which are capitalized and shown in the Balance sheet as an asset, these expenses are gradually amortized over the lifetime of the insurance policy. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [SPAD] includes: 
• Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs [EPAD]

Fee & Commission Expense - Insurance [SPFC] represents an insurance company’s fee and commission costs other than underwriting commissions for agents. Applicable to insurance companies.
Fee and Commission Expense - Insurance [SPFC] includes:
• Fee & Commission Expense - Insurance [EPFC]

Advertising Expense [SADE] represents a company’s cost of advertising media and promotional expenses. Applicable to all industries. 
Advertising Expenses [SADE] includes: 
• Advertising Expense [EADV]

Underwriting & Commissions [SUNDC] represents an insurance company’s total sum of the following insurance costs. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Underwriting & Commissions [SUNDC] includes:
•Underwriting Expenses[SUWE]
•Policy Acquisition Costs - Unclassified[SAQU]
•Amortization of Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs[SPAD]

Goodwill Amortization - Supplemental [SAMA] represents the systematic charge to expense over the useful lives of goodwill (acquisition cost of subsidiary exceeding the identified value of acquired assets). Applicable to all Industries.
Goodwill Amortization - Supplemental [SAMA] includes:
• Amortization of Goodwill - Supplemental [VAMA]

If account above is not available, it includes:
• Amortization of Goodwill [EAMA]
• Amortization of Goodwill in Cost of Revenues [EAGC]
• Amortization of Goodwill in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EAGS]

Amortization of Goodwill - Total [STAMA] represents the maximum value of goodwill amortization reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes.
 will be used in the calculation of ratios and analytics such as Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA). Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Goodwill - Total [STAMA] includes:
• Amortization of Goodwill - Total [TAMA]

Life Insurance Benefits Paid [SLBP] represents amounts paid to policyholders or beneficiaries on claims made against life insurance policies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Life Insurance Benefits Paid [SLBP] includes: 
• Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Paid - Gross - Life [ELBI]

Non-Life Insurance Benefits Paid [SGBP] represents amounts paid to policyholders or beneficiaries on claims made against non-life/general insurance policies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Non-Life Insurance Benefits Paid [SGBP] includes:  
• Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Paid - Gross - Non-Life [ELBN]

Restructuring Charges [SRST] represents expenses or provisions associated with the reorganization of certain functions, regrouping of divisions or closing of a facility/branch. These may include the consolidation of divisions, relocation of facilities and/or employees, and employee termination costs. Applicable to all Industries.
Restructuring Charges [SRST] includes:
• Restructuring Charges & Provisions [ERES]

Interest & Dividend Income/(Expense) - Net - Finance [SIDI] represents the total value of net interest and dividend income before loan loss provisions. It is the sum of interest and dividend income, and interest or equivalent expenses. Applicable to Banks.
Interest & Dividend Income/(Expense) - Net - Finance [SIDI] includes:
• Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET]  
• Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT]

Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT] represents combined interest and dividend income from deposits and from loans and investment securities as well as fee income from lending activities by companies not classified as banks, trading account assets, securities available for sale, securities held to maturity or other securities.  Applicable to Bank and Other Financial companies.
Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT] is the sum of:  
• Interest & Dividend Income - Other - Finance [SIOD]  
• Interest Income - Loans/Deposits [SIIL] 
• Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities - Finance [SDIS]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Interest Income [XIIN].

Interest Income - Loans/Deposits [SIIL] represents the total value of combined interest or dividend income on deposits and from loans and investment securities as well as fee income from lending activities by companies not classified as banks. Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.    
Interest Income - Collateralized Financing [SILR] includes: 
• Interest & Fees on Loans & Receivables [SIFL]
• Interest Income - Deposits to Other Financial Institutions [SIDF]
• Interest Income - Collateralized Financing [SILR]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Interest Income - Loans - Business - Total [RIIU].

Interest & Fees on Loans & Receivables [SIFL] represents the total value of combined interest or dividend income from loans and investment securities as well as fee income from lending activities by companies not classified as banks. Applicable to Banks.
Interest & Fees on Loans & Receivables [SIFL] includes:
• Interest & Fees on Loans [RFLI]

Interest Income - Collateralized Financing [SILR] represents interest income from REPO (reverse repurchase) transactions, collateralized financing agreements and securities purchased. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Income - Collateralized Financing [SILR] includes:  
• Interest Income - Collateralized Financing [RTSF]

provider_title: Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities - Finance [SDIS]
provider_description:
Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities - Finance [SDIS] represents combined interest and dividend income from trading account assets, securities available for sale, securities held to maturity or other securities. Applicable to Bank and Other Financial companies.
Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities - Finance [SDIS] is the sum of:
• Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Finance [SIDS]  
• Interest & Dividend Income - Trading Account Assets - Finance [SIDA]  
In the absence of the above it includes:
• Interest & Dividend Income on Investment Securities - Business – Total (No b/d) [RDIU]

provider_title: Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Finance [SIDS]
provider_description:
Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Finance [SIDS] represents the income from investment securities available for sale or held to maturity, such as equity securities and fixed income securities. Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.
Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Finance [SIDS] includes:  
• Interest & Dividend Income - Investment Securities Available for Sale/Held to Maturity [RISI]

provider_title: Interest & Dividend Income - Trading Account Assets - Finance [SIDA]
provider_description:
Interest & Dividend Income - Trading Account Assets - Finance [SIDA] represents interest earned on securities held for trading (as opposed to securities held for sale of held to maturity). Applicable to Banks and Other Financial companies.
Interest & Dividend Income - Trading Account Assets - Finance [SIDA] includes:
• Interest & Dividend Income - Trading Account Assets [RVTA]

Interest & Dividend Income - Other - Finance [SIOD] represents interest or dividend income other than from loans, collateralized financing and investment securities. It is also used when the source of interest and dividends is unknown. Applicable to Banks and Other Financial companies.
Interest & Dividend Income - Other - Finance [SIOD] includes:
Banks and Other Financial companies:
• Interest & Dividend Income - Other[ROID]
• Interest & Dividend Income - Business - Total[RIDU]
• Dividend Income - Investments[RNID]
• Interest Income - Investment[RNIT]

Banks additionally includes:
• Murabaha Income[IMBR]
• Musharaka Income[IMSR]
• Istisna Income[IISR]
• Mudaraba Income[IMDR]
• Ijara Income[IIJR]
• Wakala Income[IWKR]
• Sukuk Income[ISKR]
• Other Islamic Income[IOIR]
• Dividend & Investment Income[EIDT]

Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET] represents the total value of interest payable relating to financing operations. It includes interest expense on loans and borrowings obtained from external suppliers of funds as well as interest payable on repurchase agreements (REPOs), collateralized financing agreements and securities sold as well as represents interest paid on deposits placed with the bank by its individual, corporate and institutional clients, as well as deposits due to other banks. Applicable to Bank and Other Financial companies.
Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET] is a sum of following: 
• Return on Unrestricted Investment Accounts [SRUI]  
• Interest Expense - External Financing Business [SIED]  
• Interest Expense - Operational Financing - Business [SEOF]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Interest Expense [XINE].

Interest Expense - Operational Financing - Business [SEOF] represents the total value of interest payable relating to normal banking, investment or financial operations. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Expense - Operational Financing - Business [SEOF] is the sum of following:  
• Interest Expenses - Other - Total [SEOI] 
• Interest Expense - Collateralized Financing [SELR] 
• Interest Expense - Deposits [SDPI]

Interest Expense - Deposits [SDPI] represents interest paid on deposits placed with the bank by its individual, corporate and institutional clients, as well as deposits due to other banks. It includes interest expense from regular operating activities for financial institutions, including interest on external financing. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Expense - Deposits [SDPI] includes:  
• Customer Interest [EBCU]

Interest Expenses - Other - Total [SEOI] represents interest payable relating to normal banking, investment or financial operations which are either not specified as deriving from bank deposit accounts, customer deposits or REPO transactions, or which may represent a combination of these items. It excludes interest on external financing, such as long-term loans and bonds. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Expenses - Other - Total [SEOI]] includes:  
• Interest - Trading liabilities [EETL]
• Interest Expense - Operational Financing - Business - Total [EBMI]
• Interest Expenses - Other [EEOI]

Interest Expense - External Financing Business [SIED] represents interest expense on loans and borrowings obtained from external suppliers of funds, rather than funds obtained in regular banking activities. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Expense - External Financing Business [SIED] includes:  
• Interest - Other Borrowings [EIEF]
• Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities [EILL]
• Dividends on Hybrid Financial Instruments - Liability Portion [SDHY]

Non-Interest Business Revenue/(Expense) - Net - Total [SNIB] represents the total value of non-interest revenue reported by Banks.
Non-Interest Business Revenue/(Expense) - Net - Total [SNIB] includes:
• Net Commission & Fees Income/Expense - Business Revenue [SNCF]
• Trust Income [STRU]
• Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [SNFE]
• Investments & Loans - Business - Gain/Loss [SGIL]
• Net Income/Expense from Insurance - Bank [SNIR]
• Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB]
• Revenue from Business-Related Activities - Other - Total [SOBR]

provider_title: Net Commission & Fees Income/Expense - Business Revenue [SNCF]
provider_description:
Net Commission & Fees Income/Expense - Business Revenue [SNCF] represents the reported combined value of Commission and fee. This is calculated by getting the difference of Fees & Commissions Income [SCFI] and Fees & Commissions Expense [SCFE]. Applicable to Bank and Other Financial companies.
Net Commission & Fees Income/Expense - Business Revenue [SNCF] includes:  
• Net Fees & Commissions Income/Expense [XFAC] if the accounts mentioned above are not available

Fees & Commissions Income [SCFI] represents the sum of fees earned from customer services. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.  
Fees & Commissions Income [SCFI] includes: 
• Fee Income - Asset Management[EFAM]
• fees earned from credit card services for banks [ECCF]
• commissions and fees earned on managing customers’  investment assets [EFAM]  
• Fee Income - Other Customer Services [EOCS]
• Fees and commissions received in respect of financial services rendered [EFAC]  

Insurance companies additionally includes: 
• Mudarib Share - Policyholders[IPMS]
• Wakala Fee - Shareholders[ISWF]
• Mudarib Share - Shareholders[ISMS]
• Wakala Fee - Policyholders[IPWF]
Investment companies additionally includes:
• Net Fees & Commissions Income/Expense[XFAC] (if the value is positive)

Fees & Commissions Expense [SCFE] represents commission and fee expenses from banking and other operations for third party’s services.  Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Fees & Commissions Expense [SCFE] includes: 
Fees & Commissions Expense[ECFE]
For Insurance & Investment, it includes Net Fees & Commissions Income/Expense[XFAC](if value is negative).

Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/(Loss) [SGTI] represents realized and unrealized income or losses on trading account investment assets, reported by financial companies. Applicable to Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/(Loss) [SGTI] includes:  
• Trading Investments - Realized Gain/Loss [SRTI]
• Trading Investments - Unrealized Gain/Loss [SUTI]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes:
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/Loss - Total [EGTU]

Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP] represents provisions established for possible defaults or renegotiations by customers on loans from a financial institution. Applicable to Bank, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP] includes:
• Provision for Loan Losses [ELOP]
• Loans Written Off [ELWO]
• Loans Written Off - Recovered [EROF] (deducted)

Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [SEOE] represents expenses relating to maintenance, upkeep and general care of premises occupied, heat, light, expenses other than rental costs. Applicable to all Industries.
Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [SEOE] includes:
• Equipment/Occupancy Expense - Bank/Financial - Other [EOEO]

provider_title: Equity Earnings/(Loss) - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA]
provider_description:
Equity Earnings/(Loss) - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA] represents profits arising from any source, accounted for by the equity method. Profits or losses of subsidiaries, associated companies or other companies accounted for on the equity basis and included in Profit before tax. It includes the non-recurring portion of profits, arising from any source, accounted for by the equity method. Applicable to all Industries.
Equity Earnings/(Loss) - before Taxes including Non-Recurring [SIQA] includes:
• Equity Earnings - before Tax [EIQA]
• Non-Recurring Portion of Equity Earnings before Taxes [SNQA]

Costs Associated with IPOs & Mergers [SCAI] represents costs related to the issuance of shares and other instruments on stock exchanges, as well as the costs incurred for the acquisition of other entities. Applicable to all Industries.
Costs Associated with IPOs & Mergers [SCAI] includes:
• Costs Associated with IPOs & Mergers [ECAI]

Distribution for Preferred Shares [SDFS] represents the total dollar amount of the current dividend requirement on issued preferred stock of a company (including its subsidiaries).  Preferred stockholders normally forgo voting rights and receive a fixed dividend that takes precedence over the payment of dividends to common stockholders. Preferred dividends are usually cumulative and non-participative in nature. When preferred stock is redeemed during the year, the company may still report preferred dividends on the income statement, although there is no preferred stock outstanding at the end of that fiscal year. Applicable to all Industries.
Distribution for Preferred Shares [SDFS] includes: 
• Distribution for Preferred Shares [CPRD]

If the account above is not available, it includes Preferred Dividends, Distributions & Earnings Adjustments - Total [XPFS] (deducted).

Loan Losses - Net [SNLL] represent the actual amount the bank lost during the year from uncollectable loans offset by the loans recovered during the year that were previously charged off by the bank. Applicable to Banks.
Loan Losses - Net [SNLL] is the difference between:
• Loan Losses - Actual [SALL] 
• Loan Recoveries - Actual [SARC]

If the account above is not available, it includes Loan Losses - Net [VNLL].

Loan Recoveries - Actual [SARC] represent the amount of loans previously charged off by the bank that were repaid within a given year. Applicable to Banks.
Loan Recoveries - Actual [SARC] includes:
• Loan Recoveries - Actual [VARC]

If the account above is not available, it includes Loans Written Off - Recovered [EROF].

Loan Losses - Actual [SALL] represent the amount of loans that the bank decides are uncollectable and writes off in a given year. Applicable to Banks.
Loan Losses - Actual [SALL] includes:
• Loan Losses - Actual [VALL]

If the account above is not available, it includes Loans Written Off [ELWO].

provider_title: Interest & Dividend Income after Loan Loss Provision - Net - Finance [SIAL]
provider_description: Interest & Dividend Income after Loan Loss Provision - Net - Finance [SIAL] represents the difference between Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT], Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET] and Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP]. Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.

provider_title: Revenue after Loan Provisions - Net - Finance [SNRL]
provider_description:
Revenue after Loan Provisions - Net - Finance [SNRL] represents Interest and Dividend income after Provision for loan losses. Applicable to Banks & Other Financial companies.
Revenue after Loan Provisions - Net - Finance [SNRL] includes:
• Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT]
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP] (Deducted)
