Commissions & Fees from Securities Activities [SNSAC] represents the sum of commissions and fees earned on managing customers’ investment assets and other income derived from services rendered in a fiduciary capacity. Applicable to Insurance, Banks, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Commissions & Fees from Securities Activities [SNSAC] includes:
• Trust Income [STRU]
• Fee Income - Asset Management [EFAM]

Investment Gain/(Loss) [SINVG] represents realized gains and losses on the sale of investments and interest from investments together with any income received on short term lending. Interest received from advances, deposit accounts and any income received on short term lending. Applicable to Banks.
Investment Gain/(Loss) [SINVG] includes:
• Investment Securities - Business Unclassified - Gain/Loss [EVIU]
• Trading Investments - Realized Gain/Loss [ERTI]
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/Loss - Total [EGTU]
• Trading Investments - Unrealized Gain/Loss [EUTI]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/Loss [EDRG]
• Dividend & Investment Income [EIDT]
• Investment Gain/Loss - Other [EGIO]
• Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/Loss [EGLI]

Non-Interest Expense - Bank [SNIE] represents the total value of all non-interest expenses reported by a bank. Applicable to Banks.
Non-Interest Expense - Bank [SNIE] includes:
• Revenue from Business Activities - Total[STLR] 
• Income before Taxes [SIBT] (deducted)
• Provision & Impairment for Loan Losses [SLLP] (deducted)

provider_title: Revenue Net of Interest Expense Before Loan Loss Provision [STRN]
provider_description: Revenue Net of Interest Expense Before Loan Loss Provision [STRN] represents the difference between total as reported revenues (Revenue from Business Activities - Total [STLR]) less the total value of interest payable relating to financing operations (Interest Expense - Finance - Total [SIET]). Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.

Income from Earning Assets [SIEI] represents all the income from the company's Earning assets. Applicable to Banks and Other Financial companies.
Income from Earning Assets [SIEI] includes:
• Trading Investments/Trading Account Income - Gain/(Loss) [SGTI]
• Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [SNFE]
• Investment Income - Gross - Investment [SGII]
• Interest & Dividend Income - Finance - Total [SIDT]
• Investment Securities - Business - Gain/(Loss) [SGLS]

Commissions and Fees [SCAF] represents the sum of Fees & Commissions from Operations, Comm./Fees from Securities Activities, Insurance Commissions, Fees & Premiums, Credit Card Fees, Fees for Other Customer Services and Real Estate Operation Gain for the fiscal period. Applicable to Banks.
Commissions and Fees [SCAF] includes:
• Net Commission & Fees Income/Expense - Business Revenue [SNCF]
• Net Income/Expense from Insurance - Bank [SNIR]

Occupancy Expense - Other [SOEO] represents costs related to occupying a building or premises, other than rental expense, property taxes and pre-opening expenses. Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Occupancy Expense - Other [SOEO] includes: 
• Other Occupancy Expense [EPOE]

Investment Securities - Business Unclassified - Gain/(Loss) [SVIU] represents net gains on investment securities, reported by financial companies. Applicable to Banks and Financial companies.
Investment Securities - Business Unclassified - Gain/(Loss) [SVIU] includes:
• Investment Securities - Business Unclassified - Gain/Loss [EVIU]

Banks additionally includes:
• Sale of Investments Held for Sale, Maturity & Trading - Gain/Loss [EGIT]

Settlement of Loans - Gain/(Loss) [SGSL] represents gains, net of losses, on the sale or early settlement of loans. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Settlement of Loans - Gain/(Loss) [SGSL] includes:
• Net Gains on Loan Sales [EGSL]

Other Operating Income - Total [SOOI] represent any other operating income which cannot be specifically collected under the granular FCC’s. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Operating Income - Total [SOOI] includes:
• Other Operating Income [EONT]
• Other Operating Income/Expense [EOIE] (if an income)

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Cost Reimbursements (in Revenue) [ROCR]

Investment Trust and Other Financial companies additionally includes:
• Cost Reimbursements (in Revenue) [ROCR]

provider_title: Interest Income - Deposits to Other Financial Institutions [SIDF]
provider_description:
Interest Income - Deposits to Other Financial Institutions [SIDF] represents interest income earned from deposits with financial institutions including funds with the central bank and loans made to other banks. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Income - Deposits to Other Financial Institutions [SIDF] includes:
• Bank Interest [RTBK]

Interest Expense - Collateralized Financing [SELR] represents interest payable on repurchase agreements (REPOs), collateralized financing agreements and securities sold, applicable to banks. It includes funds acquired from a financial institution for a limited period of time to cover reserve requirements, such as the federal funds purchased in the USA. Applicable to Banks.
Interest Expense - Collateralized Financing [SELR] includes:
• Interest Expense - Collateralized Financing [EFFS]

provider_title: Net Foreign Exchange Income/(Expense) - Business Revenue [SNFE] - Net gain or loss from foreign currency transactions. May include foreign currency translation gains if reported in the income statement (rather than in the statement of other comprehensive income). Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.
provider_description:
Net Foreign Exchange Income/(Expense) - Business Revenue [SNFE] - Net gain or loss from foreign currency transactions. May include foreign currency translation gains if reported in the income statement (rather than in the statement of other comprehensive income). Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.
Net Foreign Exchange Income/(Expense) - Business Revenue [SNFE] includes:
• Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [ENFE]

Supplementary Adjustments - Non-Operating - Decrease/(Increase) [SSPN] represents targeted data items disclosed by companies in the notes to the accounts but cannot be assigned to any item presented within the Income Statement. These items are deemed to be part of non-operating income/expenses and adjusted in here to ensure the item can be shown in its respective position and the statement is still balancing. Applicable to all Industries.

Foreign Exchange Gain/(Loss) [SFEGL] represents the sum of proceeds from the sale or redemption of investments in foreign currency and foreign currency contracts. Applicable to all Industries.
Foreign Exchange Gain/(Loss) [SFEGL] includes:
Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [ENFE]
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [EIFX]
• Foreign Exchange - Realized Gain/Loss - Capital [ERFC]
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Unrealized - Capital [EGLC]

provider_title: Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SGLI]
provider_description:
Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SGLI] represents proceeds from the sale or redemption of investment securities held for sale or maturity. Applicable to Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SGLI] includes:
• Investments Securities - Available for Sale/Held to Maturity - Realized Gain/Loss [EGLI]

Net Income/(Expense) from Insurance - Bank [SNIR] represents the total value of commissions, fees and premiums earned from taking insurance policy subscriptions, net of related costs such as claims and policy benefits. Applicable to Banks.  
Net Income/(Expense) from Insurance - Bank [SNIR] includes: 
• Premiums Earned & Other Income from Insurance - Bank - Total [SPEI]
• Claims & Benefits & Other Expenses Incurred from Insurance - Bank - Total [SCBE]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes:
• Insurance Income - Net - Bank [EIRD]

Operating Provisions - Increase/(Decrease) [SOPV] represents any movement in operating provisions such as maintenance expenses and provisions for risks and charges. Applicable to all industries.
Operating Provisions - Increase/(Decrease) [SOPV] includes:
• Operating Provisions [EOPR]

provider_title: Discontinued Operations before Tax - Total - Income/(Expense) [SDBT]
provider_description:
Discontinued Operations before Tax - Total - Income/(Expense) [SDBT] represents the value of all discontinued operations reported before income tax. Applicable to all Industries.
Discontinued Operations before Tax - Total - Income/(Expense) [SDBT] includes:
• Discontinued Operations before Tax [ZDBU]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Discontinued Operations before Tax - Income/Expense [SDCG]
• Sale of Discontinued Operations before Tax - Gain/Loss [SDDG]

Discontinued Operations before Tax - Income/(Expense) [SDCG] represents the gross current income and expenses generated by the operations of a business unit or subsidiary available for sale, before deduction of taxes. Applicable to all Industries.
Discontinued Operations before Tax - Income/(Expense) [SDCG] includes: 
• Discontinued Operations before Tax - Income/Expense [ZCDG]

provider_title: Sale of Discontinued Operations before Tax - Gain/(Loss) [SDDG]
provider_description:
Sale of Discontinued Operations before Tax - Gain/(Loss) [SDDG] represents any gain/loss from the sale of business unit or subsidiary before deducting the tax from discontinued operational items. Applicable to all Industries. 
Sale of Discontinued Operations before Tax - Gain/(Loss) [SDDG] includes:
• Sale of Discontinued Operations before Tax - Gain/Loss [ZDDG]

provider_title: Operating Expenses - before Interest Expenses & Provision for Loan Losses - Total [STOE]
provider_description:
Operating Expenses - before Interest Expenses & Provision for Loan Losses - Total [STOE] represents a sum of net operating expenses/income which are either not specified as being for plant hire, fixed asset rentals, depreciation/amortization, marketing, duties/taxes, exchange losses, research/development or exploration or which may represent a combination of some or all of these items (Other Operating Income/Expense - Net [SOIE]), all costs of operating a business other than the costs of readying a product for sale (Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SSGA]) and total cost of goods and services sold (Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]). Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.
Operating Expenses - before Interest Expenses & Provision for Loan Losses - Total [STOE] includes:
• Selling, General & Administrative Expenses - Total [SSGA]
• Other Operating Income/Expense - Net [SOIE]

Financial companies additionally includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Cost of Financing-Related Operations [SCFS] (deducted)
• Dividends to Policy Holders [SDPH]
• Expenses from Banking Operations - Insurance [SEBO]
• Insurance Claims/Reserves - Total [STIC]
• Underwriting Expenses [SUWE]

In the absence of the breakdown above it includes Operating Expenses - Total [XTOE].

Policy Acquisition Costs - Other [SOPA] represents an insurance company’s policy acquisition costs, other than underwriting commissions and the amortization of deferred acquisition costs. It includes reinsurance commissions received (reducing the total value of acquisition costs). Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Policy Acquisition Costs - Other [SOPA] includes: 
• Policy Acquisition Costs - Other [EPAO]

provider_title: Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SDES]
provider_description:
Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SDES] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of tangible fixed assets to expenses over those periods expected to benefit from the use of the assets. This represents all depreciation (pure value or combined with amortization) reported within the selling, general and administrative expenses. Applicable to all Industries.  
Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [SDES] includes:
• Depreciation in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EDES]
• Depreciation & Amortization in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EDAS]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EDLS]
• Depreciation in Research & Development Expenses [EDRD]
• Depreciation & Amortization Expense in Research & Development Expenses [EDAR]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Research & Development Expenses [EDRL]

If there is no Cost of sales, this will also includes:
• Depreciation & Amortization [EDAE]
• Depreciation [EDEP]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EDLR]

Income Taxes - Other (by Type) [SOTX] represents the sum of other income taxes not specified as current or deferred. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Other (by Type) [SOTX] includes:
• Income Taxes - Other - Deferred/Current [VOTO]
• Income Taxes - Other - Domestic [VOTD]
• Income Taxes - Other - Local [VOTL]
• Income Taxes - Other - Foreign [VOTF]
• Research & Development Expense - Tax Credit [ERTC] (deducted)

Trust Income [STRU] represents income derived from services rendered in a fiduciary capacity, other than investment asset management fees. Applicable to Bank and Investment Trust companies. 
Trust Income [STRU] includes:  
• Trust Income [ETIN]

provider_title: Premiums Earned & Other Income from Insurance - Bank - Total [SPEI]
provider_description:
Premiums Earned & Other Income from Insurance - Bank - Total [SPEI] represents commissions, fees and premiums earned from taking insurance policy subscriptions, before subtracting (gross) related costs. Applicable to Banks.
Premiums Earned & Other Income from Insurance - Bank - Total [SPEI] includes:  
• Insurance Income - Gross - Bank [EPEI]

Utility Revenue - Total [SRVU] represents revenue from sale of utility commodities and services to the public and to other governments. Does not include amounts from sales to the parent government. Also excludes income from utility fund investments and from other nonoperating properties (treated as General revenue). Any monies from taxes, special assessments, and intergovernmental revenue are classified as General revenue, not Utility revenue. Applicable to industrial companies.
Utility Revenue - Total [SRVU] includes:
•Utility Revenue - Other Utility Operations[SOUR]
•Utility Revenue - Steam Operations[SSOP]
•Utility Revenue - Water Operations[SWAT]
•Utility Revenue - Gas Operations[SGOP]
•Utility Revenue - Electric Operations[SEOP]
•Utility Revenue - Non-Utility Operations[SNUR]

Utility Revenue - Gas Operations [SGOP] represents revenue from regulated sales of gas through local distribution establishments. The sale of gas is regulated by local authorities. It also includes service charges related to gas distribution and the transmission of gas through pipelines or gas transportation via ships. Applicable to Utility companies with Natural Gas operations. 
Utility Revenue - Gas Operations [SGOP] includes: 
• Utility Revenue - Gas Operations [RGOP]

Cost of Revenues - Other - Total [SCOS] represent the sum of all other costs of sales not related directly with production. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment companies.
Cost of Revenues - Other - Total [SCOS] includes:
• Cost of Revenues - Other [EOCG]

Industrial and Property companies additionally includes:
• Merchandise & Finished Goods - Ending Balance [EMFG] (Deducted)
• Merchandise & Finished Goods - Opening Balance [EBMF]
• Cost of Purchased Merchandise [ECPM]
• Cost of Products Manufactured [ECMA]
• Transfer from/to Other Account [ETOA]

Industrial companies additionally includes:
• External Expenses - Third Parties - Other [EOXE]
• Fuel & Oil Expense [EFOE]
• Lease Operating Expenses (Oil & Gas Industry) [ELOE]
• Airport Charges/Fees [EAPC]
• Aircraft Operating Lease Costs [EAOL]
• Aircraft Maintenance [EAMT]
• Programming Costs [EPRC]
• Network Costs [ENWC]
• Royalties/Licenses - Government [EGRL]
• Decommissioning & Rehabilitation Costs [EDRC]
• Production Expenses/Mining Costs/Cost of Sales [EPMC]
• Gaming Taxes [EGTX]

provider_title: Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP] - Exploration expenses mainly applicable for mining, oil and gas industries. Includes dry hole expenses and exploration/dry hole expenses written off but excludes impairment of exploration and dry hole expenses
provider_description:
Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP] - Exploration expenses mainly applicable for mining, oil and gas industries. Includes dry hole expenses and exploration/dry hole expenses written off but excludes impairment of exploration and dry hole expenses
The cost of collecting and analyzing geophysical and seismic data in potential crude oil or natural gas exploration sites, as well as the cost of drilling wells. The item is mainly applicable for mining, oil and gas industries. Applicable to all Industries.
Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP] includes:
• Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [EEXP]

Property & Other Taxes [SPTX] represents property taxes and indirect taxes other than income taxes reported under expenses other than the cost of revenue section. Applicable to all Industries.
Property & Other Taxes [SPTX] includes:
• Property & Other Taxes [EPOT]

Accretion - Site Closure & Reclamation Expenses [SSCR] represents accretion of the costs that an extraction company will incur in the future, for the closure of a mine and restoring the natural environment to its previous shape. Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Accretion - Site Closure & Reclamation Expenses [SSCR] includes: 
• Accretion - Site Closure & Reclamation Expenses [EASR]

Impairment - Oil & Gas Assets [SIOG] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of oil and natural gas assets by extraction companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Impairment - Oil and Gas Assets [SIOG] includes:
• Impairment - Oil & Gas Assets [EIOG]

provider_title: Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, Amortization & Exploration Expenses (EBITDAX) [SEBITDAX]
provider_description: Earnings before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, Amortization & Exploration Expenses (EBITDAX) [SEBITDAX] represents a sum of Earnings before Interest, Taxes & Depreciation [SEBITDA] and exploration expenses mainly applicable for mining, oil and gas industries (Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP]).

provider_title: Exploration Expenses and Interest Expenses (After Tax) [SIEEXP]
provider_description:
Exploration Expenses and Interest Expenses (After Tax) [SIEEXP] represents the sum of exploration expenses mainly applicable for mining, oil and gas industries  and interest expense net of capitalized  adjusted by income tax rate. Applicable for Industrial companies.
Exploration Expenses and Interest Expenses (After Tax) [SIEEXP] includes:
• Exploration/Dry Hole Expenses (including Write-Off) [SEXP] & 
• Interest Expense - Net of Capitalized Interest [SIEN] (adjusted by the tax rate)

Interest Capitalized [SICA] represents interest charges deferred to a company's property, plant and equipment account, amortized over the life of the related assets. It reflects only the portion of interest on an asset that is amortized during the fiscal period. Applicable to Industrial, Insurance, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies. 
Interest Capitalized [SICA] includes:
• Interest Capitalized [ECAP]
• Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Debt Portion (AFUDC) [SAFD]

Rental Expense [SRXP] represents operating lease/rental expenses reported outside the cost of goods sold. Applicable to all industries. 
Rental Expense [SRXP] includes: 
• Rental Expense [ERXP]

provider_title: Contributions & Transfer to Bank Guarantee Fund [SBGF]
provider_description:
Contributions & Transfer to Bank Guarantee Fund [SBGF] represents a bank guarantee fund to cover banking customer deposits. Legislation in some markets requires banks to supply the required funds, i.e. banks are making contributions and transfers to the bank guarantee fund. Applicable to Banks.
Contributions & Transfer to Bank Guarantee Fund [SBGF] includes:
• Contributions & Transfer to Bank Guarantee Fund [EBGF]

provider_title: Cost of Financing-Related Operations [SCFS] refers to total direct costs relating to financial operations. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
provider_description:
Cost of Financing-Related Operations [SCFS] refers to total direct costs relating to financial operations. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies. 
Cost of Financing-Related Operations [SCFS] includes:
• Cost of Financing-Related Operations [ECFU]

Industrial and Financial companies additionally includes:
• Interest Expense - Operational Financing - Business - Total [EBMI]
• Interest Expense - Business - Total [EIEU]
• Interest Expenses - Other [EEOI]
• Interest - Other Borrowings [EIEF]

Investment companies additionally includes:
• Interest Expense - Operational Financing - Business - Total [EBMI]

Fair Value Adjustments - Financial Investments [SFVI] represents fair value re-measurements of financial investments. Fair value adjustments may reflect a change to key assumptions required by accounting standards, resulting in a different valuation of financial instruments. Applicable to all Industries.
Fair Value Adjustments - Financial Investments [SFVI] includes: 
• Fair Value Adjustments - Financial Investments [EFVI]

provider_title: DPS - Special - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SSDSGI]
provider_description:
DPS - Special - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SSDSGI] represents special dividends per share before taxes, paid to common shareholders. A special dividend is a once-off payment, and typically occurs when a company makes a distribution from a portion of its unusually large profits, retained earnings or capital disclosed at company level and per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Special - Gross - Issue - By Announcement Date [SSDSGI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Special - Issue Specific [XSDSGI]

Impairment - Goodwill [SIGO] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of company acquisition costs (goodwill). These assets are retained by the reporting company. Applicable to all industries.
Impairment - Goodwill [SIGO] includes:
• Impairment - Goodwill [EIGO]

provider_title: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses on Investments [SIMP] is a U.S.-GAAP accounting concept. In case a loss on certain investments is considered permanent, U.S. companies are required to write down the loss and disclose it in the income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses on Investments [SIMP] is a U.S.-GAAP accounting concept. In case a loss on certain investments is considered permanent, U.S. companies are required to write down the loss and disclose it in the income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses on Investments [SIMP] includes:
• Other than Temporary Impairment Losses on Investments [RIMP]

Revenue Taxes [SEXT] represents government-levied tax on the manufacture, sale, or consumption of goods and services included in the sale price, collected by the seller, and returned to the government. The tax can be imposed at any trade level and can either be a specific tax or a value-added tax (percentage of value). The excise taxes receipts are used only when receipts of excise taxes are clearly identified as revenue in the income statement of a company. (In most cases, this item appears twice, once as income (collected from customers) and as expense (paid to the government). Major markets reporting Excise Tax are India, Pakistan, United States, Brazil, Sri Lanka and Hong Kong. The polarity of the item is the opposite of gross sales, i.e. it is collected with the positive sign although this is a cost. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Revenue Taxes [SEXT] includes:
• Excise Tax Expense [REXT]

Dividends to Policy Holders [SDPH] represents dividend transfers to policy holders. It represents amounts distributed or credited to holders of participating policies (i.e. those entitled to a share of the profits). Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Dividends to Policy Holders [SDPH] includes:
• Dividends to Policy Holders [ELBD]

Amortization of Computer Software - Supplemental [SASW] represents amortization of computer software for the period. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Computer Software - Supplemental [SASW] includes:
• Amortization of Computer Software - Supplemental [VASW]

If the account above is not available, it includes: 
• Amortization of Computer Software [EASW]
• Amortization of Computer Software in Cost of Revenues [EASC]
• Amortization of Computer Software in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EASS]

provider_title: Sale of Discontinued Operations - Net - Gain/(Loss) [SXDD]
provider_description:
Sale of Discontinued Operations - Net - Gain/(Loss) [SXDD] represents any gain/loss from the sale/disposal of business unit or subsidiary, net of tax. Applicable to all industries. 
Sale of Discontinued Operations - Net - Gain/(Loss) [SXDD] includes: 
• Sale of Discontinued Operations - Net - Gain/Loss [ZDDN]

Dividend & Investment Income [SIDN] represents income from investments in shares of companies not valued using the equity method. Includes related tax credits and income from trade investments where not shown separately. Applicable to all Industries. 
Dividend/Investment Income [SIDN] includes: 
• Dividend & Investment Income [EIDT]

Impairment - Financial Investments [SIVO] represents non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of investment assets or provisions against investment assets. Applicable to all Industries.
Impairment - Financial Investments [SIVO] includes:
• Impairment - Financial Investments [EIVO]

Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/(Loss) [SDHN] represents income or losses arising from derivative assets held for hedging purposes, i.e. for the purpose of limiting a company’s operating risks. The code is used when a company does not specify the precise nature of hedging income (such as realized and unrealized gains). Applicable to all Industries.
Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/(Loss) [SDHN] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [EGLD]

Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/(Loss) - Total - Supplemental [SGLD] represents the total value of income or losses arising from derivative assets that are held for hedging purposes. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/(Loss) - Total - Supplemental [SGLD] includes:
• Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging - Supplemental [SUAD]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/(Loss) - Total - Supplemental [SDRG]
• Trading Derivatives - Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [STDG]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/Loss [EGLD]

Unearned Premiums [SPUP] represents change in premiums received but not yet earned (written). This is the gross value, before unearned premiums ceded to reinsurers.
Unearned premiums represent the pro rata portion of the premiums in force, applicable to the unexpired period of the policy term. Premiums received from non-life policies are earned (written) over the passage of time, while the unearned portion reduces gross premiums written.
Changes in unearned premiums can either increase or reduce gross premiums. Applicable to Insurancecompanies.
Unearned Premiums [SPUP] includes:
• Unearned Premiums - Change [RRIU]

Insurance Benefits Ceded [SIBP] represents the portion of current insurance claims and long-term insurance reserves that was refunded by reinsurance companies. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Insurance Benefits Ceded [SIBP] includes: 
• Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Ceded [SLBC]
• Long-Term Insurance Reserves Ceded [SLRC]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Insurance Claims & Benefits/Reserves Ceded -Total [ELBP]

Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Ceded [SLBC] represents an insurance company’s portion of current insurance claims and benefits that was refunded by reinsurance companies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Ceded [SLBC] includes:
• Current Insurance Claims & Benefits Ceded [ELBC]

Long-Term Insurance Reserves Ceded [SLRC] represents an insurance company’s portion of the change in long-term insurance reserves, such as reserves for claims, losses and benefits that was refunded by reinsurance companies. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Long-Term Insurance Reserves Ceded [SLRC] includes:
• Long-Term Insurance Reserves Ceded [EIRC]

provider_title: Unclassified Underwriting Expense - Other [SODE] - Underwriting costs other than, or not specified as, policy acquisition costs, insurance claims/reserves, and dividends to policyholders. Applicable to Insurance companies.
provider_description:
Unclassified Underwriting Expense - Other [SODE] - Underwriting costs other than, or not specified as, policy acquisition costs, insurance claims/reserves, and dividends to policyholders. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Unclassified Underwriting Expense - Other [SODE] includes:
• Underwriting Expense - Other [EODE]

provider_title: Revenue from Financing-Related Operations [SFRO] refers to other revenues related to financing operations. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
provider_description:
Revenue from Financing-Related Operations [SFRO] refers to other revenues related to financing operations. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Revenue from Financing-Related Operations [SFRO] is computed and represents the following:
Industrial and Property:
• Business-Related Financing Revenue - Other [SOFB] 

Property:
• Dividend income - Investments [SDII]
• Interest income - Investment [SIII]

Investment Expense - Insurance - Total [SIIE] represents the total investment expenses of an insurance company. Applicable to Insurance companies..
Investment Expense - Insurance [SIIE] includes:
• Investment Expense - Insurance [RNIE]
• Net Foreign Exchange Income - Business Revenue [ENFE] (if an expense)
• Financial Income - Total [XTFI] (if an expense)
• Net Financing Income/Expense [XNFI] (if an expense)

Investment Gain/(Loss) - Other [SGIO] represents net investment gains or losses on asset types other than trading account, investments held to maturity, investments available for sale, investments designated at fair value, and hedging derivatives, not specified as realized or unrealized. Applicable to Banks and Investment companies. 
Investment Gain/(Loss) - Other [SGIO] includes: 
• Investment Gain/Loss - Other [EGIO]

Extraordinary Items [SXTR] represents events and transactions that are distinguished by their unusual nature, by the infrequency of their occurrence, and the materiality of their impact on the earnings of the company, reported after income taxes.  Applicable to all Industries.
Extraordinary Items [SXTR] includes:
• Extraordinary Items [XTRA]
• Income Taxes - Non-Recurring Tax Change Impact [VTXC] (deducted)
• COVID-19 Income Taxes - Non-Recurring Charge/(Credit) [SCXC] (deducted)

Foreign Exchange Gain/(Loss) - Non-Business [SIFX] represents the net result on foreign currency exchange. Applicable to Industrial, Insurance, Property, Investment and Financial companies. 
Foreign Exchange Gain/(Loss) - Non-Business [SIFX] includes:
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Non-Business [EIFX]

After-Tax Adjustments - Other - Income/(Expense) - Total [SOAN] represents adjustments to net income reported after taxes but before equity in earnings, minority interest, extraordinary items, discontinued operations and preferred dividends. It includes Zakat, the impact of discontinued operations reported before taxes on total taxes payable for the period and adjustment of special reserve. Applicable to all Industries.
After-Tax Adjustments - Other - Income/(Expense) - Total [SOAN] includes:
• Profit Transfer [CPFT]
• Wealth Taxes [CTWT] (deducted)
• After-Tax Adjustments - Other [COAN]
• Estimated Tax Impact on Pre-tax Discontinued Operations [SETD]
• Zakat [SZKT]
• After-Tax Adjustments - Special Reserves [SASR]

Utility Revenue - Water Operations [SWAT] represents revenue from the regulated distribution of water through local distribution establishments. The distribution of water is regulated by local authorities. Applicable to Utility companies with Water operations. 
Utility Revenue - Water Operations [SWAT] includes: 
• Utility Revenue - Water Operations [RWAT]

Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE] represents costs for operations and maintenance of power generating plants by electric utility companies, and maintenance of distribution facilities by utility companies. A significant portion of Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE] may represent depreciation and maintenance of local distribution facilities such as power lines and gas pipelines. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE] includes:
• Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [EDOE]

provider_title: Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Debt Portion (AFUDC) [SAFD]
provider_description:
Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Debt Portion (AFUDC) [SAFD] represents a non-cash item representing the estimated interest costs of debt used to finance construction (capitalized for utility company). Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Debt Portion (AFUDC) [SAFD] includes:
• Allowance for Funds Used during Construction - Debt Portion (AFUDC) [EAFD]

Generation Cost [SGENC] represents total cost of goods and services sold including costs for operations and maintenance of power generating plants by electric utility companies, and maintenance of distribution facilities by utility companies. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Generation Cost [SGENC] includes:
• Cost of Operating Revenue [SCOR]
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Expense [SFEX]
• Operations & Maintenance (Utility) [SDOE]
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Purchased Power [SPPW]
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Purchased for Resale [SFPR]

Water & Steam Revenue [SWREV] represents regulated revenue from the distribution of water and steam through local distribution establishments. Applicable to Utility companies.
Water & Steam Revenue [SWREV] includes:
• Utility Revenue - Steam Operations [SSOP]
• Utility Revenue - Water Operations [SWAT]

provider_title: DPS - Special - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SSDSNI]
provider_description:
DPS - Special - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SSDSNI] represents special dividends per share after taxes, paid to common shareholders. A special dividend is a once-off payment, and typically occurs when a company makes a distribution from a portion of its unusually large profits, retained earnings or capital disclosed at company level and per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all Industries.
DPS - Special - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SSDSNI] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Special - Net - Issue Specific [XSDSNI]

Material Expenses [SMAT] represents the sum of all material costs of goods and services sold. It includes the cost of materials used for the production of goods or for the delivering of services, utility company's cost of electric power purchased for further resale, costs of work performed for the company's own benefit that have been capitalized, cost of natural gas purchased for resale by gas utility companies and net change in the value of inventories. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Material Expenses [SMAT] Includes:
• Material Expenses - Materials, Inventory, Own Work & Utility - Unclassified [SMAU]
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Expense [SFEX]
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Purchased for Resale [SFPR]
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Purchased Power [SPPW]
• Own Work Capitalized [SOWC]
• Changes in Inventory [SCII]
• Materials Purchased [SMPR]
• Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [SREX]

provider_title: Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Expense [SFEX]
provider_description:
Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Expense [SFEX] represents a utility company's cost of fuel used for generating electricity, water, or steam for distribution. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Expense [SFEX] includes:
• Utility Cost of Revenue - Fuel Expense [EFEX]

provider_title: Gross Revenue from Business Activities - Total [SREV]
provider_description:
Gross Revenue from Business Activities - Total [SREV] represents gross receipts from the sales of products and services, before trade discounts, excise taxes, and sales returns and allowances. Major markets reporting Gross revenues are India, Taiwan, Turkey, Brazil, United States and Pakistan.
Includes any net sales item that is not a section total (such as Total Revenue - XTLR). Applicable to Industrial companies.
Gross Revenue from Business Activities - Total [SREV] includes:
• Sales of Goods & Services - Gross [RREV]

provider_title: Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [SDUA]
provider_description:
Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [SDUA] represents the unrealized fair value changes of derivative assets held for hedging purposes. Applicable to all industries.
Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [SDUA] includes:
• Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [EDEO]

provider_title: Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging - Supplemental [SUAD]
provider_description:
Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging - Supplemental [SUAD] represents the unrealized fair value changes of derivative assets held for hedging purposes. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging - Supplemental [SUAD]  includes:
• Unrealized Adjustments on Derivatives for Hedging [EDEO]

Pre-Opening Expenses [SPOE] represents costs incurred in the formation of a firm, prior to a firm opening its doors for business. This item may also be referred to as preliminary expenses or start up expenses. Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Pre-Opening Expenses [SPOE] includes:
• Pre-Opening Expenses [EPRE]

Non-Recurring Adjustments - Non-Operating - Decrease/(Increase) [SNRN] represents non-recurring adjustments disclosed by companies in a note either to Pretax Profit/Profit before Taxation or not pointing to any subtotal in the Income Statements. These cannot be allocated to a specific data point within the Income Statements and are treated as a component to Non-Operating Income/Expenses. Applicable to all Industries.

provider_title: Claims & Benefits & Other Expenses Incurred from Insurance - Bank - Total [SCBE]
provider_description:
Claims & Benefits & Other Expenses Incurred from Insurance - Bank - Total [SCBE] represents claims, benefits and other expenses incurred from the insurance business by banks that are involved in insurance as a secondary business activity. Applicable to Banks.
Claims & Benefits & Other Expenses Incurred from Insurance - Bank - Total [SCBE] includes:  
• Insurance Expenses - Bank [ECBI]

Impairment - Intangibles excluding Goodwill [SIIO] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of intangibles other than goodwill. These assets are retained by the reporting company. Applicable to all Industries.
Impairment - Intangibles Excluding Goodwill [SIIO] includes:
• Impairment - Intangibles excluding Goodwill [EIIO]

provider_title: DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - DR - By Announcement Date [SDPSGIDR]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - DR - By Announcement Date [SDPSGIDR] represents dividends per common share before taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all industries.
DPS - Common - Gross - Issue - DR - By Announcement Date [SDPSGIDR] includes:
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - by Declaration Date [DPSCDD] (Divided by DR ratio)
• Dividends Per Share - Common - Gross - Issue Specific [XDPSGI] (Divided by DR ratio)

provider_title: DPS - Common - Net - Issue - DR - By Announcement Date [SDPSNIDR]
provider_description:
DPS - Common - Net - Issue - DR - By Announcement Date [SDPSNIDR] represents represents dividends per common share after taxes, disclosed per specific share issue on the day on which a company announces its intention to pay dividends to its shareholders. Applicable to all industries. 
DPS - Common - Net - Issue - DR - By Announcement Date [SDPSNIDR] includes:
• DPS - Common - Net - Issue - By Announcement Date [SDPSNI] (Divided by DR ratio)

Trusts & Fiduciary Income/Commission & Fees [STCF] represents commissions and fees derived from services rendered in a fiduciary or trust capacity, net of related costs other than investment asset management fees. Applicable to Investment Trust companies.
Trusts & Fiduciary Income/Commission & Fees [STCF] includes:  
• Fees & Commissions Income [SCFI]
• Trust Income [STRU]

In the absence of the breakdown above, it includes Net Commissions & Fees from Fiduciary Activities [ETCF].

Changes in Inventory [SCII] represents net changes in the value of inventories. Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Changes in Inventory [SCII] includes:
• Changes in Inventory [EIDS]

provider_title: Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development Expenses - Supplemental [SARD]
provider_description:
Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development Expenses - Supplemental [SARD] represents amortization of reasearch and development for the period. Applicable to all industries. 
Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development Expenses - Supplemental [SARD] includes:
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development Expenses - Supplemental[VRDA]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development in Cost of Revenues [EARC]
• Amortization of Capitalized Research & Development in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EARS]
• Amortization excluding Goodwill in Research & Development Expenses [EARD]

provider_title: Sale of Leased Fixed Assets - Gain/(Loss) [SGLL]
provider_description:
Sale of Leased Fixed Assets - Gain/(Loss) [SGLL] represents gain or loss on the difference between the selling and purchasing prices of leased fixed assets. Applicable to Industrial, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Sale of Leased Fixed Assets - Gain/(Loss) [SGLL] includes:
• Sale of Leased Fixed Assets - Gain/Loss [EGLL]

Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/(Loss) [SNDE] represents realized gains or losses on the effective portion of hedging contracts. Effective hedging gains are those hedging results that were initially reported as hedging valuation result in other comprehensive income. Once the hedging contract matures or is sold, such gains or losses are expensed in the income statement. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/(Loss) [SNDE] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/Loss [EDEF]

provider_title: Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/(Loss) - Total - Supplemental [SDRG]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/(Loss) - Total - Supplemental [SDRG] represents the total value of realized gains or losses on the effective portion of hedging contracts.Effective hedging gains are those hedging results that were initially reported as hedging valuation result in other comprehensive income. Once the hedging contract matures or is sold, such gains or losses are expensed in the income statement. This is a specific type of realized gains/losses on hedging derivatives. Applicable to Industrial, Property and Investment Trust companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/(Loss) - Total - Supplemental [SDRG] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDEG]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDIG]
• Early Termination of Derivatives - Hedging - Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDTG] 
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/Loss [EDRG]

Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDEG] represents realized gains or losses on the effective portion of hedging contracts. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDEG] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Effective Gain/Loss [EDEF]

Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [STAMD] represents the maximum value of amortization of deferred charges reported by the company in the income statement, cash flow or notes. It is used in the calculation of ratios and analytics such as Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA). Applicable to all industries.
Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [STAMD] includes:
• Amortization of Deferred Charges - Total [TAMD]

Royalty Income - Business [SROI] represents income from royalties (payments for the right to use certain assets). Applicable to Industrial companies. It includes income received from the use of copyrighted materials or natural resource extractions. 
Royalty Income - Business [SROI] includes: 
• Royalty Income - Business [RROI]

provider_title: Gain/(Loss) on Sale of Financial Instruments - Other [SGFI]
provider_description:
Gain/(Loss) on Sale of Financial Instruments - Other [SGFI] represents gain/loss from investments and other financial instruments which are designated at fair value through profit and loss, not specified as realized or unrealized. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Gain/(Loss) on Sale of Financial Instruments - Other [SGFI] includes:
• Net Loss from Financial Instruments Designated at Fair Value [EGFI]

provider_title: Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]
provider_description:
Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI] represents the weighted average common shares outstanding used to calculate earnings and other per share items, per specific share issue. Applicable to all Industries.
Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [BWASI]

provider_title: Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [SDWSI]
provider_description:
Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [SDWSI] represents diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item. To be used at instrument level. Applicable to all Industries.
Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [SDWSI] includes:
• Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific [DWASI]

Hotel Revenue [SHRV] represents the sum of all revenues generated by industrial and property companies with hotel operations. Applicable to Industrial & Property companies.
Hotel Revenue [SHRV] includes:  
Industrial:
• Hotel Revenue - Rooms [SHRR]
• Interest & Fees on Loans [SHRL]
• Hotel Revenue - Food & Beverages [SHRF]
• Hotel Revenue - Other [SHRO] Property:
• Hotel Revenue - Rooms [RHRR] 
• Hotel revenue – hotel lease income [RHRL]  
• Hotel Revenue - Food & Beverages [RHRF] 
• Hotel Revenue – Other [RHRO]
• Hotel Revenue [RHRV]

Hotel Revenue - Other [SHRO] represents other unspecified revenues generated by Industrial and Property companies with hotel operations. 
Hotel Revenues - Other [SHRO] includes: 
• Hotel Revenue - Other [RHRO]

Property Operating Expenses - Hotel [SPOH] represents property operating expenses incurred as part of hotel operations. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies with hotel operations. 
Property Operating Expenses - Hotel [SPOH] includes:
• Property Operating Expenses - Hotel [EPOH]

provider_title: Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BINCI]
provider_description:
Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BINCI] represents basic net income allocated to a particular share issue. Applicable to all industries.
Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [BINCI] includes:
• Allocated Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [XBINCI]

provider_title: Earnings Allocation Factor - Basic - Issue Specific [BEAFI]
provider_description:
Earnings Allocation Factor - Basic - Issue Specific [BEAFI] represents factor used to allocate part of company-level earnings per share to a specific share issue/instrument. Applicable to all industries.
Earnings Allocation Factor - Basic - Issue Specific [BEAFI] includes:
• Earnings Allocation Factor - Issue Specific [XBEAFI]

provider_title: Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINNCI]
provider_description:
Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINNCI] represents diluted net income allocated to a specific share issue. Applicable to all industries.
Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [DINNCI] includes:
• Allocated Diluted Net Income including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific [XDINCI]

provider_title: Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI]
provider_description:
Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI] represents the proportion of each share issue to the total profits of the company. It is being collected on the instrument level only for basic and diluted shares. This item is commonly not reported and in that case will be derived. For companies with single issue, Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI] is always equal to one. For companies with multiple issues, it is generally calculated as the number of weighted average shares of an issue divided by the combined weighted average shares of all the issues. The weighted shares used already take into account the ratio used to convert the secondary class of shares to primary equivalent. Applicable to all industries. 
Earnings Allocation Factor - Diluted - Issue Specific [DEAFI] includes:
• Diluted Earnings Allocation Factor - Issue Specific [XDEAFI]

Amortization of Deferred Financing Charges [SADF] represents costs relating to debt issuance expenses, financing costs, loan origination costs and mortgage service costs. Applicable to Industrial, Property, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Amortization of Deferred Financing Costs [SADF] includes:
• Amortization of Deferred Financing Charges [EADF]

provider_title: Provision for Income Tax by Region - Total [SPAX] includes all taxes based on profits that may be owed to federal, State and/or foreign government. These taxes do not include regressive taxes, such as sales taxes or excise taxes to state and federal government. It includes income taxes incurred by affiliated, associated and joint venture companies. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Provision for Income Tax by Region - Total [SPAX] includes all taxes based on profits that may be owed to federal, State and/or foreign government. These taxes do not include regressive taxes, such as sales taxes or excise taxes to state and federal government. It includes income taxes incurred by affiliated, associated and joint venture companies. Applicable to all Industries.
Provision for Income Tax by Region - Total [SPAX] includes:
• Income Taxes - Other (by Region) [SITO]
• Income Taxes - Foreign [SITF]
• Income Taxes - Domestic [SITD]

Income Taxes - Domestic [SITD] represents any tax provision attributable to its local tax jurisdictions segmented by geographic location of tax jurisdiction. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all industries.  Income Taxes - Domestic [SITD] includes:
• Income Taxes - Domestic (by Region) [VTDT]
• Income Taxes - Local (by Region) [VTLT]

Income Taxes - Foreign [SITF] represents income taxes payable in specific foreign jurisdictions. When a company reports its tax provision segmented by geographic location of tax jurisdiction, any tax provision attributable to non-domestic tax jurisdictions is classified as Income Taxes - Foreign [SITF]. This value is obtained from the notes of the financial statements. Applicable to all Industries.
Income Taxes - Foreign [SITF] includes:
• Income Taxes - Foreign (by Region) [VTFT]

Trading Investments - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SRTI] represents realized income or losses on the sale of trading account investment assets. Applicable to Banks and Financial companies.
Trading Investments - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SRTI] includes:  
• Trading Investments - Realized Gain/Loss [ERTI]

Other Comprehensive Income - Starting Line [SOCS] represents the net income reported by the company as the starting line in the other comprehensive income section. This line item needs to be collected irrespective of the fact whether the company reports it or not. If the starting line net income is not reported under the OCI, then we are supposed to pick the bottomline net income from Income Statement as the Net Income Starting line for OCI. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Starting Line [SOCS] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Starting Line [XOCS]

provider_title: Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN] includes other comprehensive income/losses arising from foreign currency differences which has not been accounted for in the income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN] includes other comprehensive income/losses arising from foreign currency differences which has not been accounted for in the income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency - Net of Tax [XCFN]

Other Comprehensive Income - Hedging Gain/(Loss) [SCHN] represents unrealized gains or losses from hedging and risk management operations, not shown in the income statement and included in the other comprehensive income. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Hedging Gain/(Loss) [SCHN] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Hedging Gain/Loss - Net of Tax [XCHN]

Other Comprehensive Income - Pension Related [SCPP] represents pension, post-retirement and healthcare plan income or losses reported in other comprehensive income that have not been accounted for in the income statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Pension Related [SCPP] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Pension Liabilities - Net of Tax [XCPN]

provider_title: Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP]
provider_description:
Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP] represents the sum of all items which have not been accounted for in the income statement.  Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP]  should not be confused with total comprehensive income which also comprises all income statement items. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [SCOP] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Net of Tax - Total [XCIN]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Foreign Currency [SCFN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Unrealized Investment Gain/Loss [SCGL]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Hedging Gain/Loss [SCHN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Revaluation of Tangible & Intangible Assets [SCRN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Other [SCOI]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Unearned Income [SCUN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Discontinued Operations [SCDN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Associated Companies [SCAN]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Pension Related [SCPP]
• Other Comprehensive Income - Income Tax [SITC]

provider_title: Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB]
provider_description:
Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] represents  the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items, before the exclusion of minority interests. Applicable to all Industries.
Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] includes:
• Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [XCIB]

If the account above is not available, it includes Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [XCIB].

provider_title: Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Minority Interest - Total [SCIM]
provider_description:
Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Minority Interest - Total [SCIM] represents minority interest reported as part of total comprehensive income. Includes the minority share of both net income and other comprehensive income. Mainly reported under International Financial Reporting Standards.
The share of total comprehensive income in subsidiaries that belongs to shareholders other than the parent company when the parent company owns less than 100%, but more than 50%, of a subsidiary. Since the subsidiary's financials are consolidated with the company, this value is a negative number to represent the amount the company does not own. Applicable to all Industries.
Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Minority Interest - Total [SCIM] includes:
• Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Minority Interest - Total [XCIM]

provider_title: Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE]
provider_description:
Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE] represents the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items before the exclusion of minority interests less the value of minority interest reported as part of total comprehensive income. Applicable to all Industries.
Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE] includes:
• Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Owners of Parent Company - Total [XCIE]

In the absence of above, it includes: 
• Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB]
• Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Minority Interest - Total [SCIM] (deducted)
• Comprehensive Income - Dividend on Preferred Stock [SDCI] (deducted).

provider_title: Comprehensive Earnings Per Share - Basic - Issue Specific [SCBEI]
provider_description:
Comprehensive Earnings Per Share - Basic - Issue Specific [SCBEI] represents the value of the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items (Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE]) divided by weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item. To be used at instrument level. (Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific [SBASI]). Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] as numerator if the account above is not available.

provider_title: Comprehensive Earnings Per Share - Diluted - Issue Specific [SCDEI]
provider_description:
Comprehensive Earnings Per Share - Diluted - Issue Specific [SCDEI] represents the value of the sum of all income statement and other comprehensive income items (Comprehensive Income - Attributable to Parent Company Equity Holders - Total [SCIE]) divided by diluted weighted average shares used to calculate earnings and other per share item (Shares used to calculate EPS - Diluted - Issue Specific [SDWSI]). Applicable to all Industries.

It uses Comprehensive Income before Minority Interest - Total [SCIB] as numerator if the account above is not available.

provider_title: Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Cost of Goods Sold - Supplemental [SDCR]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Cost of Goods Sold - Supplemental [SDCR] represents realized gains or losses on the sale, maturity or recognition of derivative assets, reported within the costs of goods sold, reclassified from OCI. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. 
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Cost of Goods Sold - Supplemental [SDCR] includes: 
• Reclassified from OCI) - Cost of Goods Sold - Supplemental [VDCG]

Hotel Revenue - Food & Beverages [SHRF] represents revenues generated by the food and beverages purchased by hotel customers. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies with hotel operations. 
Hotel Revenue - Food and Beverages [SHRF] includes: 
• Hotel Revenue - Food & Beverages [RHRF]

provider_title: Sales Returns, Allowances & Other Revenue Adjustments [SSRT] refers to reduction in gross sales resulting from merchandise being returned by customers or from the seller's reduction in the original sales price - a contra account to gross sales. It may consist of any merchandise returned for credit or cash refund, or a price reduction granted for damaged goods kept by the customer. Major markets reporting Allowances, Returns and Other Adjustments are Taiwan, Turkey, Brazil, India and United States.
provider_description:
Sales Returns, Allowances & Other Revenue Adjustments [SSRT] refers to reduction in gross sales resulting from merchandise being returned by customers or from the seller's reduction in the original sales price - a contra account to gross sales. It may consist of any merchandise returned for credit or cash refund, or a price reduction granted for damaged goods kept by the customer. Major markets reporting Allowances, Returns and Other Adjustments are Taiwan, Turkey, Brazil, India and United States.
The polarity of the item is the opposite of gross sales, i.e. it is collected with the positive sign although this is a cost. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Sales Returns, Allowances & Other Revenue Adjustments [SSRT] includes:
• Sales Returns, Allowances & Other Revenue Adjustments [RSRT]

Impairment - Investment Property [SIIN] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value write-down of investment property (land and/or buildings), held (by the owner or by the lessee under a finance lease) to earn rentals or for capital appreciation or both. (Investment property is an IFRS specific concept, under US-GAAP investments in land and buildings are accounted for as property, plant and equipment). Applicable to all Industries.
Impairment - Investment Property [SIIN] includes:
• Impairment - Investment Property [EINP]

provider_title: Debt Restructuring - Gain/(Loss) [SDRS] - Gains and losses related to the restructuring of the company's debt. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Debt Restructuring - Gain/(Loss) [SDRS] - Gains and losses related to the restructuring of the company's debt. Applicable to all Industries.
Debt Restructuring - Gain/(Loss) [SDRS] includes:
• Debt Restructuring - Gain/Loss [EDRS]

provider_title: Other Comprehensive Income - Unrealized Investment Gain/(Loss) [SCGL]
provider_description:
Other Comprehensive Income - Unrealized Investment Gain/(Loss) [SCGL] represents other comprehensive income or losses generated by the revaluation of investments which has not been accounted for in the Income Statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Unrealized Investment Gain/(Loss) [SCGL] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Unrealized Investment Gain/Loss - Net of Tax [XCGN]

provider_title: Non-Recurring Items - Impact on Income Tax [STNR]
provider_description:
Non-Recurring Items - Impact on Income Tax [STNR] represents taxes levied on non-recurring items reported in the document. Tax impact on the pretax non-recurring or special items reported in notes is collected here. Applicable to all industries.
• Non-Recurring Items - Impact on Income Tax [VNRT]

provider_title: Material Expenses - Materials, Inventory, Own Work & Utility - Unclassified [SMAU]
provider_description:
Material Expenses - Materials, Inventory, Own Work & Utility - Unclassified [SMAU] represents the total of all direct material costs of goods and services sold. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Material Expenses - Materials, Inventory, Own Work & Utility - Unclassified [SMAU] includes:
• Material Expenses - Materials, Inventory, Own Work & Utility [EMAT]

Non-Operating Rental Income [SRNI] represents operating lease/rental income. It equals gross rental revenues minus rental-related expenses. If a net amount is not disclosed, this item includes gross rental income. Applicable to Industrial, Bank, Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Non-Operating Rental Income [SRNI] includes:
• Rental Income - Net [EREI]

Trading Derivatives - Gain/(Loss) [SNDT] represents gains or losses arising from investments in derivative assets held for trading (speculative) purposes. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Trading Derivatives - Gain/(Loss) [SNDT] includes:
• Trading Derivatives - Gain/Loss [EDTR]

Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/(Loss) [SDIE] represents realized gains or losses on the ineffective portion of hedging contracts. Ineffective hedging gains are those hedging results that are expensed directly in the income statement. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/(Loss) [SDIE] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/Loss [EDIE]

Other Comprehensive Income - Other [SCOI] represents other comprehensive income not specified as related to foreign currency translation, unrealized investments, equity in affiliates, hedging, fixed asset revaluation, discontinued operations, unearned income, investment in associated companies or pension liabilities as well as all rounding adjustments. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Other [SCOI] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Other - Net of Tax [XCON]

Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDIG] represents realized gains or losses on the ineffective portion of hedging contracts.  Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [SDIG] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Ineffective Gain/Loss [EDIE]

Trading Derivatives - Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [STDG] represents gains or losses arising from investments in derivative assets held for trading (speculative) purposes. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Trading Derivatives - Gain/(Loss) - Supplemental [STDG] includes:
• Trading Derivatives - Gain/Loss [EDTR]

Fair Value Adjustments - Other Assets [SFVO] represents unrealized fair value changes of assets which are not specified as being investments, investment property, biological assets and trading or hedging derivatives. Applicable to all Industries.
Fair Value Adjustments - Other Assets [SFVO] includes: 
• Fair Value Adjustments - Other Assets [EFVO]

Non-Recurring Adjustments - Operating - Decrease/(Increase) [SNRO] represents non-recurring adjustments disclosed by companies in a note to Operating Profit/Profit from Operations. These cannot be allocated to a specific data point within operating income/expenses and is usually disclosed as a component to arrive at Operating Profit/Profit from Operations. Applicable to all Industries.

Other Comprehensive Income - Income Tax [SITC] represents income taxes on items reported within other comprehensive income. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Income Tax [SITC] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Income Tax [XCTT]

Utility Revenue - Other Utility Operations [SOUR] represents revenues from non-regulated sales of utility commodities and related services. Applicable to Utility companies. Note: Utility Revenue - Other Utility Operations has been used historically but has been discontinued (2010). 
Utility Revenue - Other Utility Operations [SOUR] includes: 
• Utility Revenue - Other Utility Operations [ROUR]

Amortization of Deferred Costs - Supplemental [SADC] represents the portion of previously paid and capitalized costs expensed to the income statement during the accounting period. This represents the total amortization value for the period, related to any charges not classified as either tangible fixed assets or intangible assets on the balance sheet. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Deferred Costs - Supplemental [SADC] includes:
• Amortization of Deferred Charges - Supplemental [VADC]

If account above is not available, it will be the sum of the following items:
• Amortization of Deferred Charges [EAMD]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges in Cost of Revenues [EADC]
• Amortization of Deferred Charges in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EADS]

provider_title: Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Revenue - Supplemental [SDRR]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Revenue - Supplemental [SDRR] represents realized gains or losses on the sale, maturity or recognition of derivative assets, reported within revenues which is reclassified from OCI. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. 
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Revenue - Supplemental [SDRR] includes: 
• Derivatives - Realized Gain/Loss (including Reclassified from OCI) - Revenue - Supplemental [VDRV]

provider_title: Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Other - Supplemental [SDOR]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Other - Supplemental [SDOR] represents realized gains or losses on the sale, maturity or recognition of derivative assets, allocated to other income statement items than revenues, costs of goods sold, interest expenses and other income statement items. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Other - Supplemental [SDOR] includes:
• Derivatives - Realized Gain/Loss (including Reclassified from OCI) - Other - Supplemental [VDOT]

Premiums Written - Gross - Life/Long-Term Insurance [SPWL] represents life insurance policy premiums written in the course of the accounting period, before the impact of provisions for unearned premiums and the portion of insurance premiums that was paid out or received from reinsurers. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Premiums Written - Gross - Life/Long-Term Insurance [SPWL] includes:
• Premiums Written - Gross - Life/Long-Term Insurance [RPWL]

Premiums Written - Gross - Non-Life/General Insurance [SPWN] represents non-life insurance policy premiums written in the course of the accounting period, before the impact of provisions for unearned premiums and the portion of insurance premiums that was paid out or received from reinsurers. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Premiums Written - Gross - Non-Life/General Insurance [SPWN] includes:
• Premiums Written - Gross - Non-Life/General Insurance [RPWN]

Trading Investments - Unrealized Gain/(Loss) [SUTI] represent unrealized gain/loss from fair value change of trading account investment securities. Applicable to Bank and Financial companies.
Trading Investments - Unrealized Gain/(Loss) [SUTI] includes:
• Trading Investments - Unrealized Gain/Loss [EUTI]

Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SRGD] represents realized gains or losses on the sale of derivative assets held for hedging purposes. Applicable to Insurance, Bank, Investment and Financial companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SRGD] includes: 
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/Loss [EDRG]

provider_title: Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Unearned [SRIU]
provider_description:
Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Unearned [SRIU] represents the portion of unearned insurance premiums that was ceded out to reinsurers, in exchange for the coverage of losses that the insurer might incur on unearned policies sold to clients. This item is usually a contra account to gross premiums. Applicable to Insurance companies. 
Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Unearned [SRIU] includes: 
• Premiums Ceded Out to Reinsurance - Unearned [RRIN]

provider_title: Other Comprehensive Income - Associated Companies [SCAN] - Other comprehensive income related to equity in affiliates, associated companies, joint ventures and unconsolidated subsidiaries which has not been accounted for in the Income Statement. Applicable to all Industries.
provider_description:
Other Comprehensive Income - Associated Companies [SCAN] - Other comprehensive income related to equity in affiliates, associated companies, joint ventures and unconsolidated subsidiaries which has not been accounted for in the Income Statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Associated Companies [SCAN] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Associated Companies - Net of Tax [XCAN]

Rental & Property-Related Operating Revenue [SRPT] represents property related operating revenues. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Rental & Property-Related Operating Revenue [SRPT] includes:
• Property-Related Operating Revenue - Rental, Development, Management & Other [RRPT]
• Property-Related Operating Revenue - Other [RPRO]
• Property Management Services Revenue [RPMS]
• Property Development Revenue [RPDR]
• Tenant Service Charge Reimbursements [RTSR]
• Rental Income - Gross [RGRI]
• Rental & Related Income - Gross [RRRI]

Property:
• Rental & Related Income - Gross [SRRI]
• Property Development Revenue [SPDR]
• Property Management Services Revenue [SPMR]
• Property-Related Operating Revenue - Other [SPRO]

In the absence of the above breakdown (Property) it includes:
• Property-Related Operating Revenue - Rental, Development, Management & Other [RRPT]

Rental & Related Income - Gross [SRRI] represents income earned from the use of property by a lessee. Gross rents received from land and building and other investment properties, including related service charges. Includes income derived from property and real estate. It includes direct operating cost/expenses charged out to tenant.  Applicable to Property companies.
Rental & Related Income - Gross [SRRI] includes:  
• Tenant Service Charge Reimbursements[SRTS]
• Rental Income - Gross [SGRI]

In the absence of above, it includes:
• Rental & Related Income - Gross [RRRI]

Rental Income - Gross [SGRI] represents income earned from the use of property by a lessee, before property operating costs. This item is applicable to Industrial and Property companies and may also be reported as part of the business and geographic segment information. 
Rental Income - Gross [SGRI] includes: 
• Rental Income - Gross [RGRI]

Property-Related Operating Revenue - Other [SPRO] represents other property-related revenues. Applicable to Property companies. 
Property Related Operating Revenue - Other [SPRO] includes: 
• Property-Related Operating Revenue - Other [RPRO]

provider_title: Non-Recurring Portion of Equity Earnings before Taxes [SNQA]
provider_description:
Non-Recurring Portion of Equity Earnings before Taxes [SNQA] represents the non-recurring portion of profits, arising from any source, accounted for by the equity method. Applicable to all industries. 
Non-Recurring Portion of Equity Earnings before Taxes [SNQA] includes:
• Non-Recurring Portion of Equity Earnings before Taxes [ENQA]

Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SNDR] represents realized gains or losses on the sale of derivative assets held for hedging purposes. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/(Loss) [SNDR] includes:
• Derivatives - Hedging - Realized Gain/Loss [EDRG]

provider_title: Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Interest Expenses - Supplemental [SDIR]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Interest Expenses - Supplemental [SDIR] represents realized gains or losses on the sale, maturity or recognition of derivative assets, reported as part of interest expenses, reclassified from OCI. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Interest Expenses - Supplemental [SDIR] includes:
• Derivatives - Realized Gain/Loss (including Reclassified from OCI) - Interest Expenses - Supplemental [VDIE]

provider_title: Property Operating Expenses - Real Estate Rental [SPOR]
provider_description:
Property Operating Expenses - Real Estate Rental [SPOR] represents costs incurred for the construction of buildings and premises for sale. Applicable to Property and Investment Trust companies. 
Property Operating Expenses - Real Estate Rental [SPOR] includes: 
• Property Operating Expenses - Real Estate Rental [EPOR]

Property Maintenance & Service Charges [EPMS] represents building or premises maintenance costs incurred by a property company. Applicable to Property companies.
Property Maintenance & Service Charges [EPMS] includes:
• Operating & Maintenance [EOAM]

Property-Related Acquisition Expenses [SPAE] represents expenses/costs incurred by property companies for the acquisition of properties. Applicable to Property companies.
Property-Related Acquisition Expenses [SPAE] includes:
• Property-Related Acquisition Expenses [EPAE]

Depreciation - Investment Property - Supplemental [SDEI] represents the accounting process of allocating the cost of investment property to expenses over the useful life of the property. Investment property is a property (land or a building or part of a building or both) held to earn rentals or for capital appreciation or both. Applicable to all industries.
Depreciation - Investment Property - Supplemental [SDEI] includes:
• Depreciation - Investment Property - Supplemental [VDEI]

In absence of above, it includes: 
• Depreciation - Investment Property [EDEI].

Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA - Company Reported [SNAE] represents earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and income taxes adjusted to exclude total stock-based compensation expense, costs incurred to spin-off, costs associated with business transformation plan, trademark royalty costs, gain or loss related to pre-spin off etc. Adjusted EBITDA differs from EBITDA in that adjusted EBITDA normalizes income and expenses since different companies may treat each type of income and expense differently. By standardizing cash flows and discounting anomalies that may occur, adjusted, or normalized, EBITDA can provide a useful measure of comparison when evaluating multiple companies.
