This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA - Company Reported [SNAE] includes:
• Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA [CNAE]

Non-Recurring/Unusual Items - Tax Impact [SCRTU] represents the as reported tax impact on unusual items. Applicable to all industries.
Non-Recurring/Unusual Items - Tax Impact [SCRTU] includes:
• Non-Recurring/Unusual Items - Tax Impact [CRTU]

provider_title: EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SBAIIDR]
provider_description:
EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SBAIIDR] represents the basic bottom line net income per share available to common shareholders, per depository receipt (DR) ratio of the underlying instrument. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SBAIIDR] includes:
• EPS - Basic - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [BEPSBIDR]

provider_title: EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SBCOIDR]
provider_description:
EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SBCOIDR] represents the as reported net income per share from continuing operations, per depository receipt (DR) ratio of the underlying instrument. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SBCOIDR] includes:
• EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [BEPSCIDR]

provider_title: EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific - DR [SBESIDR] representsNormalized Net Income - Bottom Line, per depository receipt (DR) ratio of the underlying instrument. Applicable to all industries.
provider_description:
EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific - DR [SBESIDR] representsNormalized Net Income - Bottom Line, per depository receipt (DR) ratio of the underlying instrument. Applicable to all industries.
EPS - Basic - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific - DR [SBESIDR] includes:
• Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by
• Shares used to calculate Basic EPS - Issue Specific - DR [SBASIDR]

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SDAIIDR]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SDAIIDR] represents the diluted bottom line net income per share available to common shareholders, per depository receipt (DR) ratio of the underlying instrument. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SDAIIDR] includes:
• EPS - Diluted - including Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [DEPSBIDR]

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SDCOIDR]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SDCOIDR] represents the as reported diluted net income per share from continuing operations, per depository receipt (DR) ratio of the underlying instrument. Applicable to all Industries.
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [SDCOIDR] includes:
• EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items Applicable to Common - Issue Specific - DR [DEPSCIDR]

provider_title: EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific - DR[SDESIDR]
provider_description:
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific - DR[SDESIDR] represents Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line, per Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific - DR. Applicale to all industries.
EPS - Diluted - excluding Extraordinary Items - Normalized - Issue Specific - DR[SDESIDR] includes:
•Normalized Net Income - Bottom Line [SIBL] divided by
•Shares used to calculate Diluted EPS - Issue Specific - DR[SDWSIDR]

provider_title: Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Total - Supplemental [SDAR]
provider_description:
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Total - Supplemental [SDAR] represents total realized gains or losses on the sale, maturity or recognition of derivative assets. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies. 
Derivatives - Realized Gain/(Loss) (including Reclassified from OCI) - Total - Supplemental [SDAR] includes:
• Derivatives - Realized Gain/Loss (including Reclassified from OCI) - Total - Supplemental [VDRM]

provider_title: Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Earnings - Company Reported [SNAN]
provider_description:
Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Earnings - Company Reported [SNAN] represents net earnings calculated in accordance with GAAP as adjusted for the impact of stock based compensation and other special items less related tax effects as well as net income/loss from discontinued operations.  Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Earnings are an alternative method used to measure the earnings of a company, and many companies report non-GAAP earnings in addition to their earnings as calculated through generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP). Some managers believe that these alternate figures provide a more accurate measurement of the company's financial performance. Companies use different terminologies such as Non-GAAP, Adjusted, Underlying, Core & Non-IFRS to report Non-GAAP measures. This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Earnings - Company Reported [SNAN] includes:
• Non-GAAP Adjusted Net Earnings [CNAN]

Non-GAAP EPS Diluted - Company Reported [SNED] represents non-GAAP diluted EPS reported by the company. The company may sometimes report different flavors of EPS like non-GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations, non-GAAP diluted EPS from discontinuing operations or non-GAAP diluted EPS but we should always collect bottom line EPS to this field i.e. collect diluted non-GAAP EPS including extraordinary items to this field. This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP EPS Diluted - Company Reported [SNED] includes:
• Non-GAAP EPS Diluted [CNED]

Non-GAAP Revenues - Company Reported [SNGR] represents revenues calculated in accordance with GAAP as adjusted for the impact of acquisitions, disposals, effects of divestures and changes in currency.This measure provides valuable additional information on the underlying sales performance of the business and is a key measure used internally. Companies use different terminologies such as Non-GAAP, Adjusted, Underlying, Core & Non-IFRS to report Non-GAAP revenues. This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP Revenues - Company Reported [SNGR] includes:
• Non-GAAP Revenues[CNGR]

Non-GAAP EPS Basic - Company Reported [SNEB] represents non-GAAP basic EPS reported by the company. The company may sometimes report different flavors of EPS like non-GAAP basic EPS from continuing operations, non-GAAP basic EPS from discontinuing operations or non-GAAP basic EPS but we should always collect bottom line EPS to this field i.e. collect basic non-GAAP EPS including extraordinary items to this field. This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP EPS Basic - Company Reported [SNEB] includes:
• Non-GAAP EPS Basic [CNEB]

Non-GAAP Operating Margin % - Company Reported [SNGM] represents non-GAAP income from operations divided by revenues. It includes operating profit calculated as per GAAP as adjusted for the impact of business disposals, acquisition and disposal related costs, impairments and other one-off items.   Companies use different terminologies such as Non-GAAP, Adjusted, Underlying, Core & Non-IFRS to report Non-GAAP operating margin. This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP Operating Margin % - Company Reported [SNGM] includes:
• Non-GAAP Operating Margin % [CNGM]

provider_title: Non-GAAP Income from Operations - Company Reported [SNOG]
provider_description:
Non-GAAP Income from Operations - Company Reported [SNOG] represents income from operations calculated in accordance with GAAP as adjusted for the impact of depreciation and amortization, stock-based compensation benefit or expense, impairment charges, restructuring charge or credit and other special items. Companies use different terminologies such as Non-GAAP, Adjusted, Underlying, Core & Non-IFRS to report Non-GAAP measures. This is collected as reported by the company. Applicable to all Industries.
Non-GAAP Income from Operations - Company Reported [SNOG] includes:
• Non-GAAP Income from Operations[CNGO]

provider_title: Variable Operating Lease Expenses - US GAAP [SVOLE]
provider_description: Variable Operating Lease Expenses - US GAAP [SVOLE] represents the portion of the payment made by a lessee to the lessor for the right to use an asset during the lease term that varies due to change in factors or circumstances at the commencement date of the lease. Variable Lease expense is dependent on an index or rate such as customer price index, interest rate or market rental rates. Amount of variable lease cost is recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for operating leases reported under US GAAP. Applicable to all industries.

COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SCVT] represents sum of non-recurring items, restructuring, one-time provisions, impairment & grants which are specific to COVID-19 impact. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Total [SCVT] is sum of:
• COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) - Other [SCOE]
• COVID-19 One-time Provisions [SCPR]
• COVID-19 Restructuring Charges & Provisions [SCRI]
• COVID-19 Impairment of Long-Term Assets [SCIO]
• COVID-19 One-time Government Grants [SCGR]

COVID-19 Restructuring Charges & Provisions [SCRI] represents expenses or provisions associated with the reorganization of certain functions, regrouping of divisions or closing of a facility/branch specifically due to COVID-19 impact. These may include the consolidation of divisions, relocation of facilities and/or employees, and employee termination costs associated measures taken due to COVID-19 crisis. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 Restructuring Charges & Provisions [SCRI] includes:
• COVID-19 Restructuring Charges & Provisions [ECRO]

Lease Expense -Total [SVLET] represents the total amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract. The data item is disclosed under the lease footnote. Applicable to all industries.
Lease Expense - Total [SVLET] includes:
• Lease Expense -Total [VLET]
If the account above is not available, the sum of the following will be collected:
• Operating /Rental Expense – Supplemental [SVRXP]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease ROU Assets - Supplemental [SVDLR]
• Amortization of Financial Lease ROU Assets - Supplemental [SVALR]
• Variable Lease Expense - Unclassified – Supplemental [SVLEU]
• Variable Operating Lease Expenses - US GAAP - Supplemental [SVOLE]
• Variable Financial Lease Expenses – Supplemental [SVFLE]
• Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities – Supplemental [SVIFL]
• Short-Term Lease Cost – Supplemental [SVSLC]
• Sublease Income – Supplemental [SVSLI]

Operating/Rental Expense – Supplemental [SVRXP] Represents rental expenses paid for offices, factories, machinery and equipment. It includes rent for operating leasing machinery/equipment. This is collected when it is reported in notes to the financial statement and which cannot be directly or indirectly associated with the face item.
Short-Term Lease Cost [SVSLC] represents amount of short-term lease cost for lease with term within one year. The data item is disclosed under the lease footnote. Applicable to all industries.
Sublease Income [SVSLI] represents amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense. The data item is disclosed under the lease footnote. Applicable to all industries.

provider_title: Depreciation - Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets - Supplemental [SDLR]
provider_description:
Depreciation - Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets - Supplemental [SDLR] represents total depreciation and amortization of the capitalized right to control the use of property, plant and equipment held under financial (capital) lease contracts. Applicable to all industries.
Depreciation - Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets - Supplemental [SDLR] includes:
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [VDLR]
In the absence of the above it inclues
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [EDLR]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EDLS]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Cost of Revenues [EDLC]
• Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets in Research & Development Expenses [EDRL]

provider_title: Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [SVDLR]
provider_description:
Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [SVDLR] represents the total depreciation or amortization of the capitalized right to control the use of property, plant and equipment held under financial (capital) lease contracts. It is collected when the total value is reported in the notes and cannot be directly or indirectly associated to any item on the face of the income statement. It is not collected if component values are already collected in their specific FCCs. Applicable to all industries.
Depreciation of Financial Lease Right-of-Use Assets [SVDLR] includes:
• The total depreciation or amortization of the right to use property, plant and equipment held under financial (capital) leases
• The total depreciation of tangible assets held under leasing contracts reported in the International Financial Reporting Standards

provider_title: Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [SREX]
provider_description:
Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [SREX] represents operating lease/rental expenses of a property company or industrial company with property operations, reported as part of cost of sales. Applicable to Industrial and Property companies.
Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [SREX] includes: 
• Ground leases/Rental Expenses in Cost of Revenues [EREX]

provider_title: Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities - Supplemental [SVIFL]
provider_description:
Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities - Supplemental [SVIFL] represents the interest expense on financial (capital) leases. The data item is disclosed under the lease footnote. Applicable to all industries.
Interest Expense on Financial Lease Liabilities [SVIFL] includes:
• Interest on right-of-use liabilities 
• Amortization of financial lease liabilities.

provider_title: Exceptional Claims & Benefits Paid (Catastrophes) [SETR] - Disaster Charges and Other Related Expenses refers to costs incurred due to any natural catastrophe or man made hazards such as hurricanes, tornadoes, windstorms, hailstorms, fires, explosions, earthquakes, tropical storms, floods, terrorist acts and other perils. Applicable to Insurance companies.
provider_description:
Exceptional Claims & Benefits Paid (Catastrophes) [SETR] - Disaster Charges and Other Related Expenses refers to costs incurred due to any natural catastrophe or man made hazards such as hurricanes, tornadoes, windstorms, hailstorms, fires, explosions, earthquakes, tropical storms, floods, terrorist acts and other perils. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Exceptional Claims & Benefits Paid (Catastrophes) [SETR] includes:
• Disaster Charges & Other Related Expenses [EETR]

provider_title: Reported - Tax Impact from Non-Recurring Items - Non-GAAP [SCRTI]
provider_description:
Reported - Tax Impact from Non-Recurring Items - Non-GAAP [SCRTI] represents the as reported tax impact on non-GAAP non-recurring items. Governing financial bodies require companies to report according to GAAP principles, the uniformity of which allows users to make comparisons with other companies in the same industry. Additionally, companies are allowed to report alternative or non-GAAP measures which provide the user with additional information on the company’s performance. When presenting non-GAAP financial information companies are required to disclose the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure as well as a reconciliation of the non-GAAP financial measure to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measure. Applicable to all industries. 
Reported - Tax Impact from Non-Recurring Items - Non-GAAP [SCRTI] includes:
• Reported - Tax Impact from Non-Recurring Items - Non-GAAP [CRTI]

COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) – Other [SCOE] represents non-recurring credit or charges incurred due to COVID-19 impact by the company. Non-recurring items apart from restructuring, one-time provisions, impairment & grants which are specific to COVID-19 impact is collected. Non-recurring income/expense may include a combination of events which cannot be separated or if the company is silent about the specific COVID-19 business impact. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/(Expense) – Other [SCOE] includes:
• COVID-19 Non-Recurring Income/Expense - Other [ECOI]

COVID-19 Impairment of Long-Term Assets [SCIO] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned write-down of long-term assets due to the impact of COVID-19. Impairment of long-term assets such as tangible, intangible and long-term investment specifically written-off due to COVID-19 impact are collected. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 Impairment of Long-Term Assets [SCIO] includes:
• COVID-19 Impairment of Long-Term Assets [ECIP]

COVID-19 One-time Provisions [SCPR] represents one-time provisions made by the company due to COVID-19 impact. Inventory provisions are commonly created to manage the increase in raw material prices due to COVID-19 impact. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 One-time Provisions [SCPR] includes:
• COVID-19 One-time Provisions [ECOP]

COVID-19 One-time Government Grants [SCGR] represents one-time grants or incentives provided by the Government because of COVID-19 crisis. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 One-time Government Grants [SCGR] includes:
• COVID-19 One-time Government Grants [ECGR]

Valuation of Inventory - Gain/(Loss) [SVAI] represents a non-recurring item related to the unexpected and unplanned value change of inventories. Applicable to Industrial companies.
Valuation of Inventory - Gain/(Loss) [SVAI] includes:
• Valuation of Inventory - Gain/Loss [EVAI]

COVID-19 Income Taxes - Non-Recurring Charge/(Credit) [SCXC] represents one-time or non-recurring gain/loss resulting from COVID-19 impact reported under income taxes. Applicable to all industries.
COVID-19 Income Taxes - Non-Recurring Charge/(Credit) [SCXC] includes:
• COVID-19 Income Taxes - Non-Recurring Charge/Credit [VCXC]

Variable Lease Expense – Unclassified [SVLEU] represents the portion of the payment made by a lessee to the lessor for the right to use an asset during the lease term that varies due to change in factors or circumstances at the commencement date of the lease.  Variable Lease expense is dependent on an index or rate such as customer price index, interest rate or market rental rates. Amount of variable lease cost is recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for both finance and operating leases or for unclassified leases. Applicable to all industries.

provider_title: Net Investments & Loans Gain/(Loss) - Business Revenue [SSGL]
provider_description:
Net Investments & Loans Gain/(Loss) - Business Revenue [SSGL] represents the total result arising from all investments, not specified as related to realized or unrealized gains. Applicable to Banks, Insurance, Investment and Other Financial companies. Note: Companies use differing terminology while referring to total investment income. The term “Investment income” may sometimes, particularly in the U.S., refer to interest and dividends receivable. Total net investment income is defined as a sum of realized and unrealized gains/losses, interest and dividends form a separate category of income statement items. 
Net Investments & Loans Gain/(Loss) - Business Revenue [SSGL] includes: 
• Net Investments & Loans Gain/Loss - Business Revenue [ESGL]

Other Comprehensive Income - Discontinued Operations [SCDN] represents other comprehensive income related to discontinued operations which has not been accounted for in the Income Statement. Applicable to all Industries.
Other Comprehensive Income - Discontinued Operations [SCDN] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Discontinued Operations - Net of Tax [XCDN]

provider_title: Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs - Supplemental [SAML]
provider_description:
Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs - Supplemental [SAML] represents amortization of licenses, copyrights, property rights and designs for the period. Applicable to all Industries.
Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs - Supplemental [SAML] includes:
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs - Supplemental [VAML]

If the account above is not available, it includes:
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs [EAML]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs in Cost of Revenues [EALC]
• Amortization of Licenses, Copyrights, Property Rights & Designs in Selling, General & Administrative Expenses [EALS]

Capital Gains/(Losses) - Unrealized - Total [SUNC] represents proceeds from the sale or redemption of investment securities and commodities.  Unrealized gains and losses are defined as changes in the market value of instruments, resulting from movements in readily observable market prices. Fair value adjustments are of a less recurring nature and generally refer to periodic remeasurements of assets, based on various valuation models. Fair value adjustments may also reflect a change to key assumptions required by accounting standards, resulting in a different valuation of financial instruments. Applicable to Investment Trust and Other Financial companies.
Capital Gains/(Losses) - Unrealized - Total [SUNC] includes:
Investment Trust:
• Capital Gains/(Losses) - Unrealized - Total [EUNT]
• Investment Securities - Unrealized Gains/Loss [SGUS]
• Commodities - Unrealized Gain/Loss [SGUC]
• Foreign Exchange Gain/Loss - Unrealized - Capital [SGLC]
• Derivatives - Hedging - Business - Fair Value Adjustments [SDEO]
• Undifferentiated/Other Unrealized Gains/Loss [SUNO]

Other Financial:
• Investment Securities - Unrealized Gains/Loss [EGUS]

provider_title: Provision for Decommissioning Fund & Environmental Obligations [SPDF]
provider_description:
Provision for Decommissioning Fund & Environmental Obligations [SPDF] represents provision for the decommissioning of mines or other natural assets used in the operations of the company to extract natural resources after their full utilization. Applicable to Industrial companies. 
Provision for Decommissioning Fund and Environmental Obligations [SPDF] includes: 
• Provision for Decommissioning Fund & Environmental Obligations [EPDF]

provider_title: Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Insurance Contracts Issued [SXOF]
provider_description:
Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Insurance Contracts Issued [SXOF] represents insurance finance income or expenses related to insurance contract recognised in other comprehensive income (OCI) should be shown separately. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Insurance Contracts Issued [SXOF] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Insurance Contracts Issued [XOFI]

provider_title: Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Reinsurance Contracts Issued [SXFR]
provider_description:
Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Reinsurance Contracts Issued [SXFR] represents reinsurance finance income or expenses related to reinsurance contract recognised in other comprehensive income (OCI) should be shown separately. Applicable to Insurance companies.
Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Reinsurance Contracts Issued [SXFR] includes:
• Other Comprehensive Income - Finance Expenses from Reinsurance Contracts Issued [XOFR]

Recognition of Negative Goodwill [SNGO] represents gain on the recognition of a negative goodwill. Negative goodwill is the surplus of an acquired company’s value over the price that the acquiring company paid for the assets. Most accounting standards require such a surplus to be disclosed (recognized) in the income statement as of the purchase date. Applicable to all Industries.
Recognition of Negative Goodwill [SNGO] includes:
• Negative Goodwill Recognized [ENGO]

provider_title: Gain/(Loss) - Market Risk Benefits [SMRB] representsnet value of  realized gain or loss on market risk benefit as a result of investing in a financial product that is designed to mitigate market risk and changes in fair value on market risk benefits recognized in Income Statement. The realized gain or loss is the difference between the price at which the market risk benefit was purchased and the price at which it was sold or exercised.  This disclosure is based on the adoption of ASU 2018-12, Financial Services - Insurance (Topic 944): Targeted Improvements to the Accounting for Long-Duration Contracts for US GAAP insurance companies, effective from 1/Jan/2023. Applicable to Insurance company.
